                          return (
                            <div className="bg-slate-900 text-white p-3 rounded-2xl shadow-xl border border-slate-700 text-xs space-y-1.5 min-w-[170px]">
                              <p className="font-black text-indigo-300 pb-1 border-b border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-between">
                                <span>{label} 2026</span>
                                <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-400 font-mono">{rate}% Coll.</span>
                              </p>
                              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-emerald-300">
                                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                  <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400" />
                                  <span>Collected:</span>
                                </span>
                                <span className="font-mono font-bold">PKR {collected.toLocaleString()}</span>
                              </div>
                              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-amber-300">
                                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                  <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-400" />
                                  <span>Pending:</span>
                                </span>
                                <span className="font-mono font-bold">PKR {pending.toLocaleString()}</span>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          );
                        }
                        return null;
                      }}
                    />
                    <Legend
                      verticalAlign="top"
                      align="right"
                      iconType="circle"
                      iconSize={8}
                      wrapperStyle={{ fontSize: '11px', paddingBottom: '12px' }}
                    />
                    <Bar
                      name="Collected Fees"
                      dataKey="collected"
                      fill="#10b981"
                      radius={[6, 6, 0, 0]}
                      maxBarSize={36}
                    />
                    <Bar
                      name="Pending Dues"
                      dataKey="pending"
                      fill="#f59e0b"
                      radius={[6, 6, 0, 0]}
                      maxBarSize={36}
                    />
                  </BarChart>
                </ResponsiveContainer>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Collection Progress Bar */}
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl border space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold">
                <span className="text-slate-600">Total Billed Fees:</span>
                <span className="font-mono text-slate-900">
                  PKR {(totalPaidFees + totalPendingFees).toLocaleString()}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="w-full h-3 bg-slate-200 rounded-full overflow-hidden flex">
                <div
                  style={{
                    width: `${
                      totalPaidFees + totalPendingFees > 0
                        ? (totalPaidFees / (totalPaidFees + totalPendingFees)) * 100
                        : 50
                    }%`,
                  }}
                  className="bg-emerald-500 h-full transition-all"
                  title="Collected"
                />
                <div
                  style={{
                    width: `${
                      totalPaidFees + totalPendingFees > 0
                        ? (totalPendingFees / (totalPaidFees + totalPendingFees)) * 100
                        : 50
                    }%`,
                  }}
                  className="bg-amber-500 h-full transition-all"
                  title="Pending"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] pt-1">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-emerald-700 font-semibold">
                  <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
                  <span>Collected: PKR {totalPaidFees.toLocaleString()}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-amber-700 font-semibold">
                  <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500" />
                  <span>Pending: PKR {totalPendingFees.toLocaleString()}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Recent Admissions Preview */}
            <div className="mt-6">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                <h4 className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                  Recent Admissions
                </h4>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setCurrentPath('admissions')}
                  className="text-xs text-indigo-600 hover:underline font-bold"
                >
                  View All ({state.admissions.length})
                </button>
              </div>
              <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100 border rounded-2xl overflow-hidden">
                {state.admissions.slice(0, 4).map((adm) => (
                  <div
                    key={adm.id}
                    className="p-3.5 hover:bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-between text-xs transition"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-slate-900 text-white font-bold flex items-center justify-center text-[11px]">
                        {adm.studentName.charAt(0)}
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <p className="font-bold text-slate-900">{adm.studentName}</p>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                          {adm.course} • {adm.batch}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-right">
                      <span
                        className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold ${
                          adm.status === 'Confirmed'
                            ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                            : 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {adm.status}
                      </span>
                      <p className="font-mono text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                        PKR {(adm.netFee || adm.admissionFee - adm.discount).toLocaleString()}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Today's Academic Timetable Snapshot */}
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl border p-6 shadow-sm">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-extrabold text-base text-slate-900">
                  Academic Routine Snapshot
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">Active class periods & assigned educators</p>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setCurrentPath('timetable')}
                className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-800 flex items-center gap-1"
              >
                <span>Full Timetable</span>
                <ArrowUpRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              {state.timetables.slice(0, 4).map((slot) => (
                <div
                  key={slot.id}
                  className="p-3.5 bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl border hover:border-indigo-300 transition"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs mb-1.5">
                    <span className="font-mono font-bold text-indigo-700 bg-indigo-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
                      {slot.timing || `Period ${slot.period}`}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-500">
                      Room {slot.room}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900">{slot.subject}</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 mt-0.5">
                    {slot.batch} • Teacher: {slot.teacher}
                  </p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Col: All 28 ERP Modules Quick Directory with Search */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-6">
          {/* Pending Approvals Widget */}
          {pendingApprovalsCount > 0 && (
            <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-50 to-orange-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-3xl p-5 shadow-sm">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                  <span className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-amber-500 text-white flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm">
                    {pendingApprovalsCount}
                  </span>
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-amber-950">
                      Action Required: Approvals
                    </h4>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-amber-800">
                      Discount, admission, or voucher requests waiting
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setIsApprovalsOpen(true)}
                  className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold shadow-sm transition"
                >
                  Review
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Complete 28 Modules Directory */}
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl border p-6 shadow-sm">
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-4">
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-extrabold text-base text-slate-900">
                  ERP Suite • 28 Modules
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">Instant access to all institution subsystems</p>
              </div>
              <div className="relative">
                <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
                <input
                  value={moduleSearch}
                  onChange={(e) => setModuleSearch(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Filter modules..."
                  className="pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-50 border rounded-xl text-xs outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 w-full sm:w-36 transition"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 max-h-[580px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
              {filteredModules.map((mod) => (
                <button
                  key={mod.id}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setCurrentPath(mod.id);
                    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
                  }}
                  className="p-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 hover:border-indigo-400 hover:bg-indigo-50/40 text-left transition flex items-center justify-between group cursor-pointer shadow-xs"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
                    <span className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 flex items-center justify-center text-sm shrink-0 group-hover:scale-105 transition">
                      {mod.icon}
                    </span>
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <p className="font-bold text-xs text-slate-900 truncate group-hover:text-indigo-600 transition">
                        {mod.name}
                      </p>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block truncate">
                        {mod.category}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-slate-500 bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full shrink-0">
                    {mod.count}
                  </span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Real-Time Operational Pulse: Recent System Activity Feed & Quick Notes */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Left Column (7 cols): Recent System Activity Feed */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-7 bg-white rounded-3xl border p-6 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-4">
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse" />
                  <h3 className="font-extrabold text-base text-slate-900">
                    Recent System Activity
                  </h3>
                  <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200">
                    Live ERP Pulse
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                  Real-time record of the last 5 operational actions taken across the academy
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setCurrentPath('auditlogs');
                  window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
                }}
                className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-800 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer self-start sm:self-auto"
              >
                <span>Full Audit Logs</span>
                <ArrowUpRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* List of 5 Recent Actions */}
            <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100 border rounded-2xl overflow-hidden">
              {recentActivities.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="py-8 text-center text-xs text-slate-400">
                  <Activity className="w-8 h-8 text-slate-300 mx-auto mb-2" />
                  <p>No recent activity events recorded yet.</p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                recentActivities.map((act) => {
                  const isFinance =
                    act.module.includes('Fee') ||
                    act.action.includes('FEE') ||
                    act.action.includes('PAYROLL') ||
                    act.action.includes('EXPENSE');
                  const isStudent =
                    act.module.includes('Admission') ||
                    act.action.includes('ADMISSION') ||
                    act.action.includes('STUDENT');
                  const isAttendance =
                    act.module.includes('Attendance') || act.action.includes('ATTENDANCE');
                  const isExam =
                    act.module.includes('Exam') || act.action.includes('EXAM');

                  const badgeColor = isFinance
                    ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200'
                    : isStudent
                    ? 'bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 border-sky-200'
                    : isAttendance
                    ? 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200'
                    : isExam
                    ? 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border-indigo-200'
                    : 'bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 border-purple-200';

                  const iconEl = isFinance ? (
                    <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                  ) : isStudent ? (
                    <UserPlus className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-600" />
                  ) : isAttendance ? (
                    <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600" />
                  ) : isExam ? (
                    <FileText className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600" />
                  ) : (
                    <Activity className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-600" />
                  );

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={act.id}
                      className="p-3.5 hover:bg-slate-50/80 transition flex items-start justify-between gap-3 text-xs"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0">
                        <div
                          className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 border mt-0.5 ${badgeColor}`}
                        >
                          {iconEl}
                        </div>
                        <div className="min-w-0">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                            <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 leading-tight">
                              {act.action.replace(/_/g, ' ')}
                            </span>
                            <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded font-semibold bg-slate-100 text-slate-600">
                              {act.module}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 mt-0.5 line-clamp-1">
                            {act.details || act.targetRecord}
                          </p>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-1">
                            <span className="font-medium text-slate-700">{act.user}</span>
                            <span>&bull;</span>
                            <span className="truncate">{act.targetRecord}</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="shrink-0 text-right">
                        <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-slate-400 block whitespace-nowrap">
                          {act.timestamp}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[9px] uppercase px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded font-mono font-bold text-slate-500 bg-slate-100 inline-block mt-1">
                          {act.id}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-400">
            <span>Filtered for: <strong className="text-slate-700">{user?.role === 'developer' ? 'All Academies' : (user?.academyName || 'Current Academy')}</strong></span>
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-600 font-semibold">
              <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse" />
              Automated Audit Stream Active
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Column (5 cols): Quick Notes & Reminders */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 bg-white rounded-3xl border p-6 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <StickyNote className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
                  <h3 className="font-extrabold text-base text-slate-900">
                    Quick Notes & Reminders
                  </h3>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                  Admins temporary reminders & memos (persisted in local storage)
                </p>
              </div>
              <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200">
                {quickNotes.filter((n) => !n.completed).length} Pending
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Quick Note Input Form */}
            <form onSubmit={handleAddQuickNote} className="mb-4 space-y-2">
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={newNoteText}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewNoteText(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Jot down a quick note or memo..."
                  className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 border rounded-xl text-xs outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 transition"
                />
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-black text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer shrink-0 shadow-sm"
                >
                  <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Add</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Tag Selector */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-400">Tag:</span>
                {(['Reminder', 'Urgent', 'Meeting', 'Task', 'Memo'] as const).map((cat) => (
                  <button
                    key={cat}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setNewNoteCategory(cat)}
                    className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
                      newNoteCategory === cat
                        ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-xs'
                        : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {cat}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </form>

            {/* Persistent Notes List */}
            <div className="space-y-2 max-h-[260px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
              {quickNotes.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="py-8 text-center text-xs text-slate-400 bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl border border-dashed">
                  <StickyNote className="w-6 h-6 text-slate-300 mx-auto mb-1" />
                  <p>No reminders saved. Jot down your first memo above!</p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                quickNotes.map((note) => {
                  const tagStyles: Record<string, string> = {
                    Urgent: 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border-rose-200',
                    Meeting: 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border-indigo-200',
                    Reminder: 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200',
                    Task: 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200',
                    Memo: 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-200',
                  };

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={note.id}
                      className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border transition flex items-start justify-between gap-2 text-xs group ${
                        note.completed
                          ? 'bg-slate-50/60 border-slate-200 opacity-60'
                          : 'bg-white border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-start gap-2 min-w-0">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleToggleQuickNote(note.id)}
                          className="mt-0.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-indigo-600 transition cursor-pointer shrink-0"
                          title={note.completed ? 'Mark uncompleted' : 'Mark completed'}
                        >
                          {note.completed ? (
                            <CheckSquare className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                          ) : (
                            <Square className="w-4 h-4" />
                          )}
                        </button>
                        <div className="min-w-0">
                          <p
                            className={`text-xs font-medium leading-snug break-words ${
                              note.completed ? 'line-through text-slate-400' : 'text-slate-800'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {note.text}
                          </p>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1">
                            <span
                              className={`text-[9px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded border ${
                                tagStyles[note.category] || 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600'
                              }`}
                            >
                              {note.category}
                            </span>
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                              {new Date(note.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {
                                day: '2-digit',
                                month: 'short',
                              })}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleDeleteQuickNote(note.id)}
                        title="Delete Note"
                        className="p-1 text-slate-300 hover:text-rose-600 rounded transition cursor-pointer shrink-0 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {quickNotes.some((n) => n.completed) && (
            <div className="mt-3 pt-2.5 border-t border-slate-100 flex justify-end">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleClearCompletedNotes}
                className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                Clear completed notes
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f8fafc] flex flex-col font-['Plus_Jakarta_Sans',sans-serif]">
      {/* Sticky Top Banner for Demo Accounts (Strict Read-Only Mode) */}
      {(user?.isDemo || user?.readOnly) && (
        <aside aria-label="Demo Account Notification" className="bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-600 via-orange-600 to-amber-700 text-white px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold shadow-md flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 sticky top-0 z-50 border-b border-amber-500">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <span className="flex h-2.5 w-2.5 relative">
              <span className="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-white opacity-75"></span>
              <span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2.5 w-2.5 bg-white"></span>
            </span>
            <span className="bg-black/25 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider">
              Demo Sandbox (Read-Only)
            </span>
            <span className="text-amber-50">
              Active demo session as <strong className="text-white capitalize">{user.role}</strong>. In demo mode, all modifications/writes are blocked.
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={() => logout()}
              className="px-3 py-1 bg-white text-amber-900 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-amber-100 transition shadow-sm cursor-pointer"
            >
              Exit Demo
            </button>
          </div>
        </aside>
      )}

      {/* Floating Demo Mode Write Blocked Toast */}
      {demoWriteAlert && (
        <div className="fixed top-14 right-4 z-50 max-w-md bg-amber-950 border-2 border-amber-400 text-white px-4 py-3 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl flex items-start gap-3">
          <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-300 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <div className="flex-1 text-xs">
            <p className="font-bold text-amber-200">Action Blocked (Demo Account)</p>
            <p className="text-amber-100 mt-0.5 leading-relaxed">{demoWriteAlert}</p>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={() => setDemoWriteAlert(null)}
            className="text-amber-300 hover:text-white text-xs font-bold px-1 cursor-pointer"
          >
            ✕
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Top Main Navigation Header */}
      <Header
        onToggleMobileDrawer={() => setIsMobileDrawerOpen((prev) => !prev)}
        onOpenSearch={() => setIsSearchOpen(true)}
        onOpenApprovals={() => setIsApprovalsOpen(true)}
        onOpenNotices={() => setIsNoticesModalOpen(true)}
        onOpenExportZip={() => setIsExportZipOpen(true)}
        onNavigate={(path: string) => {
          setCurrentPath(path);
          window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
        }}
        currentUser={user}
      />

      <div className="flex-1 flex min-h-0">
        {/* Sidebar Drawer */}
        <SidebarDrawer
          currentPath={currentPath}
          setCurrentPath={(p: string) => {
            setCurrentPath(p);
            window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
          }}
          isMobileDrawerOpen={isMobileDrawerOpen}
          setIsMobileDrawerOpen={setIsMobileDrawerOpen}
        />

        {/* Main Content Workspace */}
        <main className="flex-1 min-w-0 p-3 sm:p-4 md:p-6 lg:p-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full pb-28 md:pb-8">
          {/* Active Session & Instant Role Switcher Bar */}
          <div className="mb-4 p-2.5 bg-slate-900/90 backdrop-blur-md rounded-2xl border border-indigo-900/50 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2.5 text-xs text-white shadow-md no-print">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-1">
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
              <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-300">
                Active Session: <b className="text-white">{user.name}</b>
              </span>
              <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider ${
                user.role === 'developer' ? 'bg-purple-600 text-white' :
                user.role === 'admin' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white' :
                user.role === 'teacher' ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white' :
                user.role === 'student' ? 'bg-cyan-600 text-white' : 'bg-amber-600 text-white'
              }`}>
                {user.role}
              </span>
              {user.isDemo && (
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40">
                  🔒 Read-Only Demo
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            {user.isDemo || user.readOnly ? (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="px-3 py-1 rounded-xl text-[11px] font-bold bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  🔒 Locked to {user.role.toUpperCase()} Portal (Role Switching Disabled in Demo)
                </span>
              </div>
            ) : isDev ? (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase hidden sm:inline">Role View:</span>
                {(['developer', 'admin', 'teacher', 'student', 'parent'] as const).map((r) => (
                  <button
                    key={r}
                    onClick={() => {
                      const demoUser: User = {
                        uid: `usr-${r}-active`,
                        id: `usr-${r}-active`,
                        name: r === 'developer' ? 'Sajjad Ali Qasmi (Chief Developer)' :
                              r === 'admin' ? 'Prof. Ghulam Rasool (Academy Admin)' :
                              r === 'teacher' ? 'Sir Saeed Ahmed (Senior Faculty)' :
                              r === 'student' ? 'Ahmed Ali Qasmi (Pre-Engineering)' : 'Haji Mohammad Qasmi (Parent)',
                        email: r === 'developer' ? 'developer@hisaabkitaab.com' : `${r}@taleemacademy.edu.pk`,
                        role: r,
                        academyId: r === 'developer' ? null : 'inst-1',
                        academyName: r === 'developer' ? 'All Academies (Global Network)' : 'Taleem Academy Main Campus (Kandhkot)',
                        status: 'approved',
                        createdAt: Date.now(),
                      };
                      localStorage.setItem('taleemos_current_user_v5', JSON.stringify(demoUser));
                      setUser(demoUser);
                      if (r === 'developer') {
                        setCurrentPath('developer');
                      } else {
                        erpStorage.setActiveInstitution('inst-1');
                        setCurrentPath('dashboard');
                      }
                    }}
                    className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl text-[11px] font-bold transition cursor-pointer capitalize ${
                      user.role === r
                        ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-md'
                        : 'bg-white/10 text-slate-300 hover:bg-white/20 hover:text-white'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {r === 'developer' ? '👑 Dev' : r === 'admin' ? '🏢 Admin' : r === 'teacher' ? '👨‍🏫 Teacher' : r === 'student' ? '🎓 Student' : '👨‍👩‍👧 Parent'}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </div>

          {/* Breadcrumb if not on dashboard */}
          {normalizedPath !== 'dashboard' && (
            <div className="mb-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 bg-white border rounded-2xl px-4 py-2.5 shadow-sm">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    setCurrentPath('dashboard');
                    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
                  }}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <ArrowLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Dashboard</span>
                </button>
                <span className="text-slate-300">/</span>
                <span className="text-xs font-black text-slate-900 capitalize">
                  {currentPath.replace(/[-_]/g, ' ')}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium">
                <span className="hidden sm:inline">Active Scope:</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-indigo-100">
                  {isDev
                    ? (state.activeInstitutionId === 'all' ? '🌐 All Academies' : state.activeInstitutionId)
                    : (user?.academyName || 'Taleem Academy')}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Global Floating 'Download as PDF' button for active module */}
          {normalizedPath !== 'dashboard' && normalizedPath !== 'students' && normalizedPath !== 'fees' && (
            <FloatingPdfButton
              label={`Download ${currentPath.replace(/[-_]/g, ' ')} PDF`}
            />
          )}

          {/* Module Output */}
          <div className="transition-all">
            {renderActiveModule()}
          </div>
        </main>
      </div>

      {/* Mobile Bottom Navigation Bar (Fixed for responsive mobile usability) */}
      <div className="md:hidden fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-40 bg-slate-900/95 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-indigo-900/50 px-2 py-1.5 flex items-center justify-around shadow-2xl no-print">
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            setCurrentPath('dashboard');
            window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
          }}
          className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-1.5 rounded-xl transition cursor-pointer ${
            normalizedPath === 'dashboard' ? 'text-indigo-400 font-bold' : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
          }`}
        >
          <span className="text-base">🏠</span>
          <span className="text-[10px] leading-tight">Home</span>
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => {
            setCurrentPath('users');
            window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
          }}
          className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-1.5 rounded-xl transition cursor-pointer ${
            normalizedPath === 'users' ? 'text-indigo-400 font-bold' : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
          }`}
        >
          <span className="text-base">👥</span>
          <span className="text-[10px] leading-tight">Users</span>
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => {
            setCurrentPath('calendar');
            window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
          }}
          className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-1.5 rounded-xl transition cursor-pointer ${
            normalizedPath === 'calendar' ? 'text-indigo-400 font-bold' : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
          }`}
        >
          <span className="text-base">📅</span>
          <span className="text-[10px] leading-tight">Calendar</span>
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => {
            setCurrentPath('fees');
            window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
          }}
          className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-1.5 rounded-xl transition cursor-pointer ${
            normalizedPath === 'fees' ? 'text-indigo-400 font-bold' : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
          }`}
        >
          <span className="text-base">💰</span>
          <span className="text-[10px] leading-tight">Fees</span>
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => setIsMobileDrawerOpen(true)}
          className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-1.5 rounded-xl text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
        >
          <span className="text-base">☰</span>
          <span className="text-[10px] leading-tight">Drawer</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Global Modals */}
      <GlobalSearchModal
        isOpen={isSearchOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsSearchOpen(false)}
        onNavigate={(modulePath: string) => {
          setCurrentPath(modulePath);
          setIsSearchOpen(false);
          window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
        }}
      />

      <ApprovalCenterModal
        isOpen={isApprovalsOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsApprovalsOpen(false)}
        activeRole={state.activeRole}
      />

      <ExportZipModal
        isOpen={isExportZipOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsExportZipOpen(false)}
      />

      <PredictiveForecastModal
        isOpen={isForecastModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsForecastModalOpen(false)}
        forecast={predictiveForecast}
      />

      <TopbarNoticesModal
        isOpen={isNoticesModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsNoticesModalOpen(false)}
        onNavigate={(path: string) => {
          setCurrentPath(path);
          setIsNoticesModalOpen(false);
          window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}


==================== FILE: src/components/common/ApprovalCenterModal.tsx ====================
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  CheckCircle,
  XCircle,
  Clock,
  ShieldCheck,
  AlertCircle,
  Users,
  UserCheck,
  RefreshCw,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Modal } from './Modal';
import { erpStorage } from '../../lib/storage';
import { type UserRole, type ApprovalRequest, type AppUser } from '../../types';
import { fetchPendingUsers, setUserApprovalStatus } from '../../lib/academyService';

interface ApprovalCenterModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  activeRole: UserRole;
}

export const ApprovalCenterModal: React.FC<ApprovalCenterModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  activeRole,
}) => {
  const [rejectingId, setRejectingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [rejectReason, setRejectReason] = useState('');
  const [pendingUsers, setPendingUsers] = useState<AppUser[]>([]);
  const [loadingUsers, setLoadingUsers] = useState(false);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'users' | 'requests' | 'history'>('users');
  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState<any>(null);

  const state = erpStorage.getState();

  const loadPendingUsers = async () => {
    try {
      setLoadingUsers(true);
      const curr = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taleemos_current_user_v5') || 'null');
      setCurrentUser(curr);
      const isDev = curr?.role === 'developer';
      const acadId = curr?.academyId || curr?.institutionId;

      // Runs the user's Firestore query logic: query(collection(db, "users"), where("status", "==", "pending"))
      const fetched = await fetchPendingUsers(acadId, isDev);
      setPendingUsers(fetched || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Notice: loading pending users in ApprovalCenterModal:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoadingUsers(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      loadPendingUsers();
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  const handleApproveUser = async (u: AppUser) => {
    await setUserApprovalStatus(u.uid || u.id || '', 'approved');
    await loadPendingUsers();
  };

  const handleRejectUser = async (u: AppUser) => {
    await setUserApprovalStatus(u.uid || u.id || '', 'rejected');
    await loadPendingUsers();
  };

  // Role permissions check for institutional requests
  const canApprove = (req: ApprovalRequest): boolean => {
    if (activeRole === 'Super Admin') return true;
    if (activeRole === 'Director / Owner') {
      return (
        req.module === 'Admission Confirmed' ||
        req.module === 'Fee Discount > 500' ||
        req.module === 'Expense > 5000'
      );
    }
    if (activeRole === 'Principal') {
      return (
        req.module === 'Staff Leave' ||
        req.module === 'Student Promotion' ||
        req.module === 'Marks Final Submit'
      );
    }
    return false;
  };

  const handleApprove = (req: ApprovalRequest) => {
    erpStorage.approveRequest(req.id, 'Approved via TaleemOS Approval Center');
  };

  const handleConfirmReject = (req: ApprovalRequest) => {
    if (!rejectReason.trim()) return;
    erpStorage.rejectRequest(req.id, rejectReason.trim());
    setRejectingId(null);
    setRejectReason('');
  };

  const pendingApprovals = state.approvals.filter((a) => a.status === 'Pending Approval');
  const pastApprovals = state.approvals.filter((a) => a.status !== 'Pending Approval');

  return (
    <Modal
      isOpen={isOpen}
      onClose={onClose}
      title="Enterprise Approval Center"
      subtitle={`Review and authorize pending user registrations and institution requests. Active Role: ${activeRole}`}
      badge="HIERARCHICAL RBAC"
      maxWidth="max-w-4xl"
    >
      <div className="space-y-5">
        {/* Tab Switcher */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-slate-200 pb-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('users')}
              className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === 'users'
                  ? 'bg-amber-500 text-white shadow-sm'
                  : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'
              }`}
            >
              <Users className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Pending User Accounts</span>
              <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[10px] bg-white/20 font-mono">
                {pendingUsers.length}
              </span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('requests')}
              className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === 'requests'
                  ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-sm'
                  : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'
              }`}
            >
              <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Institutional Requests</span>
              <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[10px] bg-white/20 font-mono">
                {pendingApprovals.length}
              </span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('history')}
              className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === 'history'
                  ? 'bg-slate-800 text-white shadow-sm'
                  : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'
              }`}
            >
              <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Decision History</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={loadPendingUsers}
            disabled={loadingUsers}
            title="Refresh from Firestore"
            className="p-1.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-indigo-600 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-100 cursor-pointer transition flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loadingUsers ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">Sync Firestore</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* TAB 1: Pending User Accounts (UI Cards from Firestore query) */}
        {activeTab === 'users' && (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 flex items-center gap-2">
                <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
                Firestore Pending Users Queue ({pendingUsers.length})
              </h4>
              <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                {currentUser?.role === 'developer'
                  ? 'Super Developer: Approve Admins across all branches'
                  : `Admin: Authorize members of ${currentUser?.academyName || 'your academy'}`}
              </span>
            </div>

            {pendingUsers.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="p-8 text-center bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200">
                <UserCheck className="w-10 h-10 text-emerald-500 mx-auto mb-2" />
                <p className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700">All user registrations cleared!</p>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                  New registrations from Firestore will automatically appear here.
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                {pendingUsers.map((u) => (
                  <div
                    key={u.uid || u.id}
                    className="p-4 bg-white rounded-2xl border border-amber-200/90 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow flex flex-col justify-between gap-3"
                  >
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
                          <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-amber-500 to-orange-500 text-white font-bold flex items-center justify-center text-xs shrink-0 shadow-sm">
                            {u.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                          </div>
                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <h5 className="font-extrabold text-slate-900 text-xs truncate">
                              {u.name}
                            </h5>
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono block truncate">
                              {u.email}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 text-[10px] font-black rounded-md uppercase border border-amber-300 shrink-0">
                          {u.role}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      <div className="mt-2.5 p-2 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-slate-100 text-[11px] text-slate-600 space-y-0.5">
                        <div className="flex justify-between">
                          <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px]">Institution:</span>
                          <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800 truncate max-w-[200px]">
                            {u.academyName || 'Unassigned'}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        {u.phone && (
                          <div className="flex justify-between">
                            <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px]">Phone:</span>
                            <span className="font-mono text-slate-700">{u.phone}</span>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleApproveUser(u)}
                        className="flex-1 py-1.5 px-3 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl shadow-sm shadow-emerald-700/20 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-all"
                      >
                        <CheckCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        <span>Authorize</span>
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleRejectUser(u)}
                        className="py-1.5 px-3 bg-rose-100 hover:bg-rose-200 text-rose-700 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-1 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                      >
                        <XCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        <span>Reject</span>
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* TAB 2: Institutional Requests */}
        {activeTab === 'requests' && (
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
              <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 flex items-center gap-2">
                <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-500" />
                Pending Requests Queue ({pendingApprovals.length})
              </h4>
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                Only authorized roles can authorize actions
              </span>
            </div>

            {pendingApprovals.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="p-8 text-center bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200">
                <ShieldCheck className="w-10 h-10 text-emerald-500 mx-auto mb-2" />
                <p className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700">All clear! No pending requests.</p>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">Requests will automatically appear here.</p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {pendingApprovals.map((req) => {
                  const userCanAuthorize = canApprove(req);
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={req.id}
                      className="p-4 bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow"
                    >
                      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-3">
                        <div>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                            <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 text-[10px] font-black rounded-full uppercase">
                              {req.module}
                            </span>
                            <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-slate-400">
                              {req.id}
                            </span>
                            <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                              Requested by: <strong className="text-slate-800">{req.requestedBy}</strong> ({req.requestedRole})
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <h5 className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm mt-1">{req.title}</h5>
                          {req.amountOrValue && (
                            <div className="text-xs font-mono text-indigo-700 font-bold mt-0.5">
                              Value: {req.amountOrValue}
                            </div>
                          )}
                          {req.reason && (
                            <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 mt-1 italic bg-slate-50 p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-100">
                              &ldquo;{req.reason}&rdquo;
                            </p>
                          )}
                        </div>

                        {/* Approval Buttons */}
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                          {userCanAuthorize ? (
                            <>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => handleApprove(req)}
                                className="px-4 py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl shadow-md shadow-emerald-600/30 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-all"
                              >
                                <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
                                Authorize
                              </button>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => {
                                  setRejectingId(req.id);
                                  setRejectReason('');
                                }}
                                className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-rose-100 hover:bg-rose-200 text-rose-700 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                              >
                                <XCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
                                Reject
                              </button>
                            </>
                          ) : (
                            <div className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 text-xs rounded-xl flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium">
                              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
                              <span>Requires: {req.currentApproverRole}</span>
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Rejection reason inline form */}
                      {rejectingId === req.id && (
                        <div className="mt-3 p-3 bg-rose-50 rounded-xl border border-rose-200 animate-in fade-in">
                          <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-rose-800 mb-1">
                            Specify reason for rejection (mandatory):
                          </label>
                          <div className="flex gap-2">
                            <input
                              type="text"
                              value={rejectReason}
                              onChange={(e) => setRejectReason(e.target.value)}
                              placeholder="e.g., Exceeds monthly budget allowance..."
                              className="flex-1 px-3 py-1.5 bg-white border border-rose-300 rounded-lg text-xs outline-none focus:border-rose-500"
                            />
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleConfirmReject(req)}
                              className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-rose-600 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-rose-700 cursor-pointer"
                            >
                              Confirm
                            </button>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setRejectingId(null)}
                              className="px-2 py-1.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700 text-xs cursor-pointer"
                            >
                              Cancel
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* TAB 3: Decision History */}
        {activeTab === 'history' && (
          <div>
            <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
              <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />
              Decision History
            </h4>
            <div className="space-y-2 max-h-60 overflow-y-auto">
              {pastApprovals.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="p-6 text-center text-slate-400 text-xs">
                  No historical decisions logged yet.
                </div>
              ) : (
                pastApprovals.map((req) => (
                  <div
                    key={req.id}
                    className="p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-xs flex items-center justify-between"
                  >
                    <div>
                      <span className="font-bold text-slate-800">{req.title}</span>
                      <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 font-mono">
                        {req.date} &bull; Requested by {req.requestedBy}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <span
                      className={`px-2 py-0.5 font-bold rounded-full text-[10px] ${
                        req.status === 'Approved'
                          ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                          : 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {req.status}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
};


==================== FILE: src/components/common/CloudinaryUploader.tsx ====================
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  UploadCloud,
  FileCheck2,
  Loader2,
  Image as ImageIcon,
  FileText,
  ExternalLink,
  X,
  CheckCircle,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { uploadDocumentToCloudinary } from '../../lib/cloudinary';

interface CloudinaryUploaderProps {
  value?: string;
  onUpload: (url: string, meta?: { name: string; size: number; format: string }) => void;
  accept?: string;
  label?: string;
  description?: string;
  mode?: 'image' | 'document' | 'any';
  folder?: string;
  buttonText?: string;
  previewShape?: 'circle' | 'rounded' | 'banner';
  className?: string;
}

export const CloudinaryUploader: React.FC<CloudinaryUploaderProps> = ({
  value,
  onUpload,
  accept = 'image/*',
  label,
  description = 'Direct secure upload to Cloudinary (TaleemOS)',
  mode = 'image',
  folder = 'taleemos_erp',
  buttonText,
  previewShape = 'rounded',
  className = '',
}) => {
  const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);
  const [uploadError, setUploadError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [uploadedName, setUploadedName] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleFileChange = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    setIsUploading(true);
    setUploadError(null);
    try {
      const res = await uploadDocumentToCloudinary(file, folder);
      setUploadedName(file.name);
      onUpload(res.url, {
        name: res.name,
        size: res.size,
        format: res.format,
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Cloudinary upload error:', err);
      setUploadError(err.message || 'Upload failed. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setIsUploading(false);
      e.target.value = '';
    }
  };

  const isPdf = value?.toLowerCase().endsWith('.pdf') || value?.includes('/raw/upload/');
  const isImage = value && !isPdf;

  return (
    <div className={`space-y-2 ${className}`}>
      {label && (
        <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700">
          {label}
        </label>
      )}

      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center gap-3 p-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200/90 rounded-2xl">
        {/* Preview Section */}
        {value ? (
          <div className="relative group shrink-0">
            {isImage ? (
              <img
                src={value}
                alt="Cloudinary Asset"
                className={`object-cover border-2 border-indigo-400/50 shadow-sm bg-white ${
                  previewShape === 'circle'
                    ? 'w-14 h-14 rounded-full'
                    : previewShape === 'banner'
                    ? 'w-28 h-14 rounded-xl'
                    : 'w-14 h-14 rounded-xl'
                }`}
              />
            ) : (
              <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-xl bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-indigo-700">
                <FileText className="w-6 h-6" />
                <span className="text-[9px] font-bold font-mono">PDF</span>
              </div>
            )}
            <a
              href={value}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              className="absolute -top-1.5 -right-1.5 p-1 bg-white hover:bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border border-slate-200 rounded-full shadow-sm transition"
              title="Open full size"
            >
              <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />
            </a>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div
            className={`w-14 h-14 rounded-xl bg-slate-200/60 border border-dashed border-slate-300 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-400 shrink-0 ${
              previewShape === 'circle' ? 'rounded-full' : ''
            }`}
          >
            {mode === 'document' ? (
              <FileText className="w-6 h-6" />
            ) : (
              <ImageIcon className="w-6 h-6" />
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Action & Info Area */}
        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
            <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl cursor-pointer transition shadow-xs">
              {isUploading ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                  <span>Uploading to Cloudinary...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <UploadCloud className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>
                    {buttonText ||
                      (value
                        ? 'Replace via Cloudinary'
                        : mode === 'document'
                        ? 'Upload Document'
                        : 'Upload Photo')}
                  </span>
                </>
              )}
              <input
                type="file"
                accept={accept}
                disabled={isUploading}
                onChange={handleFileChange}
                className="hidden"
              />
            </label>

            {value && (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                <CheckCircle className="w-3 h-3" />
                Cloudinary Synced
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-1 truncate">
            {uploadedName ? (
              <span className="font-medium text-slate-700">Uploaded: {uploadedName}</span>
            ) : (
              description
            )}
          </p>

          {uploadError && (
            <p className="text-[10px] text-rose-600 font-semibold mt-1">
              {uploadError}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};


==================== FILE: src/components/common/ErrorBoundary.tsx ====================
import React, { Component, type ErrorInfo, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { AlertOctagon, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';

interface Props {
  children: ReactNode;
  moduleName?: string;
}

interface State {
  hasError: boolean;
  error: Error | null;
  errorInfo: ErrorInfo | null;
}

export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<Props, State> {
  constructor(props: Props) {
    super(props);
    this.state = {
      hasError: false,
      error: null,
      errorInfo: null,
    };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): State {
    return {
      hasError: true,
      error,
      errorInfo: null,
    };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
    console.error('ErrorBoundary caught an error in module:', this.props.moduleName, error, errorInfo);
    this.setState({ errorInfo });
  }

  handleRetry = () => {
    this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null, errorInfo: null });
  };

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return (
        <div className="p-6 md:p-8 my-6 bg-red-950/20 border-2 border-red-500/80 rounded-[24px] shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-200">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
            <div className="p-3 bg-red-600 text-white rounded-2xl shadow-lg shadow-red-600/30 shrink-0">
              <AlertOctagon className="w-8 h-8 animate-pulse" />
            </div>
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider bg-red-500 text-white rounded-full">
                  Red Error Boundary Intercept
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs text-red-400 font-mono">
                  {this.props.moduleName || 'ERP Module'}
                </span>
              </div>
              <h3 className="mt-2 text-xl font-bold text-red-500">
                Module Encountered an Execution Anomaly
              </h3>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-300">
                The global application state has been preserved. You can safely retry or switch to another module.
              </p>
              {this.state.error && (
                <div className="mt-3 p-3 bg-black/50 rounded-xl border border-red-900/40 text-xs font-mono text-red-300 overflow-x-auto max-h-32">
                  {this.state.error.toString()}
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={this.handleRetry}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-500 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-black tracking-wide rounded-full shadow-lg shadow-red-600/30 transition-all cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <RotateCcw className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Retry Module
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 hover:text-white text-xs font-semibold rounded-full border border-slate-700 transition-all cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Reload Application
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return this.props.children;
  }
}

==================== FILE: src/components/common/GlobalSearchModal.tsx ====================
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Search, User, BookOpen, Receipt, School, ArrowRight, X, Calendar as CalendarIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import { erpStorage } from '../../lib/storage';

interface GlobalSearchModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onNavigate: (modulePath: string) => void;
}

export const GlobalSearchModal: React.FC<GlobalSearchModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onClose, onNavigate }) => {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const state = erpStorage.getState();

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === 'k') {
        e.preventDefault();
      }
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && isOpen) {
        onClose();
      }
    };
    if (isOpen) {
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      document.body.style.touchAction = 'none';
      window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    } else {
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
      document.body.style.touchAction = '';
    }
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
      document.body.style.touchAction = '';
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const q = query.toLowerCase().trim();

  const matchingStudents = q
    ? state.students.filter(
        (s) =>
          s.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          s.rollNo.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          s.fatherName.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      )
    : [];

  const matchingAdmissions = q
    ? state.admissions.filter(
        (a) =>
          a.studentName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          a.receiptNo.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          a.phone.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      )
    : [];

  const matchingCourses = q
    ? state.courses.filter(
        (c) =>
          c.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          c.code.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          c.department.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      )
    : [];

  const matchingFees = q
    ? state.fees.filter(
        (f) =>
          f.voucherNo.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          f.studentName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          f.rollNo.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      )
    : [];

  const matchingBooks = q
    ? state.library.filter(
        (b) =>
          b.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          b.author.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          b.isbn.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      )
    : [];

  const matchingCalendarEvents = q
    ? (state.calendarEvents || []).filter(
        (e) =>
          e.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          e.type.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (e.location && e.location.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
          (e.classBatch && e.classBatch.toLowerCase().includes(q))
      )
    : [];

  const totalResults =
    matchingStudents.length +
    matchingAdmissions.length +
    matchingCourses.length +
    matchingFees.length +
    matchingBooks.length +
    matchingCalendarEvents.length;

  return (

==================== FILE: src/components/common/FloatingPdfButton.tsx ====================
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Download, Printer, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { triggerBrowserPrint } from '../../lib/pdf';

interface FloatingPdfButtonProps {
  label?: string;
  targetId?: string;
  className?: string;
  onPrint?: () => void;
}

export const FloatingPdfButton: React.FC<FloatingPdfButtonProps> = ({
  label = 'Download as PDF',
  className = '',
  onPrint,
}) => {
  const [justPrinted, setJustPrinted] = useState(false);

  const handleClick = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setJustPrinted(true);
    setTimeout(() => setJustPrinted(false), 3000);
    if (onPrint) {
      onPrint();
    } else {
      triggerBrowserPrint();
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={`fixed top-18 right-4 md:right-8 z-40 no-print ${className}`}>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={handleClick}
        title="Trigger browser print/export to PDF for visible data"
        className="group flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-indigo-950 to-slate-900 hover:from-indigo-600 hover:to-indigo-700 text-white rounded-full shadow-2xl border border-indigo-400/40 hover:border-indigo-300 transition-all duration-300 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer hover:shadow-indigo-500/25 backdrop-blur-md"
      >
        <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-indigo-500/30 group-hover:bg-white/20 flex items-center justify-center transition">
          {justPrinted ? (
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
          ) : (
            <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-300 group-hover:text-white" />
          )}
        </div>
        <span className="text-xs font-black tracking-wide hidden sm:inline">
          {justPrinted ? 'Opening Print...' : label}
        </span>
        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-white/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-white/10 text-indigo-200 group-hover:text-white hidden md:inline">
          PDF
        </span>
      </button>
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { erpStorage, INSTITUTIONS } from '../../lib/storage';
import { getCurrentUser } from '../auth/AuthSystem';

interface LetterheadPrintProps {
  title: string;
  documentNo?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  date?: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  summaryStats?: { label: string; value: string | number }[];
  signatures?: string[];
  watermarkText?: string;
  id?: string;
  academyName?: string;
  academyCode?: string;
  academyAddress?: string;
  academyPhone?: string;
}

export const LetterheadPrint: React.FC<LetterheadPrintProps> = ({
  title,
  documentNo,
  subtitle,
  date = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }),
  children,
  summaryStats,
  signatures = ['Prepared By (Accounts/Admin)', 'Checked & Verified By', 'Authorized Signatory / Principal'],
  watermarkText,
  id = 'printable-document',
  academyName: propAcadName,
  academyCode: propAcadCode,
  academyAddress: propAcadAddress,
  academyPhone: propAcadPhone,
}) => {
  const state = erpStorage.getState();
  const currentUser = getCurrentUser();
  const isDev = currentUser?.role === 'developer';

  const activeInst =
    INSTITUTIONS.find((i) => i.id === state.activeInstitutionId) || INSTITUTIONS[0];

  // Resolve Academy Name based on role and active scope
  const resolvedAcademyName: string =
    propAcadName ||
    (isDev
      ? (state.activeInstitutionId === 'all' ? 'All Academies Network' : activeInst?.academyName || activeInst?.name || 'Taleem Academy')
      : (currentUser?.academyName || activeInst?.academyName || activeInst?.name || 'Taleem Academy')) || 'Taleem Academy';

  const resolvedCode = propAcadCode || activeInst?.code || 'TAK-01';
  const resolvedAddress = propAcadAddress || activeInst?.address || 'Kandhkot, Sindh, Pakistan';
  const resolvedPhone = propAcadPhone || activeInst?.phone || '0300-1234567';
  const resolvedWatermark = watermarkText || `${resolvedAcademyName.toUpperCase()} OFFICIAL`;

  const emblemInitials = resolvedAcademyName
    .split(' ')
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((w) => w[0] || '')
    .join('')
    .toUpperCase() || 'TA';

  return (
    <div
      id={id}
      className="bg-white p-6 md:p-8 rounded-[16px] border border-slate-200 shadow-md relative overflow-hidden text-slate-800 print:border-none print:shadow-none print:p-0 print:m-0"
    >
      {/* Background Watermark */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none select-none opacity-[0.03] print:opacity-[0.04] rotate-[-25deg]">
        <span className="text-7xl md:text-9xl font-black tracking-widest uppercase text-center">
          {resolvedWatermark}
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Official Letterhead Header */}
      <div className="border-b-2 border-indigo-900/80 pb-4 relative z-10">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-center sm:text-left">
            {/* Academy Emblem / Logo */}
            <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-800 via-indigo-950 to-slate-950 text-white flex flex-col items-center justify-center shadow-lg border border-indigo-700/50 shrink-0">
              <span className="text-xl font-black tracking-tighter">{emblemInitials}</span>
              <span className="text-[8px] font-bold tracking-widest text-indigo-300 uppercase">
                {resolvedCode}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div>
              <h1 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight leading-tight uppercase">
                {resolvedAcademyName}
              </h1>
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-700">
