==================== FILE: src/components/common/Modal.tsx ====================
import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { X } from 'lucide-react';

interface ModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  badge?: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  maxWidth?: string;
}

export const Modal: React.FC<ModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  title,
  subtitle,
  badge,
  children,
  maxWidth = 'max-w-3xl',
}) => {
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && isOpen) {
        onClose();
      }
    };
    if (isOpen) {
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      document.body.style.touchAction = 'none';
      window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    } else {
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
      document.body.style.touchAction = '';
    }
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
      document.body.style.touchAction = '';
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex flex-col justify-end md:justify-center items-center overflow-y-auto no-print overscroll-contain touch-pan-y">
      {/* Backdrop with blur black/70 */}
      <div
        className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-md transition-opacity duration-300"
        onClick={onClose}
      />

      {/* Modal Dialog */}
      <div
        className={`relative w-full ${maxWidth} bg-white rounded-t-[28px] md:rounded-[24px] shadow-2xl border border-slate-200/80 max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col z-10 transform transition-all duration-300 my-0 md:my-8 overflow-hidden overscroll-contain`}
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-50 to-indigo-50/30">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-2.5 h-7 rounded-full bg-indigo-600" />
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 tracking-tight">{title}</h3>
                {badge && (
                  <span className="px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 rounded-md">
                    {badge}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              {subtitle && <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">{subtitle}</p>}
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}

==================== FILE: src/components/common/TopbarNoticesModal.tsx ====================
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Bell,
  Megaphone,
  Plus,
  X,
  Trash2,
  Edit2,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  Clock,
  Send,
  Building2,
  Globe,
  Radio,
  ExternalLink,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { erpStorage, INSTITUTIONS } from '../../lib/storage';
import { type AlertNotification } from '../../types';
import { getCurrentUser } from '../auth/AuthSystem';
import { saveNoticeToFirestore, deleteNoticeFromFirestore } from '../../lib/academyService';
import { logAuditEvent } from '../../lib/auditLogger';

interface TopbarNoticesModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onNavigate: (path: string) => void;
}

export const TopbarNoticesModal: React.FC<TopbarNoticesModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onNavigate,
}) => {
  const currentUser = getCurrentUser();
  const isDev = currentUser?.role === 'developer';
  const isAdmin = currentUser?.role === 'admin';
  const isTeacher = currentUser?.role === 'teacher';
  const canPostNotices = isDev || isAdmin || isTeacher;

  const userAcademyId = currentUser?.academyId || 'inst-1';
  const userAcademyName =
    currentUser?.academyName ||
    INSTITUTIONS.find((i) => i.academyId === userAcademyId)?.academyName ||
    'Taleem Academy';

  const [alerts, setAlerts] = useState<AlertNotification[]>([]);
  const [showPostForm, setShowPostForm] = useState(false);
  const [editingAlertId, setEditingAlertId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Form State
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('');
  const [priority, setPriority] = useState<AlertNotification['priority']>('Medium');
  const [type, setType] = useState<AlertNotification['type']>('General');
  const [audience, setAudience] = useState<AlertNotification['audience']>('All');
  const [successMsg, setSuccessMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const loadAlerts = () => {
    const all = erpStorage.getState().alerts;
    // Filter for tenant isolation
    const filtered = all.filter((item) => {
      if (isDev) return true;
      const belongsToOwn = item.academyId === userAcademyId;
      const isGlobal = item.academyId === 'all';
      const isLegacy = !item.academyId;
      return belongsToOwn || isGlobal || isLegacy;
    });
    setAlerts(filtered);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadAlerts();
    const handleStorage = () => loadAlerts();
    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorage);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorage);
  }, [userAcademyId, isDev]);

  // Body scroll locking and touch containment while modal is open
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      document.body.style.touchAction = 'none';
      const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose();
      };
      window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      return () => {
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
        document.body.style.touchAction = '';
        window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      };
    } else {
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
      document.body.style.touchAction = '';
    }
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const canModify = (item: AlertNotification) => {
    if (isDev) return true;
    if ((isAdmin || isTeacher) && (item.academyId === userAcademyId || (!item.academyId && userAcademyId === 'inst-1'))) {
      return true;
    }
    if (item.postedById && (item.postedById === currentUser?.uid || item.postedById === currentUser?.id)) {
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  };

  const handlePublish = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!title.trim() || !message.trim()) return;

    if (editingAlertId) {
      const existing = alerts.find((a) => a.id === editingAlertId);
      if (existing) {
        const updated = {
          ...existing,
          title: title.trim(),
          message: message.trim(),
          priority,
          type,
          audience,
        };
        erpStorage.updateItem('alerts', existing.id, updated);
        saveNoticeToFirestore(updated);
        logAuditEvent({
          action: 'NOTICE_UPDATE',
          module: 'Alerts & Notices',
          targetRecord: title,
          details: `Updated notice ${existing.id} via Topbar Quick Panel`,
        });
        setSuccessMsg('Notice updated successfully!');
      }
      setEditingAlertId(null);
    } else {
      const targetAcadId = isDev ? 'all' : userAcademyId;
      const targetAcadName = isDev ? 'Global Broadcast (All Academies)' : userAcademyName;

      const newAlert: AlertNotification = {
        id: `ALT-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,
        title: title.trim(),
        type,
        priority,
        date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
        audience,
        status: 'New',
        message: message.trim(),
        assignedTo: isTeacher ? `${currentUser?.name || 'Teacher'} (Faculty)` : 'Academy Administration',
        actionTaken: 'Published via Topbar',
        academyId: targetAcadId,
        academyName: targetAcadName,
        postedBy: currentUser?.name || (isDev ? 'Developer' : isTeacher ? 'Teacher' : 'Admin'),
        postedByRole: currentUser?.role || (isDev ? 'developer' : isTeacher ? 'teacher' : 'admin'),
        postedById: currentUser?.uid || currentUser?.id || 'usr-quick',
      };

      erpStorage.addItem('alerts', newAlert);
      saveNoticeToFirestore(newAlert);
      logAuditEvent({
        action: 'NOTICE_CREATE',
        module: 'Alerts & Notices',
        targetRecord: title,
        details: `Published notice for ${targetAcadName} via Topbar Quick Panel`,
      });
      setSuccessMsg(`Notice published to ${targetAcadName}!`);
    }

    loadAlerts();
    setTitle('');
    setMessage('');
    setShowPostForm(false);
    setTimeout(() => setSuccessMsg(null), 3000);
  };

  const handleStartEdit = (item: AlertNotification) => {
    setEditingAlertId(item.id);
    setTitle(item.title);
    setMessage(item.message);
    setPriority(item.priority);
    setType(item.type);
    setAudience(item.audience);
    setShowPostForm(true);
  };

  const handleDelete = async (item: AlertNotification) => {
    if (confirm(`Delete notice "${item.title}"?`)) {
      erpStorage.deleteItem('alerts', item.id);
      await deleteNoticeFromFirestore(item.id);
      logAuditEvent({
        action: 'NOTICE_DELETE',
        module: 'Alerts & Notices',
        targetRecord: item.title,
        details: `Deleted notice ${item.id} via Topbar Quick Panel`,
      });
      loadAlerts();
      setSuccessMsg('Notice deleted.');
      setTimeout(() => setSuccessMsg(null), 3000);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex flex-col justify-end md:justify-center items-center overflow-y-auto no-print overscroll-contain touch-pan-y">
      {/* Backdrop */}
      <div
        className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-sm transition-opacity"
        onClick={onClose}
      />

      {/* Dialog */}
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-2xl bg-white rounded-t-[28px] md:rounded-[24px] shadow-2xl border border-slate-200/80 max-h-[88vh] flex flex-col z-10 my-0 md:my-8 overflow-hidden overscroll-contain">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-indigo-950 to-slate-900 text-white shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-600/30 border border-indigo-400/30 flex items-center justify-center text-xl shrink-0">
              📢
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h3 className="font-extrabold text-base tracking-tight text-white">
                  Academy Notices & Broadcasts
                </h3>
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider bg-indigo-500/30 text-indigo-200 border border-indigo-400/30 rounded-md">
                  {isDev ? 'Global' : userAcademyName.split(' ')[0]}
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-indigo-200/80 mt-0.5">
                {isTeacher
                  ? 'Teachers & Admins can publish, edit & manage academy notices'
                  : 'Official announcements, exam circulars & academic notices'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 rounded-full transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Feedback Alert */}
        {successMsg && (
          <div className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-emerald-50 border-b border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
            <span>{successMsg}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Action Bar (Top of Body) */}
        <div className="px-5 py-3 bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 shrink-0">
          <div className="text-xs text-slate-600 font-semibold">
            <span>{alerts.length} Active Notices</span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            {canPostNotices && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  if (showPostForm) {
                    setShowPostForm(false);
                    setEditingAlertId(null);
                    setTitle('');
                    setMessage('');
                  } else {
                    setShowPostForm(true);
                  }
                }}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>{showPostForm ? 'Cancel Post' : '+ Post Notice'}</span>
              </button>
            )}

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                onClose();
                onNavigate('alerts');
              }}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-white hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <span>Full Center</span>
              <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />

          {/* Notices List */}
          {alerts.length === 0 ? (

              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            alerts.map((item) => {

              const isCritical = item.priority === 'Critical';
              const isHigh = item.priority === 'High';

              return (
                <div
                  key={item.id}
                  className={`p-4 rounded-2xl border transition-all ${
                    isCritical
                      ? 'bg-rose-50/70 border-rose-300 shadow-xs'
                      : isHigh
                      ? 'bg-amber-50/60 border-amber-300'
                      : 'bg-white border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                    <div className="space-y-1 min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                        <span
                          className={`text-[9px] font-black uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border ${
                            isCritical
                              ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border-rose-300'
                              : isHigh
                              ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border-amber-300'
                              : 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border-indigo-200'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {item.priority}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-600 bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
                          {item.type}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1 font-mono">
                          <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
                          {item.date}
                        </span>
                        {item.academyId === 'all' && (
                          <span className="text-[9px] font-bold bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded">
                            🌐 Global Notice
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      <h4 className="font-extrabold text-sm text-slate-900 pt-0.5">
                        {item.title}
                      </h4>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-700 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line">
                        {item.message}
                      </p>

                      <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-500 border-t border-slate-100 mt-2">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 truncate">
                          <span>
                            Posted by: <b>{item.postedBy || 'Administration'}</b>
                          </span>
                          {item.postedByRole && (
                            <span className="text-[9px] uppercase px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-slate-100 font-bold">
                              {item.postedByRole}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-indigo-600 font-bold">
                          Audience: {item.audience}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Quick Edit/Delete Actions for Teacher/Admin/Developer */}
                    {userCanModify && (
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0 pt-0.5">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleStartEdit(item)}
                          className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-indigo-600 hover:bg-white rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition"
                          title="Edit Notice"
                        >
                          <Edit2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleDelete(item)}
                          className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 hover:bg-white rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition"
                          title="Delete Notice"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

interface MonthlyFeeData {
  month: string;
  shortMonth: string;
  billed: number; // PKR
  collected: number; // PKR
  efficiency: number; // %
  isSeasonalDrop?: boolean;
  dropReason?: string;
}

export const FeeCollectionAnalysisD3: React.FC = () => {
  const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement | null>(null);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const [selectedBatch, setSelectedBatch] = useState<string>('All');
  const [selectedYear, setSelectedYear] = useState<string>('2026');
  const [hoveredData, setHoveredData] = useState<MonthlyFeeData | null>(null);

  // Compute dataset (could scale by batch factor)
  const batchMultiplier =
    selectedBatch === 'Matric Science'
      ? 0.35
      : selectedBatch === 'F.Sc Pre-Medical'
      ? 0.45
      : selectedBatch === 'Computer Science'
      ? 0.2
      : 1.0;

  const dataset: MonthlyFeeData[] = ACADEMIC_YEAR_2026.map((item) => ({
    ...item,
    billed: Math.round(item.billed * batchMultiplier),
    collected: Math.round(item.collected * batchMultiplier),
    efficiency: item.efficiency,
  }));

  const totalBilled = dataset.reduce((acc, d) => acc + d.billed, 0);
  const totalCollected = dataset.reduce((acc, d) => acc + d.collected, 0);
  const overallEfficiency = Math.round((totalCollected / totalBilled) * 1000) / 10;
  const seasonalDropMonths = dataset.filter((d) => d.isSeasonalDrop);

  // D3 Rendering
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!svgRef.current || !containerRef.current) return;

    const containerWidth = containerRef.current.clientWidth || 800;
    const width = Math.max(680, containerWidth);
    const height = 400;
    const margin = { top: 40, right: 65, bottom: 55, left: 75 };
    const innerWidth = width - margin.left - margin.right;
    const innerHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;

    // Clear previous elements
    d3.select(svgRef.current).selectAll('*').remove();

    const svg = d3
      .select(svgRef.current)
      .attr('viewBox', `0 0 ${width} ${height}`)
      .attr('width', '100%')
      .attr('height', height)
      .style('overflow', 'visible');

    // Create main chart group
    const g = svg
      .append('g')
      .attr('transform', `translate(${margin.left},${margin.top})`);

    // X Scale (Months)
    const xScale = d3
      .scaleBand()
      .domain(dataset.map((d) => d.shortMonth))
      .range([0, innerWidth])
      .padding(0.3);

    // Y Scale Left (PKR Currency)
    const maxAmount = (d3.max(dataset, (d) => Math.max(d.billed, d.collected)) || 500000) * 1.15;
    const yScaleAmount = d3
      .scaleLinear()
      .domain([0, maxAmount])
      .nice()
      .range([innerHeight, 0]);

    // Y Scale Right (Efficiency %)
    const yScaleEfficiency = d3
      .scaleLinear()
      .domain([50, 100])
      .range([innerHeight, 0]);

    // Background horizontal grid lines
    const yAxisGrid = d3
      .axisLeft(yScaleAmount)
      .tickSize(-innerWidth)
      .tickFormat(() => '')
      .ticks(5);

    g.append('g')
      .attr('class', 'grid')
      .call(yAxisGrid)
      .selectAll('line')
      .attr('stroke', '#f1f5f9')
      .attr('stroke-dasharray', '3 3');

    // Seasonal Drop Highlight Region (July - August)
    const julX = xScale('Jul');
    const augX = xScale('Aug');
    if (julX !== undefined && augX !== undefined) {
      const bandwidth = xScale.bandwidth();
      const dropStartX = julX - bandwidth * 0.2;
      const dropWidth = augX + bandwidth * 1.2 - dropStartX;

      g.append('rect')
        .attr('x', dropStartX)
        .attr('y', 0)
        .attr('width', dropWidth)
        .attr('height', innerHeight)
        .attr('fill', '#fff1f2')
        .attr('opacity', 0.8)
        .attr('rx', 8);

      g.append('text')
        .attr('x', dropStartX + dropWidth / 2)
        .attr('y', 20)
        .attr('text-anchor', 'middle')
        .attr('fill', '#e11d48')
        .attr('font-size', '10px')
        .attr('font-weight', '700')
        .attr('letter-spacing', '0.05em')
        .text('SEASONAL COLLECTION DROP (SUMMER RECESS)');
    }

    // X Axis
    const xAxis = d3.axisBottom(xScale);
    g.append('g')
      .attr('transform', `translate(0,${innerHeight})`)
      .call(xAxis)
      .call((group) => {
        group.select('.domain').attr('stroke', '#cbd5e1');
        group.selectAll('text')
          .attr('fill', '#475569')
          .attr('font-weight', '600')
          .attr('font-size', '11px')
          .attr('dy', '1.2em');
      });

    // Y Axis Left (Amount in PKR)
    const yAxisLeft = d3
      .axisLeft(yScaleAmount)
      .ticks(6)
      .tickFormat((d) => `PKR ${(Number(d) / 1000).toFixed(0)}k`);

    g.append('g')
      .call(yAxisLeft)
      .call((group) => {
        group.select('.domain').remove();
        group.selectAll('text')
          .attr('fill', '#64748b')
          .attr('font-weight', '600')
          .attr('font-size', '10px');
      });

    // Y Axis Right (Efficiency %)
    const yAxisRight = d3
      .axisRight(yScaleEfficiency)
      .ticks(5)
      .tickFormat((d) => `${d}%`);

    g.append('g')
      .attr('transform', `translate(${innerWidth},0)`)
      .call(yAxisRight)

        group.select('.domain').remove();
        group.selectAll('text')
          .attr('fill', '#6366f1')
          .attr('font-weight', '700')
          .attr('font-size', '10px');
      });

    // Sub-bar scale for side-by-side bars (Billed vs Collected)
    const xSubScale = d3
      .scaleBand()
      .domain(['billed', 'collected'])
      .range([0, xScale.bandwidth()])
      .padding(0.08);

    // Bars: Target Billed
    g.selectAll('.bar-billed')
      .data(dataset)
      .enter()
      .append('rect')
      .attr('class', 'bar-billed')
      .attr('x', (d) => (xScale(d.shortMonth) || 0) + (xSubScale('billed') || 0))
      .attr('y', (d) => yScaleAmount(d.billed))
      .attr('width', xSubScale.bandwidth())
      .attr('height', (d) => innerHeight - yScaleAmount(d.billed))
      .attr('fill', '#94a3b8')
      .attr('rx', 4)
      .attr('opacity', 0.65)

    g.selectAll('.bar-collected')
      .data(dataset)
      .enter()

      .attr('x', (d) => (xScale(d.shortMonth) || 0) + (xSubScale('collected') || 0))
      .attr('y', (d) => yScaleAmount(d.collected))
      .attr('width', xSubScale.bandwidth())
      .attr('height', (d) => innerHeight - yScaleAmount(d.collected))
      .attr('fill', (d) => (d.isSeasonalDrop ? '#f43f5e' : '#10b981'))
      .attr('rx', 4)
      .on('mouseenter', (_, d) => setHoveredData(d));

    // Efficiency Curve Generator

    g.append('path')

      .attr('stroke-width', 3)
      .attr('stroke-dasharray', '0')
      .attr('d', lineGenerator);

    // Efficiency Data Circles
    g.selectAll('.efficiency-dot')
      .data(dataset)
      .enter()
      .append('circle')
      .attr('class', 'efficiency-dot')
      .attr('cx', (d) => (xScale(d.shortMonth) || 0) + xScale.bandwidth() / 2)
      .attr('cy', (d) => yScaleEfficiency(d.efficiency))
      .attr('r', (d) => (d.isSeasonalDrop ? 6 : 4.5))
      .attr('fill', (d) => (d.isSeasonalDrop ? '#e11d48' : '#ffffff'))
      .attr('stroke', '#4f46e5')
      .attr('stroke-width', 2.5)
      .style('cursor', 'pointer')
      .on('mouseenter', (_, d) => setHoveredData(d));

    // Efficiency Percentage Labels above dots
    g.selectAll('.efficiency-label')
      .data(dataset)
      .enter()
      .append('text')
      .attr('class', 'efficiency-label')
      .attr('x', (d) => (xScale(d.shortMonth) || 0) + xScale.bandwidth() / 2)
      .attr('y', (d) => yScaleEfficiency(d.efficiency) - 10)
      .attr('text-anchor', 'middle')
      .attr('font-size', '10px')
      .attr('font-weight', '700')
      .attr('fill', (d) => (d.isSeasonalDrop ? '#e11d48' : '#312e81'))
      .text((d) => `${d.efficiency}%`);

  }, [dataset]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Title & Filter Bar */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 p-5 shadow-sm flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-1.5 bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200 rounded-lg text-indigo-700">
              <Calendar className="w-4 h-4" />
            </span>
            <h2 className="text-base font-black text-slate-900">
              Fee Collection Efficiency Analysis
            </h2>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-indigo-600 text-white text-[10px] font-black rounded-full uppercase tracking-wider">
              D3 Engine
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
            Month-over-month target invoicing vs realized receipts with seasonal drop detection.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
          {/* Batch Selector */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs">
            <Filter className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
            <select
              value={selectedBatch}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedBatch(e.target.value)}
              aria-label="Filter by department"
              className="bg-transparent font-bold text-slate-700 focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
            >
              <option value="All">All Batches</option>
              <option value="Matric Science">Matric Science</option>
              <option value="F.Sc Pre-Medical">F.Sc Pre-Medical</option>
              <option value="Computer Science">Computer Science</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Year Selector */}
          <div className="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700">
            Academic Year {selectedYear}
          </div>

          {/* Print Report */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => triggerBrowserPrint()}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-indigo-50 hover:bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 font-bold text-xs rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            Print Report
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* KPI Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Annual Invoiced Target</div>
          <div className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900 font-mono mt-1">
            PKR {totalBilled.toLocaleString()}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">12 Calendar Months Total</div>
        </div>

        <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-2xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50/30 shadow-sm">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-700 uppercase">Realized Cash Collections</div>
          <div className="text-xl font-black text-emerald-700 font-mono mt-1">
            PKR {totalCollected.toLocaleString()}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-emerald-600 mt-0.5">
            Deficit: PKR {(totalBilled - totalCollected).toLocaleString()}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-2xl border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/30 shadow-sm">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-700 uppercase">Mean Collection Efficiency</div>
          <div className="text-xl font-black text-indigo-700 font-mono mt-1">
            {overallEfficiency}%
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-indigo-600 flex items-center gap-1 mt-0.5">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Institutional Target: &gt;85%
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-2xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50/40 shadow-sm">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-rose-700 uppercase">Severe Seasonal Drop</div>
          <div className="text-xl font-black text-rose-700 font-mono mt-1">
            July (68%) &amp; Aug (76%)
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-rose-600 flex items-center gap-1 mt-0.5">
            <AlertCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> -22% Below Mean
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* D3 Chart Card */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 p-5 shadow-sm space-y-4">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 pb-4">
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-sm font-black text-slate-900">
              Month-over-Month Efficiency Trajectory &amp; Realized Revenue
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
              Side-by-side bars indicate target billed vs collected cash; purple spline represents collection efficiency (%).
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Chart Legends */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 text-xs font-semibold">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="w-3 h-3 rounded bg-slate-400 opacity-60 inline-block" />
              <span className="text-slate-600">Billed Target</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="w-3 h-3 rounded bg-emerald-500 inline-block" />
              <span className="text-slate-600">Collected Cash</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="w-3 h-3 rounded bg-rose-500 inline-block" />
              <span className="text-rose-600 font-bold">Seasonal Drop Month</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="w-4 h-0.5 bg-indigo-600 inline-block" />
              <span className="text-indigo-600 font-bold">Efficiency %</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Responsive D3 SVG Container */}
        <div ref={containerRef} className="w-full overflow-x-auto py-2">
          <svg ref={svgRef} className="w-full min-w-[650px]" />
        </div>

        {/* Hover / Selected Month Detail Card */}
        {hoveredData ? (
          <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl flex flex-col md:flex-row items-start md:items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs animate-in fade-in">
            <div className="space-y-0.5">
              <div className="font-black text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                <span>{hoveredData.month}</span>
                <span
                  className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${
                    hoveredData.efficiency >= 90
                      ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                      : hoveredData.efficiency >= 80
                      ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800'
                      : 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800'
                  }`}
                >
                  {hoveredData.efficiency}% Efficiency
                </span>
              </div>
              {hoveredData.dropReason && (
                <p className="text-rose-600 font-medium">{hoveredData.dropReason}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-5">
              <div>
                <span className="text-slate-400 block text-[10px] font-bold uppercase">Billed Target</span>
                <span className="font-mono font-black text-slate-800">
                  PKR {hoveredData.billed.toLocaleString()}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div>
                <span className="text-slate-400 block text-[10px] font-bold uppercase">Collected Cash</span>
                <span className="font-mono font-black text-emerald-600">
                  PKR {hoveredData.collected.toLocaleString()}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div>
                <span className="text-slate-400 block text-[10px] font-bold uppercase">Shortfall</span>
                <span className="font-mono font-black text-rose-600">
                  PKR {(hoveredData.billed - hoveredData.collected).toLocaleString()}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-100 rounded-xl text-center text-xs text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
            <Info className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
            Hover over any bar or circular data point to inspect month-specific billing and collection details.
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Seasonal Drop Analysis Insights & Actionable Recovery Plan */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        <div className="p-5 bg-rose-50/60 border border-rose-200 rounded-2xl space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-rose-900 font-bold text-sm">
            <TrendingDown className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600" />
            <h3>Seasonal Drop Root-Cause Diagnostics</h3>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-700 leading-relaxed">
            Data reveals systematic collection dips every <strong>July (68%)</strong> and <strong>August (76%)</strong>.
            During the annual summer recess, campus physical counters experience an 85% drop in footfall. Parents traditionally postpone challan deposits until the resumption of physical classes in September.
          </p>
          <div className="space-y-2 pt-1 text-xs">
            <div className="p-2.5 bg-white/80 rounded-xl border border-rose-100 flex items-start gap-2">
              <span className="font-black text-rose-600">1.</span>
              <span className="text-slate-700">
                <strong>July Drop:</strong> PKR {(ACADEMIC_YEAR_2026[6].billed - ACADEMIC_YEAR_2026[6].collected).toLocaleString()} deferred cash inflow.
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="p-2.5 bg-white/80 rounded-xl border border-rose-100 flex items-start gap-2">
              <span className="font-black text-rose-600">2.</span>
              <span className="text-slate-700">
                <strong>August Slow Recovery:</strong> Post-monsoon reopening causes a backlog of bank branch deposits.
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="p-5 bg-emerald-50/60 border border-emerald-200 rounded-2xl space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-emerald-900 font-bold text-sm">
            <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
            <h3>Recommended Mitigation &amp; Recovery Workflow</h3>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-700 leading-relaxed">
            Implement digital prepayment incentives and advance billing schedules prior to summer recess:
          </p>
          <ul className="space-y-2 pt-1 text-xs text-slate-700">
            <li className="flex items-start gap-2">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <span><strong>Pre-Vacation Combined Challans:</strong> Issue June &amp; July fees in late May with an early-bird 5% concession waiver.</span>
            </li>
            <li className="flex items-start gap-2">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <span><strong>Digital 1Link / Kuickpay Integration:</strong> Enable mobile app banking and JazzCash/Easypaisa payments so parents don't rely on physical campus visits.</span>
            </li>
            <li className="flex items-start gap-2">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <span><strong>Automated Bulk WhatsApp Reminders:</strong> Schedule automated payment reminders 7 days and 2 days prior to the mid-July due date.</span>
            </li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Menu,
  Search,
  Bell,
  Shield,
  Building2,
  Download,
  Calendar,
  Clock,
  CheckCircle,
  Users,
  Sun,
  Moon,
  Megaphone,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { erpStorage, INSTITUTIONS } from '../../lib/storage';
import { type Academy } from '../../types';
import { getCurrentUser, type User } from '../auth/AuthSystem';
import { fetchActiveAcademies } from '../../lib/academyService';
import { getInitialTheme, toggleTheme, applyTheme, type ThemeMode } from '../../lib/theme';

interface HeaderProps {
  onToggleMobileDrawer: () => void;
  onOpenSearch: () => void;
  onOpenApprovals: () => void;
  onOpenNotices?: () => void;
  onOpenExportZip?: () => void;
  onNavigate: (path: string) => void;
  currentUser?: User | null;
}

export const Header: React.FC<HeaderProps> = ({
  onToggleMobileDrawer,
  onOpenSearch,
  onOpenApprovals,
  onOpenNotices,
  onOpenExportZip,
  onNavigate,
  currentUser: propUser,
}) => {
  const state = erpStorage.getState();
  const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState(new Date());
  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState<User | null>(propUser || getCurrentUser());
  const [activeAcademies, setActiveAcademies] = useState<Academy[]>([]);
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState<ThemeMode>(getInitialTheme());

  useEffect(() => {
    applyTheme(theme);
  }, [theme]);

  const handleToggleTheme = () => {
    const next = toggleTheme(theme);
    setTheme(next);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => setCurrentTime(new Date()), 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (propUser) {
      setCurrentUser(propUser);
    } else {
      setCurrentUser(getCurrentUser());
    }
    fetchActiveAcademies().then(setActiveAcademies);
  }, [propUser]);

  const isDev = currentUser?.role === 'developer';
  const isAdmin = currentUser?.role === 'admin';

  const pendingApprovalsCount = state.approvals.filter(
    (a) => a.status === 'Pending Approval'
  ).length;

  const userAcadId = currentUser?.academyId || state.activeInstitutionId;
  const activeNoticesCount = state.alerts.filter((item) => {
    if (isDev) return true;
    return item.academyId === userAcadId || item.academyId === 'all' || !item.academyId;
  }).length;

  const currentInstitution =
    INSTITUTIONS.find((i) => i.id === state.activeInstitutionId) || INSTITUTIONS[0];

  const handleInstitutionChange = (instId: string) => {
    erpStorage.setActiveInstitution(instId);
  };

  const formattedDate = currentTime.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
    weekday: 'short',
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
  });

  const formattedTime = currentTime.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', {
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
    second: '2-digit',
  });

  // Role Badge Styling
  const getRoleBadge = (role?: string) => {
    switch (role) {
      case 'developer':
        return { label: 'Developer', color: 'bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-300 border-purple-400/40', icon: '👑' };
      case 'admin':
        return { label: 'Academy Admin', color: 'bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-300 border-blue-400/40', icon: '🛡️' };
      case 'teacher':
        return { label: 'Teacher', color: 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-400/40', icon: '👨‍🏫' };
      case 'student':
        return { label: 'Student', color: 'bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 border-cyan-400/40', icon: '🎓' };
      case 'parent':
        return { label: 'Parent', color: 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border-amber-400/40', icon: '👨‍👩‍👧' };
      default:
        return { label: role || 'Member', color: 'bg-slate-500/20 text-slate-300 border-slate-400/40', icon: '👤' };
    }
  };

  const roleBadge = getRoleBadge(currentUser?.role);

  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-40 bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-indigo-950 to-slate-900 text-white border-b border-indigo-900/40 shadow-lg no-print w-full max-w-full overflow-hidden">
      {/* Top Header Main Row */}
      <div className="px-2.5 sm:px-4 md:px-6 py-2 sm:py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5 sm:gap-2 md:gap-4 w-full max-w-full">
        {/* Left side: Hamburger (mobile) + Campus selector */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2 md:gap-4 shrink-0 min-w-0">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onToggleMobileDrawer}
            className="p-1.5 sm:p-2 text-slate-300 hover:text-white rounded-xl hover:bg-white/10 active:scale-95 transition cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"
            title="Open Menu Drawer"
          >
            <Menu className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-300" />
          </button>

          {/* TaleemOS Official App Logo & Brand Crest (Beside Three Lines Menu) */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
            <div
              className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-500 via-indigo-600 to-violet-700 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-md shadow-indigo-950/40 border border-indigo-300/30 hover:scale-105 transition-transform"
              title="TaleemOS Enterprise ERP"
            >
              {/* Graduation Cap & Academic Crest Vector */}
              <svg
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                className="w-4 h-4 text-white drop-shadow-sm"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                strokeWidth="2.2"
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
              >
                <path d="M22 10v6M2 10l10-5 10 5-10 5z" />
                <path d="M6 12v5c3 3 9 3 12 0v-5" />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <div className="hidden sm:flex flex-col leading-none">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <span className="font-black text-xs tracking-tight text-white">TaleemOS</span>
                <span className="text-[7.5px] uppercase bg-indigo-500/30 text-indigo-200 border border-indigo-400/30 px-1 py-0.2 rounded font-bold">
                  ERP
                </span>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[9px] text-indigo-300/80 font-medium">Academy Hub</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Desktop Campus Multi-Tenant Switcher / Scoped Academy Display */}
          <div className="hidden md:flex items-center">
            {isDev ? (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-purple-900/40 hover:bg-purple-900/60 backdrop-blur-md px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-purple-500/40 transition-colors">
                <Building2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-400 shrink-0" />
                <div className="flex flex-col">
                  <span className="text-[9px] uppercase font-bold text-purple-300 leading-none">
                    Dev Scope
                  </span>
                  <select
                    value={state.activeInstitutionId}
                    onChange={(e) => handleInstitutionChange(e.target.value)}
                    className="bg-transparent text-xs font-bold text-white focus:outline-none cursor-pointer pr-1 truncate"
                  >
                    <option value="all" className="bg-slate-900 text-purple-300">
                      🌐 All Academies (Global)
                    </option>
                    {(activeAcademies.length > 0 ? activeAcademies : INSTITUTIONS).map((inst: any) => (
                      <option
                        key={inst.academyId || inst.id}
                        value={inst.academyId || inst.id}
                        className="bg-slate-900 text-white"
                      >
                        {inst.academyName || inst.name || inst.campusName} ({inst.code})
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-white/10">
                <Building2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-400 shrink-0" />
                <div className="flex flex-col">
                  <span className="text-[9px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 leading-none">
                    My Academy
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-white truncate max-w-[200px]">
                    {currentUser?.academyName || currentInstitution.campusName || 'Taleem Academy'}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Mobile Scope / Academy Label */}
          <div className="md:hidden flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
            <span className="text-xs font-black tracking-tight text-white truncate max-w-[95px] sm:max-w-[130px]">
              {isDev ? 'Dev Scope' : (currentUser?.academyName || currentInstitution.campusName || 'TaleemOS')}
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Live Date / Time (Desktop) */}
          <div className="hidden lg:flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-slate-300 border-l border-white/10 pl-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium">
              <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-400" />
              <span>{formattedDate}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-mono text-indigo-200 bg-white/5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
              <Clock className="w-3 h-3 text-indigo-400" />
              <span>{formattedTime}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Center / Right side: Search, Users, Role, Approvals, Logout */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 sm:gap-2 shrink-0">
          {/* Spotlight Search Trigger */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onOpenSearch}
            title="Search Hub (Ctrl+K)"
            className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 sm:px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/15 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-300" />
            <span className="hidden md:inline">Search</span>
          </button>

          {/* Users Directory Button in Topbar */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onNavigate('users')}
            title="Open Users Directory"
            className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 sm:px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/15 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-200 hover:text-white transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Users className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-300" />
            <span className="hidden md:inline">Users</span>
          </button>

          {/* Developer Direct Link if Developer */}
          {isDev && (
            <button
              onClick={() => onNavigate('developer')}
              title="Open Developer Hub"
              className="hidden lg:flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-600 to-indigo-600 hover:from-purple-500 hover:to-indigo-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold border border-purple-400/40 shadow-sm transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <span>👑 Dev Hub</span>
            </button>
          )}

          {/* User Role Badge */}
          <div
            title={`Active Role: ${roleBadge.label}`}
            className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 sm:py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold ${roleBadge.color}`}
          >
            <span className="text-xs">{roleBadge.icon}</span>
            <span className="hidden lg:inline">{roleBadge.label}</span>
          </div>

          {/* Day / Night Mode Toggle */}

            className="p-1.5 sm:p-2 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-amber-300 hover:text-white rounded-xl border border-white/10 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            {theme === 'dark' ? (
              <Sun className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-300" />
            ) : (
              <Moon className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-300" />
            )}
          </button>

          {/* Approvals Center Bell Trigger */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onOpenApprovals}
            title="Open Approvals Center"
            className="relative p-1.5 sm:p-2 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/15 text-slate-200 hover:text-white rounded-xl border border-white/10 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Bell className="w-4 h-4" />
            {pendingApprovalsCount > 0 && (
              <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 px-1.5 py-0.2 bg-rose-500 text-white font-black text-[10px] rounded-full animate-bounce shadow">
                {pendingApprovalsCount}
              </span>
            )}
          </button>

          {/* Topbar Notices Trigger (Teacher & Admin have equal notice actions) */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onOpenNotices}
            title="Academy Notices & Broadcasts"
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 sm:px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-indigo-600/30 hover:bg-indigo-600/50 text-indigo-200 hover:text-white rounded-xl border border-indigo-400/30 transition-all cursor-pointer relative"
          >
            <Megaphone className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-300" />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline text-xs font-bold">Notices</span>
            {activeNoticesCount > 0 && (
              <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 bg-indigo-500 text-white font-black text-[10px] rounded-full shadow-xs">
                {activeNoticesCount}
              </span>
            )}
          </button>

        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Mobile Dedicated Dev Scope Sub-Bar (Full Width, Never Overflows) */}
      {isDev && (
        <div className="md:hidden px-3 py-1.5 bg-purple-950/80 border-t border-purple-500/30 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs w-full">

            <Building2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-400" />
            <span>Dev Scope:</span>
          </div>
          <select
            value={state.activeInstitutionId}
            onChange={(e) => handleInstitutionChange(e.target.value)}

          >
            <option value="all" className="bg-slate-900 text-purple-300">
              🌐 All Academies (Global Network)
            </option>
            {(activeAcademies.length > 0 ? activeAcademies : INSTITUTIONS).map((inst: any) => (

      )}

      <div className="px-3 sm:px-4 md:px-6 py-2 bg-black/25 border-t border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between overflow-x-auto text-xs whitespace-nowrap gap-4 scrollbar-none touch-scroll w-full">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 sm:gap-6">
          <div
            onClick={() => onNavigate('students')}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity"
          >
            <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 uppercase font-semibold">Students:</span>
            <span className="font-extrabold text-white font-mono">{state.students.length}</span>
            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400" />
          </div>

          <div
            onClick={() => onNavigate('admissions')}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity"
          >
            <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 uppercase font-semibold">Confirmed Adm:</span>
            <span className="font-extrabold text-emerald-300 font-mono">
              {state.admissions.filter((a) => a.status === 'Confirmed').length}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div
            onClick={() => onNavigate('batches')}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity"
          >
            <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 uppercase font-semibold">Active Batches:</span>
            <span className="font-extrabold text-indigo-300 font-mono">
              {state.batches.filter((b) => b.status === 'Active').length}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div
            onClick={() => onNavigate('fees')}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity"
          >
            <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 uppercase font-semibold">October Fee Col:</span>
            <span className="font-extrabold text-amber-300 font-mono">
              PKR{' '}
              {state.fees
                .filter((f) => f.status === 'Paid')
                .reduce((acc, curr) => acc + curr.netPayable, 0)
                .toLocaleString()}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { LogOut } from 'lucide-react';

  deleteUserAccount,
  fetchPendingUsers,
} from '../../lib/academyService';
import { type AppUser } from '../../types';

interface Props {
  currentPath: string;
  setCurrentPath: (p: string) => void;
  isMobileDrawerOpen: boolean;
  setIsMobileDrawerOpen: (v: boolean) => void;
}

interface UserItem {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  role: string;
  institutionId: string;
  institutionName: string;
  status: string;
}

function formatSince(id: string) {
  try {
    const ts = parseInt(id.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 13), 10);
    if (!isNaN(ts) && ts > 1000000000000) {
      const d = new Date(ts);
      const diff = Date.now() - d.getTime();
      const days = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
      if (days === 0) return 'Today';
      if (days === 1) return '1d ago';
      if (days < 30) return `${days}d ago`;
      return d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short' });
    }
  } catch {}
  return 'Recently';
}

    try {
      const u = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taleemos_current_user_v5') || 'null');
      setCurrentUser(u);
      const coll = getLocalUsers();
      setUsers(coll);
    } catch {}
  };

  const syncRemote = async () => {
    try {
      const u = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taleemos_current_user_v5') || 'null');
      if (u) {
        const isDev = u.role === 'developer';
        const acadId = u.academyId || u.institutionId;
        const pending = await fetchPendingUsers(acadId, isDev);
        if (pending && pending.length > 0) {
          setUsers(getLocalUsers());
        }
      }
    } catch {}
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadLocal();
    syncRemote();
    const onStorage = () => loadLocal();
    window.addEventListener('storage', onStorage);
    // Sync Firestore periodically every 15 seconds instead of spamming every 2s
    const interval = setInterval(syncRemote, 15000);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('storage', onStorage);
