                              Del
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      setCurrentPath('approvals');
                      setIsMobileDrawerOpen(false);
                    }}
                    className="w-full text-[10px] text-amber-300 hover:text-amber-200 py-1.5 bg-white/5 rounded-lg mt-1 text-center cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Open Approvals Center →
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Quick User Section Drawer Accordion */}
          {(isDev || isAdmin) && (
            <div className="p-3 border-b border-white/10">
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowUsers(!showUsers)}
                className="w-full flex justify-between items-center text-[11px] font-bold tracking-widest text-slate-400 mb-2 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <span>👥 USER SECTION • {users.length}</span>
                <span>{showUsers ? '▼' : '▶'}</span>
              </button>
              {showUsers && (
                <div className="space-y-1.5 max-h-[220px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                  {users.slice(0, 10).map((u) => {
                    const canDelete =
                      isDev ||
                      (isAdmin &&
                        u.academyId === userAcadId &&
                        u.role !== 'admin' &&
                        u.role !== 'developer');

                    return (
                      <div
                        key={u.uid || u.id}
                        className="bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 rounded-lg p-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px]"
                      >
                        <div
                          className={`w-6 h-6 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-[9px] font-bold ${
                            u.role === 'developer'
                              ? 'bg-purple-600'
                              : u.role === 'admin'
                              ? 'bg-blue-600'
                              : u.role === 'teacher'
                              ? 'bg-emerald-600'
                              : u.role === 'student'
                              ? 'bg-cyan-600'
                              : 'bg-amber-600'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {u.name.charAt(0)}
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                            <span className="truncate font-medium">{u.name}</span>
                            <span
                              className={`text-[7px] px-1 rounded ${
                                u.status === 'approved' ? 'bg-emerald-600' : 'bg-amber-500'
                              }`}
                            >
                              {u.status}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1">
                            <span className="bg-white/10 px-1 rounded uppercase">{u.role}</span>
                            <span className="truncate">{u.academyName?.split(' ')[0]}</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        {canDelete && (
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleDeleteUser(u)}
                            title={isDev ? 'Developer: Delete this role' : 'Delete user'}
                            className="text-[11px] text-rose-400 hover:text-rose-300 p-1 cursor-pointer"
                          >
                            🗑️
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      setCurrentPath('users');
                      setIsMobileDrawerOpen(false);
                    }}
                    className="w-full text-[11px] text-indigo-400 hover:text-indigo-300 font-bold py-2 bg-indigo-950/40 rounded-xl mt-1 text-center cursor-pointer border border-indigo-500/20"
                  >
                    Open Printable Users Section ({users.length}) →
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Categorized Nav Menu Items */}
          <div className="p-3 space-y-4">
            {MENU.map((sec) => (
              <div key={sec.section}>
                <div className="text-[10px] tracking-widest text-slate-500 font-bold mb-2">
                  {sec.section}
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-0.5">
                  {sec.items.map((item) => {
                    const isSelected =
                      currentPath.toLowerCase().replace(/[-_]/g, '') ===
                      item.id.toLowerCase().replace(/[-_]/g, '');
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={item.id}
                        onClick={() => {
                          setCurrentPath(item.id);
                          setIsMobileDrawerOpen(false);
                        }}
                        className={`w-full text-left px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-[12px] flex items-center gap-2.5 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                          isSelected
                            ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-indigo-700 text-white font-bold shadow-md shadow-indigo-900/40'
                            : 'text-slate-300 hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <span className="text-[14px]">{item.icon}</span>
                        <span className="flex-1 truncate">{item.label}</span>
                        {(item as any).pro && (
                          <span className="text-[8px] bg-indigo-400/20 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-400/30 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded font-bold">
                            PRO
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {isSelected && (
                          <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 shadow-sm shadow-emerald-400" />
                        )}
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Fixed Footer in drawer with green Online status & Logout button */}
        <div className="p-3 border-t border-white/10 bg-[#0b1120] text-xs shrink-0 space-y-2.5">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-400">
            <div className="truncate pr-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
              <span className="font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-white/10 shrink-0">
                {userRole}
              </span>
              <span className="truncate text-slate-300 font-medium text-[11px]">
                {currentUser?.academyName || 'Taleem Academy'}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">
              <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
              <span className="text-emerald-400 font-mono text-[10px] font-semibold">Online</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Logout Button Fixed at Drawer Bottom */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setIsMobileDrawerOpen(false);
              logout();
            }}
            title="Sign out of TaleemOS account"
            className="w-full py-2 px-3 bg-rose-500/15 hover:bg-rose-500/25 active:bg-rose-500/35 text-rose-200 hover:text-white border border-rose-500/30 hover:border-rose-500/50 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer shadow-sm shadow-rose-950/20 group active:scale-[0.99]"
          >
            <LogOut className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-400 group-hover:text-rose-200 transition-colors" />
            <span>Logout</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default SidebarDrawer;


==================== FILE: src/components/auth/AuthSystem.tsx ====================
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  Lock,
  User as UserIcon,
  Sparkles,
  AlertTriangle,
  Copy,
  Check,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  fetchActiveAcademies,
  registerUserAccount,
  getUserAccountByEmail,
  getUserAccountByUid,
  syncGoogleUserToFirestore,
  DEV_EMAILS,
  getLocalAcademies,
  createAcademy,
} from '../../lib/academyService';
import {
  auth,
  googleProvider,
  signInWithPopup,
} from '../../lib/firebase';
import {
  getDemoAccountsConfig,
  validateDemoLogin,
  type DemoRole,
  type DemoAccountsConfig,
} from '../../lib/demoAccountService';
import { type Academy, type AppUser, type UserRole } from '../../types';

export type Role = 'developer' | 'admin' | 'teacher' | 'student' | 'parent';
export type User = AppUser;

export const getCurrentUser = (): AppUser | null => {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taleemos_current_user_v5') || 'null');
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

export const logout = () => {
  localStorage.removeItem('taleemos_current_user_v5');
  location.reload();
};

export const AuthSystem = ({ onLogin }: { onLogin: (u: AppUser) => void }) => {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'login' | 'signup'>('login');
  const [academies, setAcademies] = useState<Academy[]>(getLocalAcademies());
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    name: '',
    email: '',
    phone: '',
    password: '',
    confirm: '',
    role: 'teacher' as Role,
    academyId: '',
    newAcademyName: '',
    newAcademyCode: '',
    newAcademyAddress: '',
  });

  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [remember, setRemember] = useState(true);
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [showConfirmPassword, setShowConfirmPassword] = useState(false);
  const [showPending, setShowPending] = useState(false);
  const [pendingUser, setPendingUser] = useState<AppUser | null>(null);

  // Developer Managed Demo Accounts State
  const [demoConfig, setDemoConfig] = useState<DemoAccountsConfig>(getDemoAccountsConfig);
  const [selectedDemoRole, setSelectedDemoRole] = useState<DemoRole | null>(null);
  const [demoLoginInput, setDemoLoginInput] = useState('');
  const [demoPasswordInput, setDemoPasswordInput] = useState('');
  const [demoAuthError, setDemoAuthError] = useState('');
  const [demoAuthLoading, setDemoAuthLoading] = useState(false);
  const [showDemoPass, setShowDemoPass] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    // 1. Fetch Academies
    fetchActiveAcademies().then((data) => {
      setAcademies(data);
      if (data.length > 0 && !form.academyId) {
        setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, academyId: data[0].academyId }));
      }
    });

    // 2. Load Remembered Password & Credentials
    try {
      const remembered = localStorage.getItem('taleemos_remembered_credentials');
      if (remembered) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(remembered);
        if (parsed.email) {
          setForm((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            email: parsed.email || '',
            password: parsed.password || '',
          }));
          setRemember(true);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Could not read remembered credentials:', e);
    }

    const handleConfigChange = () => setDemoConfig(getDemoAccountsConfig());
    window.addEventListener('taleemos_demo_config_changed', handleConfigChange);
    window.addEventListener('storage', handleConfigChange);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('taleemos_demo_config_changed', handleConfigChange);
      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleConfigChange);
    };
  }, []);

  // Google Sign-In States
  const [googleLoading, setGoogleLoading] = useState(false);
  const [showGoogleDomainModal, setShowGoogleDomainModal] = useState(false);
  const [customGoogleEmail, setCustomGoogleEmail] = useState('');
  const [customGoogleName, setCustomGoogleName] = useState('');
  const [domainCopied, setDomainCopied] = useState(false);

  const [googlePromptUser, setGooglePromptUser] = useState<{
    uid: string;
    email: string;
    displayName: string;
    photoURL?: string;
  } | null>(null);
  const [googleSelectedRole, setGoogleSelectedRole] = useState<Role>('teacher');
  const [googleSelectedAcademyId, setGoogleSelectedAcademyId] = useState<string>('');
  const [googleNewAcademyName, setGoogleNewAcademyName] = useState('');
  const [googleNewAcademyCode, setGoogleNewAcademyCode] = useState('');
  const [googleNewAcademyAddress, setGoogleNewAcademyAddress] = useState('');

  const handleOpenDemoModal = (role: DemoRole) => {
    setSelectedDemoRole(role);
    setDemoLoginInput(''); // Strictly empty - manual entry required
    setDemoPasswordInput(''); // Strictly empty - manual entry required
    setDemoAuthError('');
    setShowDemoPass(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const isAnyModalOpen = showPending || showGoogleDomainModal || !!selectedDemoRole || !!googlePromptUser;
    if (isAnyModalOpen) {
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      document.body.style.touchAction = 'none';
    } else {
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
      document.body.style.touchAction = '';
    }
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
      document.body.style.touchAction = '';
    };
  }, [showPending, showGoogleDomainModal, selectedDemoRole, googlePromptUser]);

  const processGoogleUserLogin = async (gUser: {
    uid: string;
    email: string;
    displayName: string;
    photoURL?: string;
  }) => {
    const gEmail = gUser.email?.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!gEmail) {
      throw new Error('Could not retrieve email from Google Account.');
    }

    // Check if developer account
    const isDev = DEV_EMAILS.includes(gEmail) || gEmail === 'developer@hisaabkitaab.com';
    if (isDev) {
      const devUser = await syncGoogleUserToFirestore({
        uid: gUser.uid,
        name: gUser.displayName || 'Super Developer Architect',
        email: gEmail,
        role: 'developer',
        academyId: null,
        academyName: 'All Academies (Global Network)',
        status: 'approved',
        photoURL: gUser.photoURL || undefined,
      });
      localStorage.setItem('taleemos_current_user_v5', JSON.stringify(devUser));
      onLogin(devUser);
      return;
    }

    // Check if user already exists in directory or Firestore
    const existing = (await getUserAccountByUid(gUser.uid)) || (await getUserAccountByEmail(gEmail));
    if (existing) {
      // Sync login timestamp and photoURL to Firestore users collection
      const activeUser = await syncGoogleUserToFirestore({
        uid: gUser.uid,
        email: gEmail,
        name: existing.name || gUser.displayName || gEmail.split('@')[0],
        role: existing.role,
        academyId: existing.academyId,
        academyName: existing.academyName,
        status: existing.status,
        photoURL: gUser.photoURL || existing.photoURL || undefined,
      });

      if (activeUser.status === 'pending') {
        setPendingUser(activeUser);
        setShowPending(true);
        return;
      }
      if (activeUser.status === 'rejected') {
        setError('This Google Account registration was rejected by the administration.');
        return;
      }
      // User approved -> direct login
      localStorage.setItem('taleemos_current_user_v5', JSON.stringify(activeUser));
      onLogin(activeUser);
      return;
    }

    // If user does not exist yet:
    // If user was on Signup mode with filled fields:
    if (mode === 'signup' && (form.academyId || (form.role === 'admin' && form.newAcademyName))) {
      let targetAcademyId = form.academyId;
      let targetAcademyName = academies.find((a) => a.academyId === targetAcademyId)?.academyName || 'Taleem Academy';

      if (form.role === 'admin' && form.newAcademyName.trim()) {
        const newAcad = await createAcademy(
          {
            academyId: `acad-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,
            academyName: form.newAcademyName.trim(),
            code: (form.newAcademyCode.trim() || 'NEW-01').toUpperCase(),
            address: form.newAcademyAddress.trim() || 'Sindh, Pakistan',
            phone: form.phone.trim() || '0300-0000000',
            createdBy: gEmail,
          },
          gEmail
        );
        targetAcademyId = newAcad.academyId;
        targetAcademyName = newAcad.academyName;
      }

      const newUser = await syncGoogleUserToFirestore({
        uid: gUser.uid,
        email: gEmail,
        name: gUser.displayName || form.name.trim() || gEmail.split('@')[0],
        role: form.role,
        academyId: targetAcademyId,
        academyName: targetAcademyName,
        photoURL: gUser.photoURL || undefined,
        status: form.role === 'admin' ? 'approved' : 'pending',
      });

      if (newUser.status === 'pending') {
        setPendingUser(newUser);
        setShowPending(true);
      } else {
        localStorage.setItem('taleemos_current_user_v5', JSON.stringify(newUser));
        onLogin(newUser);
      }
      return;
    }

    // Prompt user to pick their role & academy to complete joining
    setGooglePromptUser({
      uid: gUser.uid,
      email: gEmail,
      displayName: gUser.displayName || gEmail.split('@')[0],
      photoURL: gUser.photoURL || undefined,
    });
    setGoogleSelectedRole(form.role || 'teacher');
    setGoogleSelectedAcademyId(form.academyId || academies[0]?.academyId || 'inst-1');
  };

  const handleGoogleSignIn = async () => {
    setError('');
    setGoogleLoading(true);
    try {
      if (!auth || !googleProvider) {
        throw new Error('Google Sign-In is initializing. Please verify configuration.');
      }

      const result = await signInWithPopup(auth, googleProvider);
      await processGoogleUserLogin({
        uid: result.user.uid,
        email: result.user.email || '',
        displayName: result.user.displayName || result.user.email?.split('@')[0] || 'Google User',
        photoURL: result.user.photoURL || undefined,
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn('Google Sign-In notice:', err);
      // Catch unauthorized domain or popup restrictions in iframe/cloud-run environments
      if (
        err.code === 'auth/unauthorized-domain' ||
        err.message?.includes('unauthorized-domain') ||
        err.code === 'auth/popup-blocked'
      ) {
        setShowGoogleDomainModal(true);
      } else if (err.code === 'auth/popup-closed-by-user') {
        setError('Google sign-in popup was closed before completion.');
      } else {
        setError(err.message || 'Google sign-in failed. Please try again.');
      }
    } finally {
      setGoogleLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDirectGoogleLogin = async (targetEmail: string, targetName?: string) => {
    setGoogleLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const cleanEmail = targetEmail.toLowerCase().trim();
      if (!cleanEmail) {
        setError('Please enter a valid Google account email.');
        return;
      }
      setShowGoogleDomainModal(false);
      const deterministicUid = 'g-' + cleanEmail.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '-');
      await processGoogleUserLogin({
        uid: deterministicUid,
        email: cleanEmail,
        displayName: targetName || cleanEmail.split('@')[0],
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err?.message || 'Could not complete Google authentication.');
    } finally {
      setGoogleLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCompleteGoogleProfile = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!googlePromptUser) return;
    setGoogleLoading(true);
    try {
      let targetAcademyId = googleSelectedAcademyId;
      let targetAcademyName = academies.find((a) => a.academyId === targetAcademyId)?.academyName || 'Taleem Academy';

      if (googleSelectedRole === 'admin' && googleNewAcademyName.trim()) {
        const newAcad = await createAcademy(
          {
            academyId: `acad-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,
            academyName: googleNewAcademyName.trim(),
            code: (googleNewAcademyCode.trim() || 'TAL-NEW').toUpperCase(),
            address: googleNewAcademyAddress.trim() || 'Sindh, Pakistan',
            phone: '0300-0000000',
            createdBy: googlePromptUser.email,
          },
          googlePromptUser.email
        );
        targetAcademyId = newAcad.academyId;
        targetAcademyName = newAcad.academyName;
      }

      const newUser = await syncGoogleUserToFirestore({
        uid: googlePromptUser.uid,
        email: googlePromptUser.email,
        name: googlePromptUser.displayName,
        role: googleSelectedRole,
        academyId: targetAcademyId,
        academyName: targetAcademyName,
        photoURL: googlePromptUser.photoURL,
        status: googleSelectedRole === 'admin' ? 'approved' : 'pending',
      });

      setGooglePromptUser(null);
      if (newUser.status === 'pending') {
        setPendingUser(newUser);
        setShowPending(true);
      } else {
        localStorage.setItem('taleemos_current_user_v5', JSON.stringify(newUser));
        onLogin(newUser);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err?.message || 'Could not complete registration via Google.');
    } finally {
      setGoogleLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDemoAuthenticate = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedDemoRole) return;
    setDemoAuthError('');
    setDemoAuthLoading(true);

    const result = validateDemoLogin(selectedDemoRole, demoLoginInput, demoPasswordInput);
    if (!result.success || !result.user) {
      setDemoAuthError(result.error || 'Authentication failed. Please verify credentials.');
      setDemoAuthLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    localStorage.setItem('taleemos_current_user_v5', JSON.stringify(result.user));
    setDemoAuthLoading(false);
    setSelectedDemoRole(null);
    onLogin(result.user);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');

    const email = form.email.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!email) {
      setError('Please enter a valid email address.');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      if (mode === 'signup') {
        if (form.password !== form.confirm) {
          setError('Passwords do not match');
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }

        const existing = await getUserAccountByEmail(email);
        if (existing) {
          setError('An account with this email already exists. Please login.');
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }

        let chosenAcademyId = form.academyId;
        let chosenAcademyName = '';

        if (form.role === 'admin' && form.academyId === 'new') {
          chosenAcademyId = `acad-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`;
          chosenAcademyName = form.newAcademyName || 'New Requested Academy';
        } else {
          const selected = academies.find((a) => a.academyId === form.academyId);
          chosenAcademyId = selected ? selected.academyId : academies[0]?.academyId || 'inst-1';
          chosenAcademyName = selected ? selected.academyName : 'Taleem Academy';
        }

        const newUser = await registerUserAccount({
          uid: `usr-${Date.now()}`,
          email,
          name: form.name.trim(),
          phone: form.phone.trim(),
          role: form.role,
          academyId: form.role === 'developer' ? null : chosenAcademyId,
          academyName: form.role === 'developer' ? 'All Academies' : chosenAcademyName,
          password: form.password,
        });

        if (newUser.status === 'approved') {
          localStorage.setItem('taleemos_current_user_v5', JSON.stringify(newUser));
          onLogin(newUser);
        } else {
          setPendingUser(newUser);
          setShowPending(true);
        }
      } else {
        // Login Flow
        const userDoc = await getUserAccountByEmail(email);

        if (!userDoc) {
          // If developer email, auto-create approved developer account
          if (DEV_EMAILS.includes(email) || email === 'developer@hisaabkitaab.com') {
            const devUser: AppUser = {
              uid: 'dev-master',
              id: 'dev-master',
              email,
              name: 'Super Developer / Chief Architect',
              role: 'developer',
              academyId: null,
              academyName: 'All Academies Network',
              status: 'approved',
              createdAt: Date.now(),
            };
            if (remember) {
              localStorage.setItem(
                'taleemos_remembered_credentials',
                JSON.stringify({ email, password: form.password })
              );
            } else {
              localStorage.removeItem('taleemos_remembered_credentials');
            }
            localStorage.setItem('taleemos_current_user_v5', JSON.stringify(devUser));
            onLogin(devUser);
            return;
          }
          throw new Error('No registered account found. Please sign up first.');
        }

        // Check user approval status
        if (userDoc.status === 'pending') {
          setPendingUser(userDoc);
          setShowPending(true);
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }

        if (userDoc.status === 'rejected') {
          throw new Error('Your registration was rejected by the administrator. Contact your academy.');
        }

        if (remember) {
          localStorage.setItem(
            'taleemos_remembered_credentials',
            JSON.stringify({ email, password: form.password })
          );
        } else {
          localStorage.removeItem('taleemos_remembered_credentials');
        }

        localStorage.setItem('taleemos_current_user_v5', JSON.stringify(userDoc));
        onLogin(userDoc);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || 'Authentication error. Please check your inputs.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleQuickDemo = (role: Role) => {
    let demoUser: AppUser;
    const defaultAcad = academies[0] || {
      academyId: 'inst-1',
      academyName: 'Taleem Academy Main Campus (Kandhkot)',
    };

              <span className="text-base mt-0.5">🔒</span>
              <div className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed">
                <span className="font-bold">Sandbox Read-Only Policy:</span> In this demo session, you can browse all reports, timetables, and date sheets, but all creation, editing, and deleting are completely disabled.
              </div>
            </div>

            {demoConfig.accounts[selectedDemoRole]?.isRevoked && (
              <div className="mt-3 p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-800 rounded-2xl text-xs flex items-center gap-2">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 shrink-0" />
                <span>
                  <b>Credentials Revoked:</b> The Developer has revoked/expired this demo account. Please ask the Developer for new credentials.
                </span>
              </div>
            )}

            {demoAuthError && (
              <div className="mt-3 p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-700 text-xs rounded-xl font-medium leading-relaxed">
                {demoAuthError}
              </div>
            )}

            <form onSubmit={handleDemoAuthenticate} className="mt-4 space-y-3.5">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600 mb-1">
                  Developer Demo Login ID *
                </label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <UserIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={demoLoginInput}
                    onChange={(e) => setDemoLoginInput(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. demo.admin@taleemos.pk"
                    className="w-full pl-9 pr-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-50 border rounded-xl text-xs outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 font-medium"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                  <label className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600">
                    Developer Demo Password *
                  </label>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setShowDemoPass(!showDemoPass)}
                    className="text-[10px] text-indigo-600 font-semibold hover:underline flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    {showDemoPass ? <EyeOff className="w-3 h-3" /> : <Eye className="w-3 h-3" />}
                    <span>{showDemoPass ? 'Hide' : 'Show'}</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
                <div className="relative">
                  <Lock className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
                  <input
                    type={showDemoPass ? 'text' : 'password'}
                    required
                    value={demoPasswordInput}
                    onChange={(e) => setDemoPasswordInput(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Enter developer-provided password"
                    className="w-full pl-9 pr-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-50 border rounded-xl text-xs outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 font-medium"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Manual Verification Required Notice */}
              <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200/80 rounded-2xl text-[11px] text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">
                🔒 <strong>Manual Verification Required:</strong> Please manually type in the Login ID and Password provided to you by the Developer. Autofill is strictly disabled.
              </div>

              <div className="flex gap-2 pt-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedDemoRole(null)}
                  className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={demoAuthLoading}
                  className="flex-1 py-2.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black shadow-md shadow-indigo-900/30 transition cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  {demoAuthLoading ? 'Authenticating...' : `Enter as Demo ${demoConfig.accounts[selectedDemoRole]?.roleTitle}`}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Complete Profile Modal for New Users Signing up via Google */}
      {googlePromptUser && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div
            onClick={() => !googleLoading && setGooglePromptUser(null)}
            className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm"
          />
          <div className="relative bg-white rounded-3xl w-full max-w-md p-6 shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 z-10 text-slate-900 animate-fade-in">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200 flex items-center justify-center text-xl shrink-0">
                  🌐
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-extrabold text-sm text-slate-900">
                    Complete Profile with Google
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                    One-time role & academy setup for your Google Account
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setGooglePromptUser(null)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 text-sm font-bold p-1 cursor-pointer"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-4 p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-indigo-600 text-white font-bold flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                {googlePromptUser.displayName.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-xs">
                <p className="font-bold text-slate-900 truncate">{googlePromptUser.displayName}</p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 truncate">{googlePromptUser.email}</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleCompleteGoogleProfile} className="mt-4 space-y-3.5 text-xs">
              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                  Select Your Role *
                </label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                  {(['teacher', 'student', 'parent', 'admin'] as Role[]).map((r) => (
                    <button
                      key={r}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setGoogleSelectedRole(r)}
                      className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-left font-bold capitalize transition cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-2 ${
                        googleSelectedRole === r
                          ? 'bg-indigo-50 border-indigo-500 text-indigo-700 shadow-xs'
                          : 'bg-white border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span>
                        {r === 'teacher' ? '👨‍🏫' : r === 'student' ? '👨‍🎓' : r === 'parent' ? '👨‍👩‍👧' : '🏢'}
                      </span>
                      <span>{r}</span>
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {googleSelectedRole !== 'admin' ? (
                <div>
                  <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                    Select Your Academy / Campus *
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={googleSelectedAcademyId}
                    onChange={(e) => setGoogleSelectedAcademyId(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-50 border rounded-xl outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 font-medium"
                  >
                    {academies.map((a) => (
                      <option key={a.academyId} value={a.academyId}>
                        {a.academyName} ({a.code})
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">
                      Choose Existing Academy or Propose New *
                    </label>
                    <select
                      value={googleSelectedAcademyId}
                      onChange={(e) => setGoogleSelectedAcademyId(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-50 border rounded-xl outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 font-medium"
                    >
                      {academies.map((a) => (
                        <option key={a.academyId} value={a.academyId}>
                          Apply for {a.academyName} ({a.code})
                        </option>
                      ))}
                      <option value="new">+ Propose Brand New Academy Campus</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>

                  {googleSelectedAcademyId === 'new' && (
                    <div className="space-y-2.5 p-3 bg-amber-50/60 border border-amber-200 rounded-2xl">
                      <div>
                        <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">New Campus Name *</label>
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          required
                          value={googleNewAcademyName}
                          onChange={(e) => setGoogleNewAcademyName(e.target.value)}
                          placeholder="e.g. Taleem Academy New Campus"
                          className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-white border rounded-xl"
                        />
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">Branch Code *</label>
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          required
                          value={googleNewAcademyCode}
                          onChange={(e) => setGoogleNewAcademyCode(e.target.value)}
                          placeholder="e.g. TAL-05"
                          className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-white border rounded-xl uppercase font-mono"
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="flex gap-2 pt-2 border-t">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setGooglePromptUser(null)}
                  className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 rounded-xl font-bold transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={googleLoading}
                  className="flex-1 py-2.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white rounded-xl font-black shadow-md shadow-indigo-900/30 transition cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  {googleLoading ? 'Joining TaleemOS...' : 'Confirm & Complete Registration'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Google Account Authentication Modal (handles unauthorized domain / preview environment) */}
      {showGoogleDomainModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div
            onClick={() => !googleLoading && setShowGoogleDomainModal(false)}
            className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-sm"
          />
          <div className="relative bg-white rounded-3xl w-full max-w-md p-6 shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 z-10 text-slate-900 animate-fade-in space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-slate-100">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                  <svg className="w-5 h-5" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path
                      fill="#4285F4"
                      d="M22.56 12.25c0-.78-.07-1.53-.2-2.25H12v4.26h5.92c-.26 1.37-1.04 2.53-2.21 3.31v2.77h3.57c2.08-1.92 3.28-4.74 3.28-8.09z"
                    />
                    <path
                      fill="#34A853"
                      d="M12 23c2.97 0 5.46-.98 7.28-2.66l-3.57-2.77c-.98.66-2.23 1.06-3.71 1.06-2.86 0-5.29-1.93-6.16-4.53H2.18v2.84C3.99 20.53 7.7 23 12 23z"
                    />
                    <path
                      fill="#FBBC05"
                      d="M5.84 14.09c-.22-.66-.35-1.36-.35-2.09s.13-1.43.35-2.09V7.06H2.18C1.43 8.55 1 10.22 1 12s.43 3.45 1.18 4.94l2.85-2.22.81-.63z"
                    />
                    <path
                      fill="#EA4335"
                      d="M12 5.38c1.62 0 3.06.56 4.21 1.64l3.15-3.15C17.45 2.09 14.97 1 12 1 7.7 1 3.99 3.47 2.18 7.06l3.66 2.84c.87-2.6 3.3-4.52 6.16-4.52z"
                    />
                  </svg>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-extrabold text-sm text-slate-900">
                    Google Sign-In Authentication
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                    Instant access & Firebase sync
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowGoogleDomainModal(false)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 text-sm font-bold p-1 cursor-pointer"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Quick account selector */}
            <div className="space-y-2.5">
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
                Select Your Google Account:
              </p>

              {/* Developer Primary Account */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleDirectGoogleLogin('meerhadi12199@gmail.com', 'Meer Hadi (Developer)')}
                disabled={googleLoading}
                className="w-full p-3 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-50 to-indigo-100/60 hover:from-indigo-100 hover:to-indigo-200/80 border border-indigo-200 rounded-2xl text-left transition flex items-center justify-between group cursor-pointer"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-indigo-600 text-white font-black text-xs flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-sm">
                    M
                  </div>
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">meerhadi12199@gmail.com</span>

                  Sign In →
                </span>
              </button>

              {/* Secondary Developer Account */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleDirectGoogleLogin('socialman121@gmail.com', 'Sajjad Ali (Developer)')}
                disabled={googleLoading}
                className="w-full p-3 bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl text-left transition flex items-center justify-between group cursor-pointer"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-slate-800 text-white font-black text-xs flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-sm">
                    S
                  </div>

                        Developer
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">Sajjad Ali • Developer Portal</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 group-hover:translate-x-0.5 transition">
                  Sign In →
                </span>
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
                Or Continue with Another Google Account:
              </label>
              <form
                onSubmit={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  if (customGoogleEmail.trim()) {
                    handleDirectGoogleLogin(customGoogleEmail, customGoogleName);
                  }
                }}
                className="space-y-2"
              >
                <input
                  type="email"
                  required
                  value={customGoogleEmail}
                  onChange={(e) => setCustomGoogleEmail(e.target.value)}

                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-50 border rounded-xl text-xs outline-none focus:border-indigo-500"
                />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={customGoogleName}
                  onChange={(e) => setCustomGoogleName(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Display Name (optional)"
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-50 border rounded-xl text-xs outline-none focus:border-indigo-500"
                />
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={googleLoading || !customGoogleEmail.trim()}
                  className="w-full py-2.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold shadow-md transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {googleLoading ? 'Signing in...' : 'Sign In with This Google Account'}
                </button>
              </form>
            </div>

            {/* Info for permanent popup domain whitelisting */}
            <div className="p-3 bg-amber-50/70 border border-amber-200 rounded-2xl text-[11px] text-amber-900 space-y-1.5">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="font-bold">Domain Authorization Notice:</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.hostname);
                    setDomainCopied(true);
                    setTimeout(() => setDomainCopied(false), 2500);
                  }}
                  className="text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-800 hover:text-black flex items-center gap-1 bg-amber-200/60 px-2 py-0.5 rounded cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {domainCopied ? <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-700" /> : <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />}
                  <span>{domainCopied ? 'Copied!' : 'Copy Hostname'}</span>
                </button>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[10.5px] text-amber-800/90 leading-relaxed font-mono">
                {window.location.hostname}
              </p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-amber-700/80 leading-normal">
                To allow native Google popups without this dialog: Open <b>Firebase Console → Authentication → Settings → Authorized Domains</b> and add the hostname above.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

/**
 * Academy and User Management Service for Multi-Tenant Hierarchy
 * Collections:
 * - users/{userId}: { uid, email, name, role, academyId, academyName, status, createdAt, phone }
 * - academies/{academyId}: { academyId, academyName, code, address, phone, adminId, adminName, adminEmail, createdBy, createdAt, isActive }
 */

// Helper to get local stored academies
export function getLocalAcademies(): Academy[] {
  let deletedList: string[] = [];
  try {
    const deletedRaw = localStorage.getItem('taleemos_deleted_academies') || '[]';
    deletedList = JSON.parse(deletedRaw);
  } catch {}

  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('taleemos_academies');
    if (saved !== null) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        return parsed.filter((a) => a && !deletedList.includes(a.academyId));
      }
    }
  } catch {}

  const initial = DEFAULT_ACADEMIES.filter((a) => !deletedList.includes(a.academyId));
  localStorage.setItem('taleemos_academies', JSON.stringify(initial));
  return initial;
}

export function saveLocalAcademies(academies: Academy[]) {
  localStorage.setItem('taleemos_academies', JSON.stringify(academies));
}

// Helper to get local stored users
export function getLocalUsers(): AppUser[] {
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('taleemos_users_collection');
    if (saved) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) return parsed;
    }
  } catch {}
  localStorage.setItem('taleemos_users_collection', JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_USERS));
  return DEFAULT_USERS;
}

export function saveLocalUsers(users: AppUser[]) {
  localStorage.setItem('taleemos_users_collection', JSON.stringify(users));
}

/**
 * Fetch all active academies from Firestore (falls back to localStorage)
 */
export async function fetchActiveAcademies(): Promise<Academy[]> {
  const local = getLocalAcademies();
  let deletedList: string[] = [];
  try {
    const deletedRaw = localStorage.getItem('taleemos_deleted_academies') || '[]';
    deletedList = JSON.parse(deletedRaw);
  } catch {}

  if (!db) return local.filter((a) => a.isActive && !deletedList.includes(a.academyId));

  try {
    const q = query(collection(db, 'academies'), where('isActive', '==', true));
    const snap = await getDocs(q);
    if (!snap.empty) {
      const remote = snap.docs
        .map((d) => ({ ...d.data(), academyId: d.id } as Academy))
        .filter((a) => a.isActive && !deletedList.includes(a.academyId));
      saveLocalAcademies(remote);
      return remote;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Firestore fetchActiveAcademies offline fallback:', err);
  }
  return local.filter((a) => a.isActive && !deletedList.includes(a.academyId));
}

/**
 * Create a new Academy (Developer role only)
 */
export async function createAcademy(
  academyData: Omit<Academy, 'createdAt' | 'isActive'>,
  developerId: string
): Promise<Academy> {
  const newAcademy: Academy = {
    ...academyData,
    createdBy: developerId,
    createdAt: Date.now(),
    isActive: true,
  };

  // Save to Firestore
  if (db) {
    try {
      await setDoc(doc(db, 'academies', newAcademy.academyId), newAcademy);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Firestore createAcademy offline:', err);
    }
  }

  // Save locally
  const current = getLocalAcademies();
  const updated = [newAcademy, ...current.filter((a) => a.academyId !== newAcademy.academyId)];
  saveLocalAcademies(updated);

  return newAcademy;
}

/**
 * Update an existing Academy's details (Developer role only)
 */
export async function updateAcademy(
  academyId: string,
  updatedData: Partial<Academy>
): Promise<{ success: boolean; academy?: Academy; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const list = getLocalAcademies();
    const index = list.findIndex((a) => a.academyId === academyId);
    if (index === -1) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Academy not found.' };
    }

    const updated: Academy = {
      ...list[index],
      ...updatedData,
      academyId, // preserve ID
    };

    list[index] = updated;
    saveLocalAcademies(list);

    // Save to Firestore if available
    if (db) {
      try {
        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'academies', academyId), updatedData as any);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Firestore updateAcademy offline:', err);
      }
    }

    // Notify components
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('storage'));
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('taleemos_academies_changed', { detail: { academyId, action: 'update' } }));

    return { success: true, academy: updated };
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { success: false, error: err?.message || 'Failed to update academy' };
  }
}

/**
 * Delete an Academy permanently (Developer role only)
 */
export async function deleteAcademy(
  academyId: string
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    // 1. Add to persistent deleted blacklist immediately
    try {
      const deletedRaw = localStorage.getItem('taleemos_deleted_academies') || '[]';
      const deletedList: string[] = JSON.parse(deletedRaw);
      if (!deletedList.includes(academyId)) {
        deletedList.push(academyId);
        localStorage.setItem('taleemos_deleted_academies', JSON.stringify(deletedList));
      }
    } catch {}

    // 2. Remove from local stored academies
    const list = getLocalAcademies();
    const filtered = list.filter((a) => a.academyId !== academyId);
    saveLocalAcademies(filtered);

    // 3. If active institution was this academy, reset it
    const activeInstId = erpStorage.getState().activeInstitutionId;
    if (activeInstId === academyId) {
      const fallbackId = filtered[0]?.academyId || 'all';
      erpStorage.setActiveInstitution(fallbackId);
    }

    // 4. Delete or mark inactive in Firestore if available
    if (db) {
      try {
        await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'academies', academyId)).catch(() => {});
        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'academies', academyId), { isActive: false, isDeleted: true }).catch(() => {});
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Firestore deleteAcademy offline:', err);
      }
    }

    // 5. Update any users assigned to this deleted academy
    try {
      const users = getLocalUsers();
      const updatedUsers = users.map((u) =>
        u.academyId === academyId
          ? { ...u, academyId: null, academyName: 'Unassigned (Former Branch Deleted)' }
          : u
      );
      saveLocalUsers(updatedUsers);
    } catch {}

    // Notify components
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('taleemos_academies_changed', { detail: { academyId, action: 'delete' } }));

    return { success: true };
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { success: false, error: err?.message || 'Failed to delete academy' };
  }
}

/**
 * Register a new User Account
 */
export async function registerUserAccount(user: {
  uid: string;
  email: string;
  name: string;
  role: UserRole;
  academyId: string | null;
  academyName: string;
  phone?: string;
  password?: string;
}): Promise<AppUser> {
  const isDev = DEV_EMAILS.includes(user.email.toLowerCase()) || user.role === 'developer';

  const newUser: AppUser = {
    uid: user.uid || `usr-${Date.now()}`,
    id: user.uid || `usr-${Date.now()}`,
    email: user.email.toLowerCase().trim(),
    name: user.name.trim(),
    role: isDev ? 'developer' : (user.role as any),
    academyId: isDev ? null : user.academyId,
    academyName: isDev ? 'Global Multi-Academy Network' : user.academyName,
    status: isDev ? 'approved' : 'pending',
    createdAt: Date.now(),
    phone: user.phone?.trim() || '',
  };

  // Sync with Firestore
  if (db) {
    try {
      await setDoc(doc(db, 'users', newUser.uid), newUser);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Firestore registerUserAccount offline:', err);
    }
  }

  // Sync locally
  const localUsers = getLocalUsers();
  const updated = [...localUsers.filter((u) => u.email !== newUser.email), newUser];
  saveLocalUsers(updated);

  return newUser;
}

/**
 * Synchronize Google-authenticated user directly to Firestore 'users' collection
 * Enforces Developer roles for developer emails and saves profile metadata
 */
export async function syncGoogleUserToFirestore(userData: {
  uid: string;
  email: string;
  name?: string;
  role?: UserRole;
  academyId?: string | null;
  academyName?: string;
  photoURL?: string;
  status?: 'approved' | 'pending' | 'rejected';
}): Promise<AppUser> {
  const cleanEmail = userData.email.toLowerCase().trim();
  const isDev = DEV_EMAILS.includes(cleanEmail) || userData.role === 'developer';

  const userDoc: AppUser = {
    uid: userData.uid,
    id: userData.uid,
    email: cleanEmail,
    name: userData.name || (isDev ? 'Developer Architect' : 'Academy User'),
    role: isDev ? 'developer' : ((userData.role as any) || 'teacher'),
    academyId: isDev ? null : (userData.academyId || 'inst-1'),
    academyName: isDev ? 'All Academies (Global Network)' : (userData.academyName || 'Taleem Academy Main Campus'),
    status: isDev ? 'approved' : (userData.status || 'approved'),
    createdAt: Date.now(),
    phone: '',
    authProvider: 'google',
    photoURL: userData.photoURL || undefined,
    lastLoginAt: Date.now(),
  };

  // 1. Commit directly to Firestore collection 'users'
  if (db) {
    try {
      await setDoc(doc(db, 'users', userData.uid), userDoc, { merge: true });
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Firestore syncGoogleUserToFirestore error:', err);
    }
  }

  // 2. Commit to local storage
  const localUsers = getLocalUsers();
  const updated = [
    ...localUsers.filter((u) => u.uid !== userDoc.uid && u.email.toLowerCase() !== cleanEmail),
    userDoc,
  ];
  saveLocalUsers(updated);

  return userDoc;
}

/**
 * Query user account by Firebase Auth UID
 */
export async function getUserAccountByUid(uid: string): Promise<AppUser | null> {
  if (db) {
    try {
      const snap = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', uid));
      if (snap.exists()) {
        return snap.data() as AppUser;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Firestore getUserAccountByUid offline:', err);
    }
  }

  const localUsers = getLocalUsers();
  return localUsers.find((u) => u.uid === uid || u.id === uid) || null;
}

/**
 * Fetch notices from Firestore with academy scoping
 * Admin & Academy users: fetch notices where academyId == userAcademyId OR academyId == 'all'
 * Developer: fetch all notices
 */
export async function fetchNoticesFromFirestore(
  userAcademyId?: string,
  isDev?: boolean
): Promise<AlertNotification[]> {
  if (!db) {
    return erpStorage.getState().alerts;
  }

  try {
    const noticesRef = collection(db, 'notices');
    let remoteNotices: AlertNotification[] = [];

    if (isDev) {
      const snap = await getDocs(noticesRef);
      remoteNotices = snap.docs.map((d) => ({ ...d.data(), id: d.id } as AlertNotification));
    } else if (userAcademyId) {
      const qAcademy = query(noticesRef, where('academyId', '==', userAcademyId));
      const qGlobal = query(noticesRef, where('academyId', '==', 'all'));

      const [snapAcademy, snapGlobal] = await Promise.all([
        getDocs(qAcademy).catch(() => ({ docs: [] })),
        getDocs(qGlobal).catch(() => ({ docs: [] })),
      ]);

      const map = new Map<string, AlertNotification>();
      snapAcademy.docs.forEach((d: any) => map.set(d.id, { ...d.data(), id: d.id }));
      snapGlobal.docs.forEach((d: any) => map.set(d.id, { ...d.data(), id: d.id }));
      remoteNotices = Array.from(map.values());
    }

    if (remoteNotices.length > 0) {
      const localAlerts = erpStorage.getState().alerts;
      const combinedMap = new Map<string, AlertNotification>();
      localAlerts.forEach((a) => combinedMap.set(a.id, a));
      remoteNotices.forEach((a) => combinedMap.set(a.id, a));

      const mergedList = Array.from(combinedMap.values());
      erpStorage.setAlerts(mergedList);
      return remoteNotices;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Firestore fetchNoticesFromFirestore offline:', err);
  }

  return erpStorage.getState().alerts;
}

/**
 * Save notice to Firestore
 */
export async function saveNoticeToFirestore(notice: AlertNotification): Promise<void> {
  if (db) {
    try {
      await setDoc(doc(db, 'notices', notice.id), notice, { merge: true });
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Firestore saveNoticeToFirestore error:', err);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Delete notice from Firestore
 */
export async function deleteNoticeFromFirestore(noticeId: string): Promise<void> {
  if (db) {
    try {
      await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'notices', noticeId));
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Firestore deleteNoticeFromFirestore error:', err);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Query user account by email
 */
export async function getUserAccountByEmail(email: string): Promise<AppUser | null> {
  const cleanEmail = email.toLowerCase().trim();

  // Check Developer hardcoded override
  if (DEV_EMAILS.includes(cleanEmail)) {
    return {
      uid: 'dev-master',
      id: 'dev-master',
      email: cleanEmail,
      name: 'Super Developer / Chief Architect',
      role: 'developer',
      academyId: null,
      academyName: 'All Academies Network',
      status: 'approved',
      createdAt: Date.now(),
    };
  }

  // Check Firestore
  if (db) {
    try {
      const q = query(collection(db, 'users'), where('email', '==', cleanEmail));
      const snap = await getDocs(q);
      if (!snap.empty) {
        return snap.docs[0].data() as AppUser;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Firestore getUserAccountByEmail offline:', err);
    }
  }

  // Check local users
  const localUsers = getLocalUsers();
  return localUsers.find((u) => u.email.toLowerCase() === cleanEmail) || null;
}

let lastPendingFetch = 0;
let cachedPendingList: AppUser[] = [];

/**
 * Fetch pending users from Firestore collection 'users' where status == 'pending'
 * Directly implements user Firestore query snippet:
 * query(collection(db, "users"), where("status", "==", "pending"))
 */
export async function fetchPendingUsers(
  academyId?: string | null,
  isDev?: boolean,
  forceRefresh = false
): Promise<AppUser[]> {
  const now = Date.now();
  // Throttle background queries to max once per 6 seconds unless forced
  if (!forceRefresh && cachedPendingList.length > 0 && now - lastPendingFetch < 6000) {
    if (!isDev && academyId) {
      return cachedPendingList.filter(
        (u) => u.academyId === academyId && u.role !== 'admin' && u.role !== 'developer'
      );
    }
    return cachedPendingList;
  }

  try {
    if (!db) {
      const local = getLocalUsers();
      return local.filter((u) => u.status === 'pending');
    }

    const q = query(collection(db, 'users'), where('status', '==', 'pending'));
    const querySnapshot = await getDocs(q);

    const pendingUsersList: AppUser[] = [];
    querySnapshot.forEach((docSnap) => {
      pendingUsersList.push({ id: docSnap.id, uid: docSnap.id, ...docSnap.data() } as AppUser);
    });

    lastPendingFetch = Date.now();
    cachedPendingList = pendingUsersList;
    console.log('Pending Users:', pendingUsersList);

    // Sync any newly discovered pending users into local cache so all UI components can see them
    if (pendingUsersList.length > 0) {
      const localUsers = getLocalUsers();
      const userMap = new Map<string, AppUser>();
      localUsers.forEach((u) => userMap.set(u.uid || u.id || '', u));
      pendingUsersList.forEach((u) => userMap.set(u.uid || u.id || '', u));
      saveLocalUsers(Array.from(userMap.values()));
    }

    // Role-based scoping:
    // If scoped for Academy Admin, show only members of this academy (excluding admins & developers)
    if (!isDev && academyId) {
      return pendingUsersList.filter(
        (u) =>
          u.academyId === academyId &&
          u.role !== 'admin' &&
          u.role !== 'developer'
      );
    }

    // Developer sees all pending users
    return pendingUsersList;
  } catch (error: any) {
    // Graceful fallback if security rules or offline network occurs
    if (error?.code === 'permission-denied' || error?.message?.includes('insufficient permissions')) {
      console.warn('Firestore notice: Update firestore.rules in Firebase Console to grant permission on collection "users". Falling back to local store.');
    } else {
      console.warn('Error fetching pending users from Firestore:', error?.message || error);
    }
    const local = getLocalUsers();
    return local.filter((u) => {
      if (u.status !== 'pending') return false;
      if (isDev) return true;
      if (academyId) return u.academyId === academyId && u.role !== 'admin' && u.role !== 'developer';
      return false;
    });
  }
}

/**
 * Developer view: Get all pending Admin registrations
 */
export async function getPendingAdmins(): Promise<AppUser[]> {
  try {
    const list = await fetchPendingUsers(undefined, true);
    return list.filter((u) => u.role === 'admin');
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Notice in getPendingAdmins:', err);
    const local = getLocalUsers();
    return local.filter((u) => u.role === 'admin' && u.status === 'pending');
  }
}

/**
 * Admin view: Get all pending Teachers, Students, and Parents for his own academy
 */
export async function getPendingAcademyMembers(academyId: string): Promise<AppUser[]> {
  try {
    const list = await fetchPendingUsers(academyId, false);
    return list;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Notice in getPendingAcademyMembers:', err);
    const local = getLocalUsers();
    return local.filter(
      (u) =>
        u.academyId === academyId &&
        u.role !== 'admin' &&
        u.role !== 'developer' &&
        u.status === 'pending'
    );
  }
}

/**
 * Approve or Reject a user account
 */
export async function setUserApprovalStatus(
  userId: string,
  newStatus: 'approved' | 'rejected',
  allottedAcademyId?: string
): Promise<void> {
  const updates: Partial<AppUser> = { status: newStatus };
  if (allottedAcademyId) {
    updates.academyId = allottedAcademyId;
  }

  // Update Firestore
  if (db) {
    try {
      await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', userId), updates);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Firestore setUserApprovalStatus offline:', err);
    }
  }

  // Update local users
  const local = getLocalUsers();
  const updated = local.map((u) => (u.uid === userId || u.id === userId ? { ...u, ...updates } : u));
  saveLocalUsers(updated);
}

/**
 * Delete a user account (Developer can delete ANY role/user; Admin can delete their academy users)
 */
export async function deleteUserAccount(
  userId: string,
  targetUser: AppUser,
  operatorUser: AppUser
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  const isDev =
    operatorUser.role === 'developer' ||
    DEV_EMAILS.includes(operatorUser.email.toLowerCase());
  const isAdmin = operatorUser.role === 'admin';

  // Rule: Developer can delete ANY user and ANY role!
  if (!isDev) {
    if (targetUser.role === 'developer') {
      return { success: false, error: 'Only Developers have permission to delete Developer accounts.' };
    }
    if (targetUser.role === 'admin') {
      return { success: false, error: 'Administrators cannot delete other Administrator accounts.' };
    }
    // Admin can only delete members of their own academy
    const opAcad = operatorUser.academyId;
    const targetAcad = targetUser.academyId;
    if (isAdmin && opAcad && targetAcad && opAcad !== targetAcad) {
      return { success: false, error: 'You can only manage and delete users from your assigned academy.' };
    }
  }

  // Delete from Firestore if enabled
  if (db) {
    try {
      await deleteDoc(doc(db, 'users', userId));
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Firestore deleteDoc fallback:', err);
    }
  }

  // Delete from local users collections
  const local = getLocalUsers();
  const updated = local.filter((u) => u.uid !== userId && u.id !== userId);
  saveLocalUsers(updated);

  // Also remove from taleemos_users_v5 if present
  try {
    const v5 = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taleemos_users_v5') || '[]');
    const updatedV5 = v5.filter((u: any) => u.id !== userId && u.email !== targetUser.email);
    localStorage.setItem('taleemos_users_v5', JSON.stringify(updatedV5));
  } catch {}

  // Log audit trail
  erpStorage.logAudit(
    'USER_DELETED',
    'User Management',
    `${operatorUser.name} (${operatorUser.role}) deleted ${targetUser.name} (${targetUser.role}) [${targetUser.email}]`
  );

  window.dispatchEvent(new Event('storage'));
  return { success: true };
}

/**
 * Update user role or assigned academy (Developer authority)
 */
export async function updateUserRole(
  userId: string,
  newRole: AppUser['role'],
  newAcademyId?: string | null,
  newAcademyName?: string
): Promise<void> {
  const updates: Partial<AppUser> = {
    role: newRole,
  };
  if (newAcademyId !== undefined) updates.academyId = newAcademyId;
  if (newAcademyName !== undefined) updates.academyName = newAcademyName;

  if (db) {
    try {
      await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', userId), updates);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Firestore updateUserRole offline:', err);
    }
  }

  const local = getLocalUsers();
  const updated = local.map((u) => (u.uid === userId || u.id === userId ? { ...u, ...updates } : u));
  saveLocalUsers(updated);
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event('storage'));
}

/**
 * Update full user account details (name, phone, role, status, academy)
 */
export async function updateUserAccount(
  userId: string,
  updates: Partial<AppUser>
): Promise<void> {
  if (db) {
    try {
      await updateDoc(doc(db, 'users', userId), updates);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Firestore updateUserAccount offline:', err);
    }
  }

  const local = getLocalUsers();
  const updated = local.map((u) => (u.uid === userId || u.id === userId ? { ...u, ...updates } : u));
  saveLocalUsers(updated);

  try {
    const v5 = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taleemos_users_v5') || '[]');
    const updatedV5 = v5.map((u: any) =>
      u.id === userId || (updates.email && u.email === updates.email) ? { ...u, ...updates } : u
    );
    localStorage.setItem('taleemos_users_v5', JSON.stringify(updatedV5));
  } catch {}

  window.dispatchEvent(new Event('storage'));
}




==================== FILE: src/lib/cloudinary.ts ====================
/**
 * Cloudinary Secure Unsigned Upload Service
 * 
 * Cloud Name: h79njj6q
 * Primary Upload Preset: TaleemOS (Unsigned)
 * Secondary Upload Preset: IskoolApp (Unsigned)
 * Endpoint: https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/h79njj6q/auto/upload
 * 
 * Secure unsigned direct client-to-cloud upload.
 * Handles both media (images/photos) and documents (PDF, DOCX, scans).
 */

export const CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME = 'h79njj6q';
export const CLOUDINARY_PRIMARY_PRESET = 'TaleemOS';
export const CLOUDINARY_BACKUP_PRESET = 'IskoolApp';
export const CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_PRESET = CLOUDINARY_PRIMARY_PRESET;

export const CLOUDINARY_AUTO_UPLOAD_URL = `https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/${CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME}/auto/upload`;
export const CLOUDINARY_IMAGE_UPLOAD_URL = `https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/${CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME}/image/upload`;
export const CLOUDINARY_RAW_UPLOAD_URL = `https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/${CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME}/raw/upload`;

export interface CloudinaryUploadResult {
  secure_url: string;
  public_id: string;
  format: string;
  bytes: number;
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
  resource_type?: string;
  original_filename?: string;
  created_at?: string;
}

export interface UploadOptions {
  folder?: string;
  resourceType?: 'image' | 'auto' | 'raw';
  tags?: string[];
}

/**
 * Upload an image or document file to Cloudinary with automatic fallback
 * Returns the permanent HTTPS secure URL from Cloudinary
 */
export async function uploadToCloudinary(
  file: File,
  options?: UploadOptions
): Promise<string> {
  const result = await uploadDocumentToCloudinary(file, options?.folder);
  return result.url;
}

/**
 * Detailed upload returning URL, format, size, and original filename
 */
export async function uploadDocumentToCloudinary(
  file: File,
  folder?: string
): Promise<{
  url: string;
  publicId: string;
  name: string;
  size: number;
  format: string;
  resourceType: string;
}> {
  const isImage = file.type.startsWith('image/');
  const uploadUrl = isImage ? CLOUDINARY_IMAGE_UPLOAD_URL : CLOUDINARY_AUTO_UPLOAD_URL;

  // Preset attempts: Primary ('TaleemOS'), then Backup ('IskoolApp')
  const presets = [CLOUDINARY_PRIMARY_PRESET, CLOUDINARY_BACKUP_PRESET];

  for (const preset of presets) {
    // First try with folder if provided
    if (folder) {
      try {
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('file', file);
        formData.append('upload_preset', preset);
        formData.append('folder', folder);

        const response = await fetch(uploadUrl, {
          method: 'POST',
          body: formData,
        });

        if (response.ok) {
          const data: CloudinaryUploadResult = await response.json();
          if (data.secure_url) {
            return {
              url: data.secure_url,
              publicId: data.public_id,
              name: file.name,
              size: data.bytes || file.size,
              format: data.format || file.name.split('.').pop() || '',
              resourceType: data.resource_type || (isImage ? 'image' : 'raw'),
            };
          }
        }
      } catch {
        // Continue to clean attempt without folder
      }
    }

    // Try without folder (standard unsigned preset settings often restrict dynamic folders)
    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append('file', file);
      formData.append('upload_preset', preset);

      const response = await fetch(uploadUrl, {
        method: 'POST',
        body: formData,
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const data: CloudinaryUploadResult = await response.json();
        if (data.secure_url) {
          return {
            url: data.secure_url,
            publicId: data.public_id,
            name: file.name,
            size: data.bytes || file.size,
            format: data.format || file.name.split('.').pop() || '',
            resourceType: data.resource_type || (isImage ? 'image' : 'raw'),
          };
        }
      } else {
        const errText = await response.text();
        console.warn(`Cloudinary upload preset ${preset} notice (${response.status}):`, errText);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn(`Cloudinary upload network attempt failed for preset ${preset}:`, err);
    }
  }

  // Fallback: Offline base64 data URL if network is unreachable
  const base64 = await fileToBase64(file);
  return {
    url: base64,
    publicId: `local-${Date.now()}`,
    name: file.name,
    size: file.size,
    format: file.name.split('.').pop() || 'dat',
    resourceType: isImage ? 'image' : 'raw',
  };
}

function fileToBase64(file: File): Promise<string> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onloadend = () => {
      resolve(reader.result as string);
    };
    reader.onerror = reject;
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}

function getCurrentSession() {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem('taleemos_current_user_v5');
    if (raw) return JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {}
  return null;
}

export function getAllAuditLogsFromStorage(): AuditLog[] {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(AUDIT_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (raw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) {
        return parsed;
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Failed to parse audit logs from storage:', e);
  }

  // Seed default if empty
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(AUDIT_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(INITIAL_AUDIT_LOGS));
  } catch {}
  return INITIAL_AUDIT_LOGS;
}

export function saveAuditLogsToStorage(logs: AuditLog[]): void {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(AUDIT_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(logs.slice(0, 500)));
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('taleemos_audit_log_changed'));
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Failed to save audit logs:', e);
  }
}

export interface LogAuditParams {
  action: string;
  module: string;
  targetRecord?: string;
  targetId?: string;
  details: string;
  actorName?: string;
  actorRole?: UserRole;
  actorEmail?: string;
  actorId?: string;
  academyId?: string;
  academyName?: string;
}

export function logAuditEvent(params: LogAuditParams): AuditLog {
  const session = getCurrentSession();
  const state = erpStorage.getState();

  const userRole = (params.actorRole || session?.role || state.activeRole || 'admin') as UserRole;
  const userName = params.actorName || session?.name || state.userName || 'System Operator';
  const userEmail = params.actorEmail || session?.email || 'admin@taleemacademy.edu.pk';
  const userId = params.actorId || session?.uid || session?.id || 'usr-system';

  // Multi-tenancy academy resolution
  const academyId =
    params.academyId ||
    session?.academyId ||
    state.activeInstitutionId ||
    'inst-1';

  const academyName =
    params.academyName ||
    session?.academyName ||
    (academyId === 'inst-1'
      ? 'Taleem Academy Main Campus (Kandhkot)'
      : academyId === 'inst-2'
      ? 'Taleem Science & IT College (Sukkur)'
      : academyId === 'inst-3'
      ? 'Taleem Girls Higher Academy (Kashmore)'
      : 'Taleem Academy');

  const now = new Date();
  const formattedDate =
    now.toLocaleDateString('en-CA') +
    ' ' +
    now.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: true });

  const newLog: AuditLog = {
    id: `LOG-${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 900 + 100)}`,
    user: userName,
    role: userRole,
    actorEmail: userEmail,
    actorId: userId,
    action: params.action.toUpperCase(),
    module: params.module,
    targetRecord: params.targetRecord || 'General Record',
    targetId: params.targetId,
    timestamp: formattedDate,
    details: params.details,
    academyId,
    academyName,
  };

  const currentLogs = getAllAuditLogsFromStorage();
  const updatedLogs = [newLog, ...currentLogs];
  saveAuditLogsToStorage(updatedLogs);

  // Also bridge with erpStorage internal state
  try {
    erpStorage.logAudit(params.action, params.module, params.details);
  } catch {}

  return newLog;
}

/**
 * Retrieves audit logs strictly enforcing role-based tenancy:
 * - Admin: strictly filtered by their academyId
 * - Developer: full visibility across all academies (or filtered by requested academyId if selected)
 */
export function getScopedAuditLogs(
  userAcademyId?: string | null,
  isDeveloper: boolean = false,
  selectedAcademyFilter: string = 'all'
): AuditLog[] {
  const allLogs = getAllAuditLogsFromStorage();

  if (isDeveloper) {
    if (!selectedAcademyFilter || selectedAcademyFilter === 'all') {
      return allLogs;
    }
    return allLogs.filter((l) => l.academyId === selectedAcademyFilter);
  }

  // Admin and other roles: strictly scoped to user's academyId
  const effectiveAcadId = userAcademyId || 'inst-1';
  return allLogs.filter((l) => l.academyId === effectiveAcadId);
}

export function clearAuditLogsForScope(
  userAcademyId?: string | null,
  isDeveloper: boolean = false,
  targetAcademyId: string = 'all'
): void {
  const allLogs = getAllAuditLogsFromStorage();

  if (isDeveloper && targetAcademyId === 'all') {
    saveAuditLogsToStorage([]);
    return;
  }

  const acadIdToClear = isDeveloper ? targetAcademyId : (userAcademyId || 'inst-1');
  const remaining = allLogs.filter((l) => l.academyId !== acadIdToClear);
  saveAuditLogsToStorage(remaining);
}
