import { type CustomFieldDefinition } from '../types';
import { logAuditEvent } from './auditLogger';

const CUSTOM_FIELDS_STORAGE_PREFIX = 'taleemos_custom_fields_v5_';

const DEFAULT_ACADEMY_FIELDS: Record<string, CustomFieldDefinition[]> = {
  'inst-1': [
    {
      id: 'cf_emerg_contact',
      label: 'Emergency Guardian Contact',
      type: 'text',
      placeholder: 'e.g. Uncle: Haji Noor (+92 300 1234567)',
      isRequired: false,
      academyId: 'inst-1',
      createdAt: '2026-10-24',
    },
    {
      id: 'cf_vaccination_date',
      label: 'Polio / Vaccination Date',
      type: 'date',
      placeholder: 'YYYY-MM-DD',
      isRequired: false,
      academyId: 'inst-1',
      createdAt: '2026-10-24',
    },
    {
      id: 'cf_prev_school',
      label: 'Previous School / Board',
      type: 'text',
      placeholder: 'e.g. BISE Larkana / Govt High School',
      isRequired: false,
      academyId: 'inst-1',
      createdAt: '2026-10-24',
    },
  ],
};

export function getCustomFieldsForAcademy(academyId?: string | null): CustomFieldDefinition[] {
  const acadId = academyId || 'inst-1';
  const key = `${CUSTOM_FIELDS_STORAGE_PREFIX}${acadId}`;

  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
    if (raw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        return parsed.slice(0, 5);
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Failed to load custom fields from storage:', e);
  }

  // Fallback to default presets
  const defaults = DEFAULT_ACADEMY_FIELDS[acadId] || DEFAULT_ACADEMY_FIELDS['inst-1'] || [];
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(defaults));
  } catch {}
  return defaults;
}

export function saveCustomFieldsForAcademy(
  academyId: string,
  fields: CustomFieldDefinition[]
): { success: boolean; error?: string } {
  if (fields.length > 5) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Maximum limit of 5 custom fields exceeded.' };
  }

  const key = `${CUSTOM_FIELDS_STORAGE_PREFIX}${academyId}`;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(fields));
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('taleemos_custom_fields_changed', { detail: { academyId } }));
    return { success: true };
  } catch (e: any) {
    return { success: false, error: e?.message || 'Storage error' };
  }
}

export function addCustomField(
  academyId: string,
  field: { label: string; type: 'text' | 'date'; placeholder?: string; isRequired?: boolean }
): { success: boolean; error?: string; field?: CustomFieldDefinition } {
  const current = getCustomFieldsForAcademy(academyId);

  if (current.length >= 5) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'Cannot add more than 5 custom fields. Please remove or edit an existing field.',
    };
  }

  if (!field.label.trim()) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Field label cannot be empty.' };
  }

  const exists = current.some((f) => f.label.toLowerCase().trim() === field.label.toLowerCase().trim());
  if (exists) {
    return { success: false, error: 'A custom field with this label already exists.' };
  }

  const newField: CustomFieldDefinition = {
    id: `cf_${Date.now()}_${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)}`,
    label: field.label.trim(),
    type: field.type,
    placeholder: field.placeholder || '',
    isRequired: Boolean(field.isRequired),
    academyId,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
  };

  const updated = [...current, newField];
  const res = saveCustomFieldsForAcademy(academyId, updated);
  if (res.success) {
    logAuditEvent({
      action: 'ADD_CUSTOM_FIELD',
      module: 'Settings',
      targetRecord: `Field: ${newField.label} (${newField.type})`,
      targetId: newField.id,
      details: `Added custom student attribute "${newField.label}" of type "${newField.type}"`,
      academyId,
    });
    return { success: true, field: newField };
  }
  return res;
}

export function updateCustomField(
  academyId: string,
  id: string,
  updates: Partial<CustomFieldDefinition>
): { success: boolean; error?: string } {
  const current = getCustomFieldsForAcademy(academyId);
  const idx = current.findIndex((f) => f.id === id);
  if (idx === -1) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Custom field not found.' };
  }

  const updatedField = { ...current[idx], ...updates };
  const updated = [...current];
  updated[idx] = updatedField;

  const res = saveCustomFieldsForAcademy(academyId, updated);
  if (res.success) {
    logAuditEvent({
      action: 'UPDATE_CUSTOM_FIELD',
      module: 'Settings',
      targetRecord: `Field: ${updatedField.label}`,
      targetId: id,
      details: `Updated custom student attribute "${updatedField.label}" (${updatedField.type})`,
      academyId,
    });
  }
  return res;
}

export function deleteCustomField(
  academyId: string,
  id: string
): { success: boolean; error?: string } {
  const current = getCustomFieldsForAcademy(academyId);
  const fieldToDelete = current.find((f) => f.id === id);
  const updated = current.filter((f) => f.id !== id);

  const res = saveCustomFieldsForAcademy(academyId, updated);
  if (res.success) {
    logAuditEvent({
      action: 'DELETE_CUSTOM_FIELD',
      module: 'Settings',
      targetRecord: `Field: ${fieldToDelete?.label || id}`,
      targetId: id,
      details: `Removed custom student attribute "${fieldToDelete?.label || id}"`,
      academyId,
    });
  }
  return res;
}

export function getMessageTemplates(academyId?: string | null): MessageTemplate[] {
  const acadId = academyId || 'inst-1';
  const key = `${TEMPLATES_STORAGE_PREFIX}${acadId}`;

  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
    if (raw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) {
        return parsed;
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Failed to load message templates from storage:', e);
  }

  // Fallback to default
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_TEMPLATES));
  } catch {}
  return DEFAULT_TEMPLATES;
}

export function saveMessageTemplate(
  template: Omit<MessageTemplate, 'id'> & { id?: string },
  academyId?: string | null
): { success: boolean; error?: string; template?: MessageTemplate } {
  const acadId = academyId || 'inst-1';
  const current = getMessageTemplates(acadId);

  if (!template.title.trim()) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Template title cannot be empty.' };
  }
  if (!template.message.trim()) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Message body cannot be empty.' };
  }

  let updatedList: MessageTemplate[];
  let savedItem: MessageTemplate;

  if (template.id) {
    // Edit existing
    const idx = current.findIndex((t) => t.id === template.id);
    if (idx !== -1) {
      savedItem = {
        ...current[idx],
        ...template,
        academyId: acadId,
      } as MessageTemplate;
      updatedList = [...current];
      updatedList[idx] = savedItem;
    } else {
      savedItem = {
        ...template,
        id: template.id,
        academyId: acadId,
        createdDate: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      } as MessageTemplate;
      updatedList = [savedItem, ...current];
    }
  } else {
    // New
    savedItem = {
      ...template,
      id: `tmpl_${Date.now()}_${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)}`,
      academyId: acadId,
      createdDate: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      isSystem: false,
    };
    updatedList = [savedItem, ...current];
  }

  try {
    const key = `${TEMPLATES_STORAGE_PREFIX}${acadId}`;
    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(updatedList));
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('taleemos_templates_changed'));

    logAuditEvent({
      action: template.id ? 'UPDATE_SMS_TEMPLATE' : 'CREATE_SMS_TEMPLATE',
      module: 'Communication',
      targetRecord: `Template: ${savedItem.title}`,
      targetId: savedItem.id,
      details: `Saved message draft "${savedItem.title}" under category "${savedItem.category}"`,
      academyId: acadId,
    });

    return { success: true, template: savedItem };
  } catch (e: any) {
    return { success: false, error: e?.message || 'Failed to save template.' };
  }
}

export function deleteMessageTemplate(
  id: string,
  academyId?: string | null
): { success: boolean; error?: string } {
  const acadId = academyId || 'inst-1';
  const current = getMessageTemplates(acadId);
  const target = current.find((t) => t.id === id);

  const updated = current.filter((t) => t.id !== id);
  try {
    const key = `${TEMPLATES_STORAGE_PREFIX}${acadId}`;
    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(updated));
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('taleemos_templates_changed'));

    logAuditEvent({
      action: 'DELETE_SMS_TEMPLATE',
      module: 'Communication',
      targetRecord: `Template: ${target?.title || id}`,
      targetId: id,
      details: `Deleted message draft template "${target?.title || id}"`,
      academyId: acadId,
    });

    return { success: true };
  } catch (e: any) {
    return { success: false, error: e?.message || 'Failed to delete template.' };
  }
}

/**
 * Replace placeholders in text with actual or sample context values
 */
export function substitutePlaceholders(
  templateText: string,
  context: Record<string, string | number> = {}
): string {
  let result = templateText;
  const mergedContext: Record<string, string | number> = {
    '{student_name}': context.student_name || 'Muhammad Hamza',
    '{parent_name}': context.parent_name || 'Ghulam Rasool',
    '{roll_no}': context.roll_no || 'TAK-26-001',
    '{class_name}': context.class_name || 'Batch 2026-A (Morning)',
    '{due_amount}': context.due_amount || '7,500',
    '{due_date}': context.due_date || '28th Oct 2026',
    '{consecutive_days}': context.consecutive_days || '4',
    '{academy_name}': context.academy_name || 'Taleem Academy',
    '{phone}': context.phone || '+92 300 1234567',
    ...context,
  };

  Object.entries(mergedContext).forEach(([key, val]) => {
    const regex = new RegExp(key.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'), 'g');
    result = result.replace(regex, String(val));
  });

  return result;
}

/**
 * Demo Account & Sandbox Management Service
 * Controls demo credentials for Admin, Teacher, Student, Parent.
 * Supports:
 * - Developer Hide / Show toggle on Login Page

 * - Strict authentication against developer-provided credentials
 * - Read-only flag enforcement (no write allowed)

import { type AppUser } from '../types';

  userName: string;
  isRevoked: boolean;
  lastResetAt: number;
}

export interface DemoAccountsConfig {
  isEnabled: boolean; // Controls whether demo accounts appear on login page
  accounts: Record<DemoRole, DemoRoleCredentials>;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'taleemos_demo_accounts_config_v1';

/**
 * Generate a cryptographically distinct, easy-to-read random password
 * E.g. "Taleem#9482" or "Pass@7319"
 */
export function generateRandomPassword(): string {
  const prefixes = ['Taleem', 'Demo', 'Portal', 'School', 'Academy', 'Smart', 'Campus'];
  const symbols = ['#', '@', '!', '$', '%'];
  const randPrefix = prefixes[Math.floor(Math.random() * prefixes.length)];
  const randSymbol = symbols[Math.floor(Math.random() * symbols.length)];
  const randNum = Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000);
  return `${randPrefix}${randSymbol}${randNum}`;
}

/**
 * Generate a random login identifier for a demo role
 * E.g. "demo.admin.742@taleemos.pk"
 */
export function generateRandomLoginId(role: DemoRole): string {
  const randNum = Math.floor(100 + Math.random() * 900);
  return `demo.${role}.${randNum}@taleemos.pk`;
}

/**
 * Retrieve the current Demo Accounts Configuration from localStorage
 */
export function getDemoAccountsConfig(): DemoAccountsConfig {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (raw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (parsed && typeof parsed.isEnabled === 'boolean' && parsed.accounts) {
        return {
          isEnabled: parsed.isEnabled,
          accounts: {
            admin: { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG.accounts.admin, ...(parsed.accounts.admin || {}) },
            teacher: { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG.accounts.teacher, ...(parsed.accounts.teacher || {}) },
            student: { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG.accounts.student, ...(parsed.accounts.student || {}) },
            parent: { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG.accounts.parent, ...(parsed.accounts.parent || {}) },
          },
        };
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Failed to parse demo accounts config:', err);
  }

  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_CONFIG));
  } catch {}
  return DEFAULT_CONFIG;
}

/**
 * Save Demo Accounts Configuration and dispatch custom event
 */
export function saveDemoAccountsConfig(config: DemoAccountsConfig): void {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(config));
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('taleemos_demo_config_changed', { detail: config }));
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Failed to save demo accounts config:', err);
  }
}

/**
 * Toggle hide/show of Demo Accounts on Login Page (Developer Authority)
 */
export function toggleDemoVisibility(show: boolean): DemoAccountsConfig {
  const config = getDemoAccountsConfig();
  config.isEnabled = show;
  saveDemoAccountsConfig(config);
  return config;
}

/**
 * Reset random login and password for a specific role or all roles
 */
export function resetRandomDemoCredentials(targetRole?: DemoRole): DemoAccountsConfig {
  const config = getDemoAccountsConfig();
  const roles: DemoRole[] = targetRole ? [targetRole] : ['admin', 'teacher', 'student', 'parent'];

  roles.forEach((r) => {
    config.accounts[r] = {
      ...config.accounts[r],
      loginId: generateRandomLoginId(r),
      password: generateRandomPassword(),
      isRevoked: false,
      lastResetAt: Date.now(),
    };
  });

  saveDemoAccountsConfig(config);
  return config;
}

/**
 * Revoke (expire) demo credentials for a specific role or all roles
 * When revoked, anyone using those credentials will be rejected.
 */
export function revokeDemoCredentials(targetRole?: DemoRole): DemoAccountsConfig {
  const config = getDemoAccountsConfig();
  const roles: DemoRole[] = targetRole ? [targetRole] : ['admin', 'teacher', 'student', 'parent'];

  roles.forEach((r) => {
    config.accounts[r] = {
      ...config.accounts[r],
      isRevoked: true,
      lastResetAt: Date.now(),
    };
  });

  saveDemoAccountsConfig(config);
  return config;
}

/**
 * Restore / Reactivate demo credentials for a role
 */
export function restoreDemoCredentials(targetRole?: DemoRole): DemoAccountsConfig {
  const config = getDemoAccountsConfig();
  const roles: DemoRole[] = targetRole ? [targetRole] : ['admin', 'teacher', 'student', 'parent'];

  roles.forEach((r) => {
    config.accounts[r] = {
      ...config.accounts[r],
      isRevoked: false,
      lastResetAt: Date.now(),
    };
  });

  saveDemoAccountsConfig(config);
  return config;
}

/**
 * Update custom login ID or password set manually by Developer
 */
export function updateCustomDemoCredentials(
  role: DemoRole,
  customLoginId: string,
  customPassword: string
): DemoAccountsConfig {
  const config = getDemoAccountsConfig();
  if (config.accounts[role]) {
    config.accounts[role] = {
      ...config.accounts[role],
      loginId: customLoginId.trim(),
      password: customPassword.trim(),
      isRevoked: false,
      lastResetAt: Date.now(),
    };
    saveDemoAccountsConfig(config);
  }
  return config;
}

/**
 * Validates login attempt against active Developer-provided Demo Credentials
 * Requires exact match of Login ID and Password.
 * Rejects if developer has revoked or expired the credentials.
 * On success, returns user object with `isDemo: true` and `readOnly: true`.
 */
export function validateDemoLogin(
  role: DemoRole,
  enteredLoginId: string,
  enteredPassword: string
): { success: boolean; user?: AppUser; error?: string } {
  const config = getDemoAccountsConfig();

  if (!config.isEnabled) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'Demo accounts are currently disabled by the Developer.',
    };
  }

  const roleCreds = config.accounts[role];
  if (!roleCreds) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'Invalid demo role selected.',
    };
  }

  // Check if developer revoked or expired this demo account
  if (roleCreds.isRevoked) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: `⛔ Demo Access Expired: The ${roleCreds.roleTitle} demo credentials have been revoked by the Developer. Please request current credentials from the developer.`,
    };
  }

  const cleanEnteredId = enteredLoginId.trim().toLowerCase();
  const cleanTargetId = roleCreds.loginId.trim().toLowerCase();

  // Validate Login ID and Password strictly
  if (cleanEnteredId !== cleanTargetId || enteredPassword.trim() !== roleCreds.password.trim()) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: '❌ Authentication Failed: Invalid Demo Login ID or Password. Please ensure you entered the exact credentials provided by the Developer.',
    };
  }

  // Construct Demo User with STRICT read-only properties
  const demoUser: AppUser = {
    uid: `demo-usr-${role}-${Date.now()}`,
    id: `demo-usr-${role}-${Date.now()}`,
    email: roleCreds.loginId,
    name: roleCreds.userName,
    role: role,
    academyId: 'inst-1',
    academyName: 'Taleem Academy Main Campus (Demo Sandbox)',
    status: 'approved',
    createdAt: Date.now(),
    isDemo: true,
    readOnly: true,
  };

  return {
    success: true,
    user: demoUser,
  };
}

==================== FILE: src/lib/pdf.ts ====================
import jsPDF from 'jspdf';
import html2canvas from 'html2canvas';

export function triggerBrowserPrint(): void {
  window.print();
}

export async function downloadElementAsPdf(elementId: string, filename = 'document.pdf'): Promise<boolean> {
  const element = document.getElementById(elementId);
  if (!element) {
    console.error(`Element #${elementId} not found for PDF export`);
    window.print();
    return false;
  }

  try {
    const canvas = await html2canvas(element, {
      scale: 2,
      useCORS: true,
      logging: false,
      backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
    });

    const imgData = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    const pdf = new jsPDF({
      orientation: canvas.width > canvas.height ? 'landscape' : 'portrait',
      unit: 'mm',
      format: 'a4',
    });

    const pdfWidth = pdf.internal.pageSize.getWidth();
    const pdfHeight = pdf.internal.pageSize.getHeight();
    const imgWidth = pdfWidth;
    const imgHeight = (canvas.height * pdfWidth) / canvas.width;

    let heightLeft = imgHeight;
    let position = 0;

    pdf.addImage(imgData, 'PNG', 0, position, imgWidth, imgHeight);
    heightLeft -= pdfHeight;

    while (heightLeft > 0) {
      position = heightLeft - imgHeight;
      pdf.addPage();
      pdf.addImage(imgData, 'PNG', 0, position, imgWidth, imgHeight);
      heightLeft -= pdfHeight;
    }

    pdf.save(filename.endsWith('.pdf') ? filename : `${filename}.pdf`);
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('PDF export via html2canvas failed, defaulting to window.print():', error);
    window.print();
    return false;
  }
}

class ERPStorage {
  private state: ERPStoreState;
  private listeners: Set<() => void> = new Set();

  constructor() {
    this.state = this.loadState();
  }

  private loadState(): ERPStoreState {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (saved) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
        // Ensure new structures or missing arrays exist
        return {
          ...INITIAL_DATA,
          ...parsed,
          calendarEvents:
            parsed.calendarEvents && parsed.calendarEvents.length > 0
              ? parsed.calendarEvents
              : INITIAL_DATA.calendarEvents,
        };
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to parse saved ERP state from localStorage:', e);
    }
    return INITIAL_DATA;
  }

  private saveState(): void {
    // Demo Account Read-Only Guard: Disallow any write when logged in as demo
    try {
      const currentUser = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('taleemos_current_user_v5') || 'null');
      if (currentUser?.isDemo || currentUser?.readOnly) {
        console.warn('Write blocked: Demo accounts operate in strict read-only mode.');
        window.dispatchEvent(
          new CustomEvent('taleemos_demo_write_blocked', {
            detail: {
              message:
                '🔒 Action Blocked: Demo accounts operate in strict read-only mode. Creating, editing, or deleting records is disabled.',
            },
          })
        );
        return;
      }
    } catch {}

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(this.state));
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to save ERP state to localStorage:', e);
    }
    this.notify();
  }

  public getState(): ERPStoreState {
    return this.state;
  }

  public setAlerts(alerts: AlertNotification[]): void {
    this.state.alerts = alerts;
    this.saveState();
  }

  public subscribe(listener: () => void): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(listener);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(listener);
  }

  private notify(): void {
    this.listeners.forEach((l) => l());
  }

  public logAudit(action: string, module: string, details: string): void {
    const newLog: AuditLog = {
      id: `LOG-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,
      user: this.state.userName,
      role: this.state.activeRole,
      action,
      module,
      timestamp: new Date().toLocaleString(),
      details,
    };
    this.state.auditLogs = [newLog, ...this.state.auditLogs.slice(0, 100)];
    this.saveState();
  }

  public setActiveRole(role: UserRole): void {
    this.state.activeRole = role;
    this.logAudit('ROLE_SWITCH', 'Auth / RBAC', `Switched active role to: ${role}`);
    this.saveState();
  }

  public setActiveInstitution(id: string): void {
    this.state.activeInstitutionId = id;
    const inst = INSTITUTIONS.find((i) => i.id === id);
    this.logAudit('CAMPUS_SWITCH', 'Multi-tenant', `Switched campus to: ${inst?.name || id}`);
    this.saveState();
  }

  // Approvals
  public approveRequest(requestId: string, reason?: string): void {
    const req = this.state.approvals.find((a) => a.id === requestId);
    if (!req) return;

    req.status = 'Approved';
    req.history.push({
      actor: this.state.userName,
      role: this.state.activeRole,
      action: 'Approved',
      timestamp: new Date().toLocaleString(),
      reason,
    });

    // Cascade to related entities
    if (req.module === 'Admission Confirmed') {
      const adm = this.state.admissions.find((a) => a.id === req.recordId);
      if (adm) adm.status = 'Confirmed';
    } else if (req.module === 'Fee Discount > 500') {
      const adm = this.state.admissions.find((a) => a.id === req.recordId);
      if (adm) adm.status = 'Confirmed';
    } else if (req.module === 'Expense > 5000') {
      const exp = this.state.expenses.find((e) => e.id === req.recordId);
      if (exp) exp.status = 'Approved';
    } else if (req.module === 'Staff Leave') {
      const lev = this.state.leaves.find((l) => l.id === req.recordId);
      if (lev) {
        lev.status = 'Approved';
        lev.approvedBy = `${this.state.userName} (${this.state.activeRole})`;
      }
    } else if (req.module === 'Student Promotion') {
      const pro = this.state.promotions.find((p) => p.id === req.recordId);
      if (pro) {
        pro.status = 'Approved';
        pro.approver = `${this.state.userName} (${this.state.activeRole})`;
      }
    }

    this.logAudit('APPROVAL_APPROVED', 'Approval Workflow', `Approved request: ${req.title}`);
    this.saveState();
  }

  public rejectRequest(requestId: string, reason: string): void {
    const req = this.state.approvals.find((a) => a.id === requestId);
    if (!req) return;

    req.status = 'Rejected';
    req.history.push({
      actor: this.state.userName,
      role: this.state.activeRole,
      action: 'Rejected',
      timestamp: new Date().toLocaleString(),
      reason,
    });

    if (req.module === 'Expense > 5000') {
      const exp = this.state.expenses.find((e) => e.id === req.recordId);
      if (exp) exp.status = 'Rejected';
    } else if (req.module === 'Staff Leave') {
      const lev = this.state.leaves.find((l) => l.id === req.recordId);
      if (lev) lev.status = 'Rejected';
    } else if (req.module === 'Student Promotion') {
      const pro = this.state.promotions.find((p) => p.id === req.recordId);
      if (pro) pro.status = 'Retained';
    }

    this.logAudit('APPROVAL_REJECTED', 'Approval Workflow', `Rejected request: ${req.title}. Reason: ${reason}`);
    this.saveState();
  }

  // Generic Mutators
  public addItem<K extends keyof ERPStoreState>(key: K, item: any): void {
    if (Array.isArray(this.state[key])) {
      (this.state[key] as any[]) = [item, ...(this.state[key] as any[])];
      this.logAudit('ADD_ITEM', String(key), `Added new item into ${String(key)} with ID: ${item.id || 'N/A'}`);
      if (key === 'attendance') {
        this.checkAndTriggerConsecutiveAbsenceAlerts();
      }
      this.saveState();
    }
  }

  public updateItem<K extends keyof ERPStoreState>(key: K, id: string, updates: any): void {
    if (Array.isArray(this.state[key])) {
      (this.state[key] as any[]) = (this.state[key] as any[]).map((item) =>
        item.id === id ? { ...item, ...updates } : item
      );
      this.logAudit('UPDATE_ITEM', String(key), `Updated item ID: ${id} in ${String(key)}`);
      if (key === 'attendance') {
        this.checkAndTriggerConsecutiveAbsenceAlerts();
      }
      this.saveState();
    }
  }

  public deleteItem<K extends keyof ERPStoreState>(key: K, id: string): void {
    if (Array.isArray(this.state[key])) {
      (this.state[key] as any[]) = (this.state[key] as any[]).filter((item) => item.id !== id);
      this.logAudit('DELETE_ITEM', String(key), `Deleted item ID: ${id} from ${String(key)}`);
      if (key === 'attendance') {
        this.checkAndTriggerConsecutiveAbsenceAlerts();
      }
      this.saveState();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Automated Alert System for Attendance:
   * Scans all student attendance records across dates chronologically.
   * If a student has missed more than 3 consecutive classes, triggers a Critical Alert in state.alerts.
   */
  public checkAndTriggerConsecutiveAbsenceAlerts(): AlertNotification[] {
    const records = this.state.attendance || [];
    const students = this.state.students || [];

    // Group attendance by student
    const studentAttendanceMap = new Map<string, AttendanceRecord[]>();
    records.forEach((r) => {
      const key = r.studentId || r.rollNo;
      if (!studentAttendanceMap.has(key)) studentAttendanceMap.set(key, []);
      studentAttendanceMap.get(key)!.push(r);
    });

    const triggeredAlerts: AlertNotification[] = [];

    studentAttendanceMap.forEach((recList, key) => {
      // Sort chronological ascending
      const sorted = [...recList].sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));

      let currentStreak = 0;
      let maxStreak = 0;
      let latestDate = '';
      let streakBatch = '';

      sorted.forEach((rec) => {
        if (rec.status === 'A') {
          currentStreak++;
          latestDate = rec.date;
          streakBatch = rec.batch;
          if (currentStreak > maxStreak) {
            maxStreak = currentStreak;
          }
        } else {
          currentStreak = 0;
        }
      });

      const consecutiveAbsences = currentStreak > 0 ? currentStreak : maxStreak;

      // Trigger if student has missed more than 3 consecutive classes (i.e. >= 4)
      if (consecutiveAbsences > 3) {
        const studentObj = students.find((s) => s.id === key || s.rollNo === key);
        const studentName = studentObj ? studentObj.name : (sorted[0]?.studentName || key);
        const rollNo = studentObj ? studentObj.rollNo : (sorted[0]?.rollNo || key);
        const batchName = streakBatch || studentObj?.classBatch || 'Assigned Cohort';

        const alertId = `ALT-ABS-${rollNo.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '')}`;
        const existingIdx = this.state.alerts.findIndex((a) => a.id === alertId);

        const newAlert: AlertNotification = {
          id: alertId,
          title: `Consecutive Absence Alert: ${studentName} (${rollNo})`,
          type: 'Student Absenteeism',
          priority: 'Critical',
          date: latestDate || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
          audience: 'Parents',
          status: existingIdx !== -1 ? this.state.alerts[existingIdx].status : 'Pending',
          message: `Automated Attendance Alert: Student ${studentName} (${rollNo}) has missed ${consecutiveAbsences} consecutive classes in ${batchName}. School regulatory framework mandates formal parental conference and explanation.`,
          assignedTo: 'Attendance Coordinator (Asma Bibi)',
          actionTaken:
            existingIdx !== -1
              ? this.state.alerts[existingIdx].actionTaken
              : 'Automated SMS & WhatsApp reminder queued; class teacher alerted.',
          studentId: studentObj?.id || key,
          rollNo,
          batch: batchName,
          consecutiveDays: consecutiveAbsences,
        };

        if (existingIdx !== -1) {
          this.state.alerts[existingIdx] = { ...this.state.alerts[existingIdx], ...newAlert };
        } else {
          this.state.alerts.unshift(newAlert);
          this.logAudit(
            'ATTENDANCE_ALERT_TRIGGERED',
            'Attendance & Alerts',
            `Triggered automated consecutive absence warning for ${studentName} (${consecutiveAbsences} missed classes)`
          );
        }
        triggeredAlerts.push(newAlert);
      }
    });

    return triggeredAlerts;
  }

  // Calendar Event operations (with drag & drop reschedule support)
  public addCalendarEvent(event: CalendarEvent): void {
    if (!this.state.calendarEvents) {
      this.state.calendarEvents = [];
    }
    this.state.calendarEvents.unshift(event);
    this.logAudit('EVENT_CREATED', 'Academic Calendar', `Created ${event.type}: "${event.title}" on ${event.date}`);
    this.saveState();
  }

  public moveCalendarEvent(id: string, newDate: string): void {
    if (!this.state.calendarEvents) return;
    const ev = this.state.calendarEvents.find((e) => e.id === id);
    if (ev) {
      const oldDate = ev.date;
      ev.date = newDate;
      this.logAudit('EVENT_RESCHEDULED', 'Academic Calendar', `Rescheduled "${ev.title}" from ${oldDate} to ${newDate}`);
      this.saveState();
    }
  }

  public updateCalendarEvent(id: string, updates: Partial<CalendarEvent>): void {
    if (!this.state.calendarEvents) return;
    const idx = this.state.calendarEvents.findIndex((e) => e.id === id);
    if (idx !== -1) {
      this.state.calendarEvents[idx] = { ...this.state.calendarEvents[idx], ...updates };
      this.logAudit('EVENT_UPDATED', 'Academic Calendar', `Updated details for: ${this.state.calendarEvents[idx].title}`);
      this.saveState();
    }
  }

  public deleteCalendarEvent(id: string): void {
    if (!this.state.calendarEvents) return;
    const ev = this.state.calendarEvents.find((e) => e.id === id);
    this.state.calendarEvents = this.state.calendarEvents.filter((e) => e.id !== id);
    if (ev) {
      this.logAudit('EVENT_DELETED', 'Academic Calendar', `Deleted ${ev.type}: "${ev.title}"`);
    }
    this.saveState();
  }

  // Reset to default
  public resetToDemo(): void {
    this.state = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(INITIAL_DATA));
    this.saveState();
  }

  // Backup JSON
  public exportToJson(): void {
    const dataStr = 'data:text/json;charset=utf-8,' + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(this.state, null, 2));
    const downloadAnchor = document.createElement('a');
    downloadAnchor.setAttribute('href', dataStr);
    downloadAnchor.setAttribute('download', `TaleemOS_Hub_v5_Backup_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.json`);
    document.body.appendChild(downloadAnchor);
    downloadAnchor.click();
    downloadAnchor.remove();
  }

  // Restore JSON
  public importFromJson(jsonString: string): boolean {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonString);
      if (parsed && parsed.admissions && parsed.students) {
        this.state = { ...INITIAL_DATA, ...parsed };
        this.saveState();
        return true;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to import JSON backup:', e);
    }
    return false;
  }
}

export const erpStorage = new ERPStorage();


==================== FILE: src/lib/theme.ts ====================
// Theme management utility for Day / Night (Light / Dark) mode

export type ThemeMode = 'light' | 'dark';

const THEME_KEY = 'taleemos_theme_mode';

export function getInitialTheme(): ThemeMode {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'light';
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(THEME_KEY);
    if (saved === 'dark' || saved === 'light') return saved;
    // Check system preference
    if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) {
      return 'dark';
    }
  } catch {}
  return 'light';
}

export function applyTheme(theme: ThemeMode): void {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
  const root = document.documentElement;
  if (theme === 'dark') {
    root.classList.add('dark');
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
  } else {
    root.classList.remove('dark');
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light');
  }
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY, theme);
  } catch {}
}

export function toggleTheme(current: ThemeMode): ThemeMode {
  const next: ThemeMode = current === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
  applyTheme(next);
  return next;
}
