                        <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-1 flex items-center gap-1">
                          <MapPin className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
                          <span>{asset.location}</span>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                        <div className="font-mono text-slate-800">{asset.purchaseDate}</div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                          Age: <strong>{dep.ageYears} yrs</strong> of {asset.usefulLifeYears}y
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-mono font-bold text-slate-900">
                        PKR {asset.originalCost.toLocaleString()}
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-normal">
                          Scrap: PKR {asset.salvageValue.toLocaleString()}
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-mono text-rose-600 font-bold">
                        -PKR {dep.accumulatedDepreciation.toLocaleString()}
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-rose-500 font-normal">
                          ({dep.writtenOffPercentage}% written off)
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-mono font-black text-emerald-700 text-sm">
                        PKR {dep.currentBookValue.toLocaleString()}
                        <div className="w-20 ml-auto bg-slate-100 rounded-full h-1.5 mt-1 overflow-hidden">
                          <div
                            className="bg-emerald-500 h-1.5 rounded-full"
                            style={{ width: `${100 - dep.writtenOffPercentage}%` }}
                          />
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center">
                        <span className="font-mono font-bold text-indigo-700">
                          {dep.remainingUsefulLife} yrs
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center">
                        <span
                          className={`px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold rounded-full ${
                            asset.condition === 'Good'
                              ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                              : asset.condition === 'Needs Repair'
                              ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800'
                              : 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {asset.condition}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleDeleteAsset(asset.id)}
                          className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                          title="Decommission Asset"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Add New Asset Capitalization Modal */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isAddModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsAddModalOpen(false)}
        title="Capitalize New Campus Asset"
        subtitle="Add infrastructure or equipment to the real-time depreciation schedule"
        badge="CAPITAL EXPENDITURE"
      >
        <form onSubmit={handleCreateAsset} className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
              Asset Title / Specification *
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              required
              value={formName}
              onChange={(e) => setFormName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. 50-KVA Silent Backup Diesel Generator"
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none focus:border-indigo-600"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Asset Category
              </label>
              <select
                value={formCategory}
                onChange={(e) => setFormCategory(e.target.value as CampusAsset['category'])}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none bg-white"
              >
                <option value="Electronics & IT">Electronics &amp; IT</option>
                <option value="Vehicle">Vehicle / Transport</option>
                <option value="HVAC & Solar Power">HVAC &amp; Solar Power</option>
                <option value="Lab Equipment">Lab Equipment</option>
                <option value="Campus Furniture">Campus Furniture</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Installation Location
              </label>

                type="text"
                required

              />

          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Original Cost (PKR) *
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                required
                min={1000}
                value={formOriginalCost}
                onChange={(e) => setFormOriginalCost(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none font-mono"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Useful Life (Years) *
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                required
                min={1}
                max={50}
                value={formUsefulLifeYears}
                onChange={(e) => setFormUsefulLifeYears(Number(e.target.value))}

==================== FILE: src/modules/AttendanceModule.tsx ====================
import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  UserCheck,
  Printer,
  Download,
  Calendar,
  MessageSquare,
  Send,
  CheckCircle2,
  XCircle,
  Clock,
  AlertTriangle,
  ArrowRight,
  Phone,
  ShieldAlert,
  Flame,
  Activity,
  TrendingDown,
  Info,
  CalendarDays,
  Sparkles,
  BarChart2,
  Check,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { erpStorage } from '../lib/storage';
import { type AttendanceRecord } from '../types';
import { LetterheadPrint } from '../components/common/LetterheadPrint';
import { triggerBrowserPrint, downloadElementAsPdf } from '../lib/pdf';
import { FloatingPdfButton } from '../components/common/FloatingPdfButton';

interface AttendanceModuleProps {
  onNavigate?: (path: string) => void;
}

export const AttendanceModule: React.FC<AttendanceModuleProps> = ({ onNavigate }) => {
  const state = erpStorage.getState();
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<'daily' | 'heatmap'>('daily');
  const [selectedBatch, setSelectedBatch] = useState(state.batches[0]?.batchName || 'Batch 2026-A (Morning)');
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState(new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]);
  const [isPrintAllOpen, setIsPrintAllOpen] = useState(false);
  const [smsSentNotice, setSmsSentNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Trigger automated detection of students missing > 3 consecutive classes
  const consecutiveAbsenceAlerts = useMemo(() => {
    return erpStorage.checkAndTriggerConsecutiveAbsenceAlerts();
  }, [state.attendance]);

  // Current week dates (Monday through Saturday)
  const weekDays = useMemo(() => {
    const base = new Date(selectedDate);
    const day = base.getDay(); // 0 = Sun, 1 = Mon ...
    const diffToMon = day === 0 ? -6 : 1 - day;
    const monday = new Date(base);
    monday.setDate(base.getDate() + diffToMon);

    const labels = ['Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday'];
    return labels.map((name, i) => {
      const d = new Date(monday);
      d.setDate(monday.getDate() + i);
      const dateStr = d.toISOString().split('T')[0];
      return {
        dayName: name,
        shortName: name.slice(0, 3),
        dateStr,
        displayDate: d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short' }),
      };
    });
  }, [selectedDate]);

  // Heatmap Matrix: batches across weekdays
  const heatmapData = useMemo(() => {
    const batches = state.batches;
    const dayTotalAbsents: Record<string, number> = {};
    const dayTotalStudents: Record<string, number> = {};
    const dayTotalPresents: Record<string, number> = {};

    weekDays.forEach((wd) => {
      dayTotalAbsents[wd.dateStr] = 0;
      dayTotalStudents[wd.dateStr] = 0;
      dayTotalPresents[wd.dateStr] = 0;
    });

    const rows = batches.map((batch) => {
      const enrolled = batch.enrolled || 25;
      const daysStats = weekDays.map((wd) => {
        const records = state.attendance.filter(
          (a) => a.batch === batch.batchName && a.date === wd.dateStr
        );

        let pCount = records.filter((r) => r.status === 'P').length;
        let aCount = records.filter((r) => r.status === 'A').length;
        let lCount = records.filter((r) => r.status === 'L').length;

        // If no records on that date in demo, derive deterministic pattern reflecting reality (higher absences on Friday/Saturday)
        if (records.length === 0) {
          const isFriday = wd.shortName === 'Fri';
          const isSaturday = wd.shortName === 'Sat';
          const isMonday = wd.shortName === 'Mon';

          const simAbsentRate = isFriday ? 0.24 : isSaturday ? 0.28 : isMonday ? 0.14 : 0.08;
          aCount = Math.round(enrolled * simAbsentRate);
          lCount = Math.round(enrolled * 0.05);
          pCount = Math.max(0, enrolled - aCount - lCount);
        }

        const totalMarked = pCount + aCount + lCount;
        const rate = totalMarked > 0 ? Math.round(((pCount + lCount * 0.5) / totalMarked) * 100) : 90;

        dayTotalAbsents[wd.dateStr] += aCount;
        dayTotalStudents[wd.dateStr] += totalMarked;
        dayTotalPresents[wd.dateStr] += pCount;

        return {
          day: wd,
          rate,
          pCount,
          aCount,
          lCount,
          total: totalMarked,
        };
      });

      const avgBatchRate = Math.round(
        daysStats.reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.rate, 0) / daysStats.length
      );

      return {
        batch,
        days: daysStats,
        avgRate: avgBatchRate,
      };
    });

    // Peak absence day calculation
    let maxAbsents = -1;
    let peakDay = weekDays[4]; // default Friday
    let minAbsents = 999999;
    let bestDay = weekDays[1]; // default Tuesday

    weekDays.forEach((wd) => {
      const abs = dayTotalAbsents[wd.dateStr] || 0;
      if (abs > maxAbsents) {
        maxAbsents = abs;
        peakDay = wd;
      }
      if (abs < minAbsents) {
        minAbsents = abs;
        bestDay = wd;
      }
    });

    const totalWeeklyStudents = Object.values(dayTotalStudents).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    const totalWeeklyPresents = Object.values(dayTotalPresents).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    const totalWeeklyAbsents = Object.values(dayTotalAbsents).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    const weeklyAvgRate = totalWeeklyStudents > 0
      ? Math.round((totalWeeklyPresents / totalWeeklyStudents) * 100)
      : 88;

    const peakDayStudents = dayTotalStudents[peakDay.dateStr] || 1;
    const peakDayAbsenceRate = Math.round((maxAbsents / peakDayStudents) * 100);

    return {
      rows,
      peakDay,
      maxAbsents,
      peakDayAbsenceRate,
      bestDay,
      weeklyAvgRate,
      totalWeeklyAbsents,
      dayTotalAbsents,
      dayTotalStudents,
    };
  }, [state.batches, state.attendance, weekDays]);

  // Filter students belonging to this batch
  const batchStudents = state.students.filter((s) => s.classBatch === selectedBatch);

  // Status map for daily register
  const getStatus = (studentId: string): 'P' | 'A' | 'L' => {
    const rec = state.attendance.find(
      (a) => a.studentId === studentId && a.date === selectedDate && a.batch === selectedBatch
    );
    return rec ? rec.status : 'P';
  };

  const handleSetStatus = (student: (typeof batchStudents)[0], status: 'P' | 'A' | 'L') => {
    const existing = state.attendance.find(
      (a) => a.studentId === student.id && a.date === selectedDate && a.batch === selectedBatch
    );

    if (existing) {
      erpStorage.updateItem('attendance', existing.id, { status });
    } else {
      const newRec: AttendanceRecord = {
        id: `ATT-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,
        date: selectedDate,
        batch: selectedBatch,
        studentId: student.id,
        studentName: student.name,
        rollNo: student.rollNo,
        status,
      };
      erpStorage.addItem('attendance', newRec);
    }
  };

  const markAll = (status: 'P' | 'A') => {
    batchStudents.forEach((student) => {
      handleSetStatus(student, status);
    });
  };

  // Stats for this batch & date
  const presentCount = batchStudents.filter((s) => getStatus(s.id) === 'P').length;
  const absentCount = batchStudents.filter((s) => getStatus(s.id) === 'A').length;
  const lateCount = batchStudents.filter((s) => getStatus(s.id) === 'L').length;
  const attendanceRate = batchStudents.length > 0 ? Math.round((presentCount / batchStudents.length) * 100) : 0;

  // SMS to Absent Parents action
  const handleSendSmsToAbsents = () => {
    const absents = batchStudents.filter((s) => getStatus(s.id) === 'A');
    if (absents.length === 0) {
      alert('No students marked absent for this batch today.');
      return;
    }

    setSmsSentNotice(`Dispatched absence SMS notification to parents of ${absents.length} students via Gateway.`);
    setTimeout(() => setSmsSentNotice(null), 4000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <FloatingPdfButton
        label="Download Attendance PDF"
        onPrint={() => setIsPrintAllOpen(true)}
      />

      {/* Header */}
      <div className="rounded-[24px] bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-indigo-950 to-slate-900 p-6 text-white shadow-xl flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 bg-indigo-600 rounded-xl">
              <UserCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
            </span>
            <h1 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-black tracking-tight">Student Daily Attendance & Heatmap</h1>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-emerald-500 text-white font-black text-[10px] rounded uppercase">
              BIOMETRIC & HEATMAP
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-indigo-200 mt-1">
            Batch-wise attendance marking, weekly classroom attendance heatmap, and automated consecutive absence alerts.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {/* View Mode Switcher */}
          <div className="inline-flex rounded-xl bg-white/10 p-1 border border-white/20">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setViewMode('daily')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer ${
                viewMode === 'daily'
                  ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow'
                  : 'text-slate-300 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Daily Sheet</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setViewMode('heatmap')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer ${
                viewMode === 'heatmap'
                  ? 'bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 font-black shadow'
                  : 'text-slate-300 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <Flame className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-300" />
              <span>Attendance Heatmap</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsPrintAllOpen(true)}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl border border-white/20 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
            Print Sheet
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleSendSmsToAbsents}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-black rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-emerald-600/30 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
            SMS Absent Parents
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Automated Consecutive Absence Alert Notification Banner */}
      {consecutiveAbsenceAlerts.length > 0 && (
        <div className="p-5 bg-gradient-to-r from-rose-50 via-amber-50 to-rose-50 rounded-3xl border-2 border-rose-300 shadow-sm space-y-3">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
              <div className="p-2.5 bg-rose-600 text-white rounded-2xl shadow-md shrink-0">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                  <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider bg-rose-600 text-white shadow-xs">
                    Automated Alert Triggered
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-rose-900">
                    {consecutiveAbsenceAlerts.length} Student(s) Missed &gt; 3 Consecutive Classes
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-rose-700 mt-1">
                  Threshold violated: System has automatically broadcasted critical notices to the <b>AlertsModule</b>. Immediate parent notification recommended.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onNavigate?.('alerts')}
              className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-black text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow transition cursor-pointer self-start sm:self-auto shrink-0"
            >
              <span>View in AlertsModule</span>
              <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 pt-1">
            {consecutiveAbsenceAlerts.map((alt) => (
              <div
                key={alt.id}
                className="p-3 bg-white/90 rounded-2xl border border-rose-200 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs shadow-xs"
              >
                <div>
                  <div className="font-extrabold text-slate-900">{alt.title}</div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] text-rose-700 font-mono mt-0.5">
                    {alt.consecutiveDays} Consecutive Classes Absent &bull; {alt.batch}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    const student = state.students.find((s) => s.rollNo === alt.rollNo);
                    const msg = encodeURIComponent(
                      `Assalam-o-Alaikum Respected Parent, this is an automated attendance notice from Taleem Academy. Student ${student?.name || alt.rollNo} has missed ${alt.consecutiveDays} consecutive classes in ${alt.batch} without sanctioned leave. Please contact the administration immediately.`
                    );
                    window.open(`https://wa.me/?text=${msg}`, '_blank');
                  }}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white rounded-xl text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0 cursor-pointer shadow-xs self-start sm:self-auto"
                >
                  <MessageSquare className="w-3 h-3" />
                  <span>WhatsApp Parent</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {smsSentNotice && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800 text-xs font-bold rounded-2xl animate-in fade-in flex items-center gap-2">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
          <span>{smsSentNotice}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {/* ATTENDANCE HEATMAP VIEW                                  */}
      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {viewMode === 'heatmap' && (
        <div className="space-y-5 animate-in fade-in">
          {/* Peak Absence Day Diagnostic Callout */}
          <div className="p-5 bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500/10 via-rose-500/10 to-amber-500/10 rounded-3xl border-2 border-amber-300 shadow-sm flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
              <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 flex items-center justify-center font-black text-lg shadow-sm shrink-0">
                <Flame className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-950" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                  <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider bg-rose-600 text-white">
                    Peak Absence Warning
                  </span>
                  <h4 className="font-extrabold text-sm text-slate-900">
                    Highest Absence Day Detected: <span className="text-rose-600 font-black">{heatmapData.peakDay.dayName} ({heatmapData.peakDay.displayDate})</span>
                  </h4>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-700 mt-1">
                  Classrooms experience an average <span className="font-bold text-rose-700">{heatmapData.peakDayAbsenceRate}% absence rate</span> ({heatmapData.maxAbsents} student absences across batches). Early Thursday reminders recommended.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500">Color Intensity:</span>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-mono">
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold">&ge;90%</span>
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-lime-200 text-lime-900 font-bold">80-89%</span>
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-200 text-amber-900 font-bold">70-79%</span>
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-rose-500 text-white font-bold">&lt;70%</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 4 Weekly Heatmap Metrics */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
            <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[20px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
              <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Weekly Avg Attendance</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 font-mono mt-1">
                {heatmapData.weeklyAvgRate}%
              </div>
              <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Across all class cohorts</div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[20px] border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50/30 shadow-sm">
              <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-rose-600 uppercase flex items-center gap-1">
                <TrendingDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Peak Absence Day
              </div>
              <div className="text-xl font-black text-rose-600 mt-1">
                {heatmapData.peakDay.dayName}
              </div>
              <div className="text-[10px] text-rose-700 font-mono mt-0.5">{heatmapData.maxAbsents} absents recorded</div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[20px] border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50/30 shadow-sm">
              <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-600 uppercase flex items-center gap-1">
                <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Best Attendance Day
              </div>
              <div className="text-xl font-black text-emerald-700 mt-1">
                {heatmapData.bestDay.dayName}
              </div>
              <div className="text-[10px] text-emerald-700 font-mono mt-0.5">Highest regularity</div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[20px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
              <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-600 uppercase">Total Weekly Absences</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-black text-indigo-700 font-mono mt-1">
                {heatmapData.totalWeeklyAbsents}
              </div>
              <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Incidents this week</div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Weekly Heatmap Matrix Grid */}
          <div className="p-6 bg-white rounded-[24px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm space-y-4">
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-extrabold text-base text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Activity className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600" />
                  Weekly Classroom Attendance Matrix (Monday – Saturday)
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                  Click any cell to immediately drill down into that day&apos;s student roster and mark attendance.
                </p>
              </div>

              <span className="text-xs font-mono text-indigo-700 bg-indigo-50 px-3 py-1 rounded-xl border border-indigo-100">
                Week: {weekDays[0].displayDate} – {weekDays[5].displayDate}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-center border-collapse text-xs">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 border-b border-slate-200">
                    <th className="p-3 text-left w-56 font-bold">Class / Batch Cohort</th>
                    {weekDays.map((wd) => {
                      const isPeak = wd.dateStr === heatmapData.peakDay.dateStr;
                      return (
                        <th
                          key={wd.dateStr}
                          className={`p-3 font-bold border-l border-slate-100 ${
                            isPeak ? 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-900' : ''
                          }`}
                        >
                          <div className="font-extrabold">{wd.dayName}</div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                            {wd.displayDate}
                            {isPeak && <span className="block text-rose-600 text-[9px] font-bold">PEAK ABSENCE</span>}
                          </div>
                        </th>
                      );
                    })}
                    <th className="p-3 font-bold border-l border-slate-200 bg-slate-100">Batch Avg</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                  {heatmapData.rows.map((row) => (
                    <tr key={row.batch.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/50 transition">
                      <td className="p-3.5 text-left font-bold text-slate-900">
                        <div className="text-xs">{row.batch.batchName}</div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                          {row.batch.timing} &bull; {row.batch.enrolled} Students
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      {row.days.map((d) => {
                        // Intensity styling
                        const isHigh = d.rate >= 90;
                        const isMedium = d.rate >= 80 && d.rate < 90;
                        const isLow = d.rate >= 70 && d.rate < 80;
                        const isCritical = d.rate < 70;

                        return (
                          <td
                            key={d.day.dateStr}
                            onClick={() => {
                              setSelectedBatch(row.batch.batchName);
                              setSelectedDate(d.day.dateStr);
                              setViewMode('daily');
                            }}
                            className="p-2 border-l border-slate-100 cursor-pointer group"
                            title={`Click to view roster for ${row.batch.batchName} on ${d.day.dayName}`}
                          >
                            <div
                              className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl transition-all group-hover:scale-105 group-hover:shadow-md ${
                                isHigh
                                  ? 'bg-emerald-500 text-white shadow-xs'
                                  : isMedium
                                  ? 'bg-lime-200 text-lime-950 border border-lime-300 font-bold'
                                  : isLow
                                  ? 'bg-amber-200 text-amber-950 border border-amber-300 font-bold'
                                  : 'bg-rose-500 text-white font-bold shadow-xs'
                              }`}
                            >
                              <div className="text-sm font-black font-mono leading-none">
                                {d.rate}%
                              </div>
                              <div className={`text-[10px] mt-1 font-mono leading-none ${
                                isHigh || isCritical ? 'text-white/80' : 'text-slate-700'
                              }`}>
                                {d.pCount}P / {d.aCount}A
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </td>
                        );
                      })}

                      <td className="p-3 border-l border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 font-mono font-black text-slate-900">
                        {row.avgRate}%
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
                <tfoot>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 font-bold border-t border-slate-200">
                    <td className="p-3 text-left">Total Daily Absentees:</td>
                    {weekDays.map((wd) => {
                      const abs = heatmapData.dayTotalAbsents[wd.dateStr] || 0;
                      const isPeak = wd.dateStr === heatmapData.peakDay.dateStr;
                      return (
                        <td
                          key={wd.dateStr}
                          className={`p-3 font-mono border-l border-slate-200 ${
                            isPeak ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-900 font-black' : ''
                          }`}
                        >
                          <span className={isPeak ? 'text-rose-700' : 'text-slate-800'}>
                            {abs} Absents
                          </span>
                        </td>
                      );
                    })}
                    <td className="p-3 border-l border-slate-200 bg-slate-200 font-mono text-indigo-900">
                      {heatmapData.totalWeeklyAbsents} Total
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                </tfoot>
              </table>
            </div>

            {/* Daily Absence Bar Distribution */}
            <div className="pt-4 border-t border-slate-200">
              <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-3 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <BarChart2 className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600" />
                <span>Daily Absence Distribution Pattern (Week Overview)</span>
              </h4>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-6 gap-2">
                {weekDays.map((wd) => {
                  const abs = heatmapData.dayTotalAbsents[wd.dateStr] || 0;
                  const isPeak = wd.dateStr === heatmapData.peakDay.dateStr;
                  const pctOfMax = heatmapData.maxAbsents > 0 ? (abs / heatmapData.maxAbsents) * 100 : 50;

                  return (
                    <div key={wd.dateStr} className="text-center space-y-1">
                      <div className="h-20 bg-slate-100 rounded-xl flex items-end p-1 justify-center">
                        <div
                          className={`w-full rounded-lg transition-all duration-500 ${
                            isPeak ? 'bg-rose-500' : 'bg-indigo-500'
                          }`}
                          style={{ height: `${Math.max(15, pctOfMax)}%` }}
                          title={`${wd.dayName}: ${abs} absentees`}
                        />
                      </div>
                      <div className="font-extrabold text-[11px] text-slate-800">{wd.shortName}</div>
                      <div className={`text-[10px] font-mono font-bold ${isPeak ? 'text-rose-600' : 'text-slate-500'}`}>
                        {abs} absents
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {/* DAILY SHEET VIEW (Standard Roster Marking)               */}
      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {viewMode === 'daily' && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* Date & Batch Filter Bar */}
          <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[22px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase">Batch:</span>
                <select
                  value={selectedBatch}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelectedBatch(e.target.value)}
                  className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-indigo-900 outline-none"
                >
                  {state.batches.map((b) => (
                    <option key={b.id} value={b.batchName}>
                      {b.batchName} ({b.enrolled} Students)
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase">Date:</span>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={selectedDate}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelectedDate(e.target.value)}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium outline-none"
                >
                </input>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => markAll('P')}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-100 border border-emerald-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer"
              >
                Mark All Present
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => markAll('A')}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-100 border border-rose-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer"
              >
                Mark All Absent
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* KPIs for Selected Day */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
            <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[20px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
              <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Total in Batch</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 font-mono mt-1">{batchStudents.length}</div>
            </div>
            <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[20px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
              <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-600 uppercase">Present (P)</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-black text-emerald-600 font-mono mt-1">{presentCount}</div>
            </div>
            <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[20px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
              <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-rose-600 uppercase">Absent (A)</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-black text-rose-600 font-mono mt-1">{absentCount}</div>
            </div>
            <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[20px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
              <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-600 uppercase">Daily Rate</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-black text-indigo-600 font-mono mt-1">{attendanceRate}%</div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Student Roster Table */}
          <div className="bg-white rounded-[24px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
            <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="font-extrabold text-sm text-slate-900">
                Attendance Roster &bull; {selectedBatch} ({selectedDate})
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono">
                {presentCount} Present &bull; {absentCount} Absent
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 font-bold border-b border-slate-200">
                    <th className="p-3.5">Roll No</th>
                    <th className="p-3.5">Student</th>
                    <th className="p-3.5">Father Name</th>
                    <th className="p-3.5">Contact Phone</th>
                    <th className="p-3.5 text-center">Status Action</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                  {batchStudents.length === 0 ? (
                    <tr>
                      <td colSpan={5} className="p-8 text-center text-slate-400">
                        No students enrolled in this batch.
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ) : (
                    batchStudents.map((s) => {
                      const currentStatus = getStatus(s.id);
                      return (
                        <tr key={s.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/50 transition">
                          <td className="p-3.5 font-mono font-bold text-indigo-700">{s.rollNo}</td>
                          <td className="p-3.5 font-bold text-slate-900">{s.name}</td>
                          <td className="p-3.5 text-slate-600">{s.fatherName}</td>
                          <td className="p-3.5 font-mono text-slate-500">{s.phone}</td>
                          <td className="p-3.5 text-center">
                            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 p-1 bg-slate-100 rounded-xl border border-slate-200">
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => handleSetStatus(s, 'P')}
                                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
                                  currentStatus === 'P'
                                    ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-sm'
                                    : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'
                                }`}
                              >
                                P
                              </button>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => handleSetStatus(s, 'A')}
                                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
                                  currentStatus === 'A'
                                    ? 'bg-rose-600 text-white shadow-sm'
                                    : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'
                                }`}
                              >
                                A
                              </button>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => handleSetStatus(s, 'L')}
                                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
                                  currentStatus === 'L'
                                    ? 'bg-amber-500 text-white shadow-sm'
                                    : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'
                                }`}
                              >
                                L
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      );
                    })
                  )}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* PRINT REPORT MODAL */}
      {isPrintAllOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-md p-4 no-print overflow-y-auto">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-4xl w-full p-6 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-slate-200 mb-4">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-slate-900">Daily Attendance Roll Sheet (A4)</h3>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => triggerBrowserPrint()}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-indigo-700 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  Print A4
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => downloadElementAsPdf('attendance-print-table', `Attendance_${selectedBatch}_${selectedDate}`)}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-800 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  PDF Download
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsPrintAllOpen(false)}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800"
                >
                  Close
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div id="attendance-print-table">
              <LetterheadPrint
                title={`DAILY STUDENT ATTENDANCE REGISTER: ${selectedBatch}`}
                documentNo={`ATT-${selectedDate}`}
                date={selectedDate}
                summaryStats={[
                  { label: 'Total Enrolled', value: batchStudents.length },
                  { label: 'Present', value: presentCount },
                  { label: 'Absent', value: absentCount },
                  { label: 'Daily Rate', value: `${attendanceRate}%` },
                ]}
              >
                <table className="w-full border-collapse border border-slate-300 text-left text-xs">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 font-bold">
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Roll No</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Student Name</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Father Name</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Parent Phone</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-center">Status</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {batchStudents.map((s) => {
                      const st = getStatus(s.id);
                      return (
                        <tr key={s.id}>
                          <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-mono font-bold text-indigo-700">
                            {s.rollNo}
                          </td>
                          <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-bold">{s.name}</td>
                          <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2">{s.fatherName}</td>
                          <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-mono">{s.phone}</td>
                          <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-center font-black">
                            <span
                              className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded ${
                                st === 'P'
                                  ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                                  : st === 'A'
                                  ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800'
                                  : 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800'
                              }`}
                            >
                              {st === 'P' ? 'PRESENT' : st === 'A' ? 'ABSENT' : 'LATE'}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      );
                    })}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </LetterheadPrint>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default AttendanceModule;
