==================== FILE: src/modules/BatchesModule.tsx ====================
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Layers,
  Plus,
  Printer,
  Download,
  Search,
  User,
  Clock,
  DoorOpen,
  UserPlus,
  Trash2,
  Edit2,
  Calendar,
  Percent,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { erpStorage } from '../lib/storage';
import { type Batch } from '../types';
import { Modal } from '../components/common/Modal';
import { LetterheadPrint } from '../components/common/LetterheadPrint';
import { triggerBrowserPrint, downloadElementAsPdf } from '../lib/pdf';

export const BatchesModule: React.FC = () => {
  const state = erpStorage.getState();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('All');
  const [courseFilter, setCourseFilter] = useState('All');

  // Modals
  const [isAddModalOpen, setIsAddModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedBatch, setSelectedBatch] = useState<Batch | null>(null);
  const [isPrintAllOpen, setIsPrintAllOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);

  // 12 fields as required
  const [batchName, setBatchName] = useState('');
  const [course, setCourse] = useState('F.Sc Pre-Engineering');
  const [teacher, setTeacher] = useState('Sir Saeed Ahmed (Physics)');
  const [room, setRoom] = useState('Room 101 - Lecture Hall A');
  const [capacity, setCapacity] = useState(40);
  const [enrolled, setEnrolled] = useState(0);
  const [timing, setTiming] = useState('08:00 AM - 01:00 PM');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Batch['status']>('Active');
  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState(new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]);
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState('');
  const [feeStructure, setFeeStructure] = useState('PKR 4,500/Month');
  const [remarks, setRemarks] = useState('');

  // 5 KPIs (Total, Active, Upcoming, Enrolled/Capacity, Occupancy %)
  const totalBatches = state.batches.length;
  const activeCount = state.batches.filter((b) => b.status === 'Active').length;
  const upcomingCount = state.batches.filter((b) => b.status === 'Upcoming').length;
  const totalEnrolled = state.batches.reduce((sum, b) => sum + b.enrolled, 0);
  const totalCapacity = state.batches.reduce((sum, b) => sum + b.capacity, 0);
  const overallOccupancy = totalCapacity > 0 ? Math.round((totalEnrolled / totalCapacity) * 100) : 0;

  const filtered = state.batches.filter((b) => {
    const matchSearch =
      b.batchName.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      b.teacher.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      b.room.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase());
    const matchStatus = statusFilter === 'All' || b.status === statusFilter;
    const matchCourse = courseFilter === 'All' || b.course === courseFilter;
    return matchSearch && matchStatus && matchCourse;
  });

  const handleSaveBatch = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!batchName.trim() || !course.trim()) return;

    if (isEditMode && selectedBatch) {
      erpStorage.updateItem('batches', selectedBatch.id, {
        batchName,
        course,
        teacher,
        room,
        capacity: Number(capacity),
        enrolled: Number(enrolled),
        timing,
        status,
        startDate,
        endDate: endDate || '2027-05-30',
        feeStructure,
        remarks,
      });
    } else {
      const newBatch: Batch = {
        id: `BAT-0${state.batches.length + 1}`,
        batchName,
        course,
        teacher,
        room,
        capacity: Number(capacity),
        enrolled: Number(enrolled),
        timing,
        status,
        startDate,
        endDate: endDate || '2027-05-30',
        feeStructure,
        remarks,
      };
      erpStorage.addItem('batches', newBatch);
    }

    setIsAddModalOpen(false);
    setIsEditMode(false);
    setSelectedBatch(null);
    resetForm();
  };

  const resetForm = () => {
    setBatchName('');
    setCapacity(40);
    setEnrolled(0);
    setRemarks('');
  };

  const handlePlusOneEnroll = (b: Batch, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (b.enrolled < b.capacity) {
      erpStorage.updateItem('batches', b.id, { enrolled: b.enrolled + 1 });
    } else {
      alert(`Batch ${b.batchName} has reached full capacity of ${b.capacity} students.`);
    }
  };

  const handleOpenEdit = (b: Batch, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setSelectedBatch(b);
    setIsEditMode(true);
    setBatchName(b.batchName);
    setCourse(b.course);
    setTeacher(b.teacher);
    setRoom(b.room);
    setCapacity(b.capacity);
    setEnrolled(b.enrolled);
    setTiming(b.timing);
    setStatus(b.status);
    setStartDate(b.startDate);
    setEndDate(b.endDate);
    setFeeStructure(b.feeStructure);
    setRemarks(b.remarks);
    setIsAddModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleDelete = (id: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (confirm('Delete this batch?')) {
      erpStorage.deleteItem('batches', id);
      if (selectedBatch?.id === id) setSelectedBatch(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="rounded-[24px] bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-indigo-950 to-slate-900 p-6 text-white shadow-xl flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 bg-indigo-600 rounded-xl">
              <Layers className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
            </span>
            <h1 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-black tracking-tight">Batches PRO</h1>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-indigo-500 text-white font-black text-[10px] rounded uppercase">
              COHORT ROSTER
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-indigo-200 mt-1">
            Section capacities, occupancy monitoring, faculty assignments, and timing allocations.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsPrintAllOpen(true)}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl border border-white/20 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
            Print All
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setIsEditMode(false);
              resetForm();
              setIsAddModalOpen(true);
            }}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-black rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            Add New
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 5 KPIs */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-5 gap-3">
        <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[20px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Total Batches</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 font-mono mt-1">{totalBatches}</div>
        </div>
        <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[20px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-600 uppercase">Active Running</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-emerald-600 font-mono mt-1">{activeCount}</div>
        </div>
        <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[20px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-blue-500 uppercase">Upcoming Intake</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-blue-600 font-mono mt-1">{upcomingCount}</div>
        </div>
        <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[20px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-500 uppercase">Enrolled / Cap</div>
          <div className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-black text-indigo-600 font-mono mt-1">
            {totalEnrolled} / {totalCapacity}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[20px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-purple-500 uppercase">Occupancy Rate</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-purple-600 font-mono mt-1">
            {overallOccupancy}%
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Search & Filters */}
      <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[22px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm space-y-3">
        <div className="relative">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3.5 top-3 text-slate-400" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search batches by cohort name, faculty, or room..."
            className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-800 placeholder-slate-400 outline-none focus:border-indigo-500"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs">
          <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mr-1">
            Status:
          </span>
          {['All', 'Active', 'Upcoming', 'Completed', 'Cancelled'].map((st) => (
            <button
              key={st}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setStatusFilter(st)}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                statusFilter === st
                  ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-sm'
                  : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'
              }`}
            >
              {st}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Results Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        {filtered.map((item) => {
          const occ = Math.round((item.enrolled / item.capacity) * 100);
          // Color indicator as required by prompt: red if full, amber if 80%, emerald if available
          const occBadgeColor =
            occ >= 100
              ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border-rose-300'
              : occ >= 80
              ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border-amber-300'
              : 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300';

          return (
            <div
              key={item.id}
              onClick={() => setSelectedBatch(item)}
              className="p-5 bg-white rounded-[22px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between"
            >
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700">
                    {item.course}
                  </span>
                  <span
                    className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-black rounded-full uppercase ${
                      item.status === 'Active'
                        ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                        : 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {item.status}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <h3 className="mt-2 text-base font-black text-slate-900">{item.batchName}</h3>

                <div className="mt-3 space-y-1.5 text-xs text-slate-600">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium">
                    <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600" />
                    <span>{item.teacher}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <DoorOpen className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                    <span>{item.room}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                    <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-500" />
                    <span>{item.timing}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Occupancy bar */}
                <div className="mt-4 p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs mb-1.5">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-slate-500">Occupancy</span>
                    <span className={`px-2 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black border ${occBadgeColor}`}>
                      {item.enrolled} / {item.capacity} ({occ}%)
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="w-full bg-slate-200 h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                    <div
                      className={`h-full transition-all duration-500 ${
                        occ >= 100 ? 'bg-rose-500' : occ >= 80 ? 'bg-amber-500' : 'bg-emerald-500'
                      }`}
                      style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, occ)}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-2 text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 flex justify-between">
                    <span>Fee: {item.feeStructure}</span>
                    <span className="text-slate-400 font-normal">
                      {item.capacity - item.enrolled} seats left
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                  {item.startDate} to {item.endDate}
                </span>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={(e) => handlePlusOneEnroll(item, e)}
                    className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 font-black rounded-lg text-[10px] flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                    title="+1 Quick Enroll Student"
                  >
                    <UserPlus className="w-3 h-3" />
                    +1 Enroll
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={(e) => handleOpenEdit(item, e)}
                    className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-indigo-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Edit2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={(e) => handleDelete(item.id, e)}
                    className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* ADD / EDIT MODAL (12 fields) */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isAddModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsAddModalOpen(false)}
        title={isEditMode ? 'Edit Batch Cohort' : 'Add New Academic Batch'}
        subtitle="Configure schedule, instructor assignment, and capacity quotas"
        badge="12 FIELDS"
        maxWidth="max-w-4xl"
      >
        <form onSubmit={handleSaveBatch} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Batch Name *
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={batchName}
                onChange={(e) => setBatchName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Batch 2026-D (Morning)"
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none focus:border-indigo-600"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Course Program *
              </label>
              <select
                value={course}
                onChange={(e) => setCourse(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none bg-white"
              >
                {state.courses.map((c) => (
                  <option key={c.id} value={c.name}>
                    {c.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Lead Teacher / Faculty *
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={teacher}
                onChange={(e) => setTeacher(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Teacher name"
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Assigned Classroom / Lab
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={room}
                onChange={(e) => setRoom(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Room 101 or Lab 02"
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Student Capacity *
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                required
                min={1}
                value={capacity}
                onChange={(e) => setCapacity(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-bold outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Initial Enrolled
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={0}
                value={enrolled}
                onChange={(e) => setEnrolled(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-bold outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Class Timing *
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={timing}
                onChange={(e) => setTiming(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="08:00 AM - 01:00 PM"
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Status</label>
              <select
                value={status}
                onChange={(e) => setStatus(e.target.value as Batch['status'])}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none bg-white"
              >
                <option value="Active">Active</option>
                <option value="Upcoming">Upcoming</option>
                <option value="Completed">Completed</option>
                <option value="Cancelled">Cancelled</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Start Date</label>
              <input
                type="date"
                value={startDate}
                onChange={(e) => setStartDate(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none bg-white"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">End Date</label>
              <input
                type="date"
                value={endDate}
                onChange={(e) => setEndDate(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none bg-white"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Monthly Fee Structure
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={feeStructure}
                onChange={(e) => setFeeStructure(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="PKR 4,500/Month"
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Remarks & Curriculum Pacing
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={remarks}
                onChange={(e) => setRemarks(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Cohort notes..."
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="pt-3 flex justify-end gap-2 border-t border-slate-100">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsAddModalOpen(false)}
              className="px-4 py-2 border border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl cursor-pointer"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="px-5 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-xs font-black rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 cursor-pointer"
            >
              {isEditMode ? 'Update Batch' : 'Save Batch'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Modal>

      {/* DETAIL MODAL + Single Print */}
      {selectedBatch && (
        <Modal
          isOpen={Boolean(selectedBatch)}
          onClose={() => setSelectedBatch(null)}
          title={`Batch Cohort: ${selectedBatch.batchName}`}
          subtitle={`${selectedBatch.course} • Lead Instructor: ${selectedBatch.teacher}`}
          badge={selectedBatch.status}
        >
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3 text-xs">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 block font-semibold">Classroom:</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">{selectedBatch.room}</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 block font-semibold">Timing:</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-slate-900 font-bold">{selectedBatch.timing}</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="p-3 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-bold mb-1">
                  <span>Enrolled Capacity</span>
                  <span className="text-indigo-600">
                    {selectedBatch.enrolled} / {selectedBatch.capacity} Students (
                    {Math.round((selectedBatch.enrolled / selectedBatch.capacity) * 100)}%)
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="text-slate-500 text-[11px]">
                  Fee Structure: {selectedBatch.feeStructure}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <span className="text-slate-400 block font-semibold">Remarks:</span>
                <p className="text-slate-800 italic">{selectedBatch.remarks}</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => triggerBrowserPrint()}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold hover:bg-indigo-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-md"
              >
                <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
                Print Batch Roster
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelectedBatch(null)}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold hover:bg-slate-200 cursor-pointer"
              >
                Close
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {/* PRINT ALL MODAL */}
      {isPrintAllOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-md p-4 no-print overflow-y-auto">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-4xl w-full p-6 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-slate-200 mb-4">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-slate-900">Batches & Capacities Roster (A4)</h3>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => triggerBrowserPrint()}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-indigo-700 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  Print A4
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => downloadElementAsPdf('batches-print-table', 'TaleemOS_Batches_Capacity')}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-800 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  PDF Download
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsPrintAllOpen(false)}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800"
                >
                  Close
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div id="batches-print-table">
              <LetterheadPrint
                title="Academic Batches & Classroom Allocation Ledger"
                documentNo="BATCH-LEDGER-2026"
                summaryStats={[
                  { label: 'Total Batches', value: totalBatches },
                  { label: 'Active Cohorts', value: activeCount },
                  { label: 'Seats Filled', value: `${totalEnrolled} / ${totalCapacity}` },
                  { label: 'Avg Occupancy', value: `${overallOccupancy}%` },
                ]}
              >
                <table className="w-full border-collapse border border-slate-300 text-left text-xs">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 font-bold">
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Batch Name</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Course</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Faculty Lead</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Room</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Timing</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Enrolled / Cap</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Status</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {filtered.map((b) => (
                      <tr key={b.id}>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-bold">{b.batchName}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2">{b.course}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2">{b.teacher}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2">{b.room}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-mono">{b.timing}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-mono font-bold">
                          {b.enrolled} / {b.capacity}
                        </td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-bold">{b.status}</td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </LetterheadPrint>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default BatchesModule;


==================== FILE: src/modules/CampusModule.tsx ====================
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Building2,
  Plus,
  Printer,
  Download,
  Search,
  DoorOpen,
  Users,
  CheckCircle,
  Trash2,
  Edit2,
  CheckSquare,
  Square,
  X,
  CheckCircle2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { erpStorage } from '../lib/storage';
import { type CampusRoom } from '../types';
import { Modal } from '../components/common/Modal';
import { LetterheadPrint } from '../components/common/LetterheadPrint';
import { triggerBrowserPrint, downloadElementAsPdf } from '../lib/pdf';

export const CampusModule: React.FC = () => {
  const state = erpStorage.getState();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [typeFilter, setTypeFilter] = useState('All');
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [isAddModalOpen, setIsAddModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [editingRoomId, setEditingRoomId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isPrintAllOpen, setIsPrintAllOpen] = useState(false);
  const [actionNotice, setActionNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Form fields
  const [building, setBuilding] = useState('Academic Block A');
  const [roomNumber, setRoomNumber] = useState('Room 103');
  const [type, setType] = useState<CampusRoom['type']>('Lecture Hall');
  const [capacity, setCapacity] = useState(50);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<CampusRoom['status']>('Available');
  const [facilitiesStr, setFacilitiesStr] = useState('Multimedia Projector, Whiteboard, Air Conditioned');

  const totalRooms = state.campus.length;
  const totalCapacity = state.campus.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.capacity, 0);

  const filtered = state.campus.filter((r) => {
    const matchSearch =
      r.roomNumber.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      r.building.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase());
    const matchType = typeFilter === 'All' || r.type === typeFilter;
    return matchSearch && matchType;
  });

  const toggleSelect = (id: string) => {
    setSelectedIds((prev) =>
      prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((i) => i !== id) : [...prev, id]
    );
  };

  const toggleSelectAll = () => {
    if (selectedIds.length === filtered.length && filtered.length > 0) {
      setSelectedIds([]);
    } else {
      setSelectedIds(filtered.map((r) => r.id));
    }
  };

  const handleOpenEdit = (r: CampusRoom, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsEditMode(true);
    setEditingRoomId(r.id);
    setBuilding(r.building);
    setRoomNumber(r.roomNumber);
    setType(r.type);
    setCapacity(r.capacity);
    setStatus(r.status);
    setFacilitiesStr(r.facilities.join(', '));
    setIsAddModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSaveRoom = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!roomNumber.trim()) return;

    if (isEditMode && editingRoomId) {
      erpStorage.updateItem('campus', editingRoomId, {
        building,
        roomNumber,
        type,
        capacity: Number(capacity),
        status,
        facilities: facilitiesStr.split(',').map((f) => f.trim()).filter(Boolean),
      });
      setActionNotice(`Updated facility: ${roomNumber} (${building})`);
    } else {
      const newRoom: CampusRoom = {
        id: `CMP-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,
        building,
        roomNumber,
        type,
        capacity: Number(capacity),
        status,
        facilities: facilitiesStr.split(',').map((f) => f.trim()).filter(Boolean),
      };
      erpStorage.addItem('campus', newRoom);
      setActionNotice(`Registered facility: ${roomNumber}`);
    }

    setIsAddModalOpen(false);
    setIsEditMode(false);
    setEditingRoomId(null);
    setTimeout(() => setActionNotice(null), 3500);
  };

  const handleDelete = (id: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (confirm('Delete this room from campus facilities?')) {
      erpStorage.deleteItem('campus', id);
      setSelectedIds((prev) => prev.filter((i) => i !== id));
      setActionNotice('Facility removed.');
      setTimeout(() => setActionNotice(null), 3000);
    }
  };

  const handleBulkDelete = () => {
    if (confirm(`Delete ${selectedIds.length} selected facilities?`)) {
      selectedIds.forEach((id) => erpStorage.deleteItem('campus', id));
      setSelectedIds([]);
      setActionNotice('Selected facilities deleted.');
      setTimeout(() => setActionNotice(null), 3000);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      {/* Toast Notice */}
      {actionNotice && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800 text-xs font-bold rounded-2xl animate-in fade-in flex items-center gap-2">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
          <span>{actionNotice}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Header */}
      <div className="rounded-[24px] bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-indigo-950 to-slate-900 p-6 text-white shadow-xl flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 bg-indigo-600 rounded-xl">
              <Building2 className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
            </span>
            <h1 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-black tracking-tight">Campus & Infrastructure ERP</h1>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-indigo-500 text-white font-black text-[10px] rounded uppercase">
              FACILITIES
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-indigo-200 mt-1">
            Lecture halls, computer laboratories, science wings, auditoriums, and seating capacity allocations.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsPrintAllOpen(true)}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl border border-white/20 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
            Print Facilities
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setIsEditMode(false);
              setEditingRoomId(null);
              setIsAddModalOpen(true);
            }}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-black rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            Add Room / Lab
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* KPIs */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[20px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Total Rooms & Labs</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 font-mono mt-1">{totalRooms} Venues</div>
        </div>
        <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[20px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-600 uppercase">Campus Seating Capacity</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-indigo-600 font-mono mt-1">{totalCapacity} Desks</div>
        </div>
        <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[20px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-600 uppercase">Available Right Now</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-emerald-600 font-mono mt-1">
            {state.campus.filter((r) => r.status === 'Available').length} Venues
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Search & Checkbox Select Bar */}
      <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[22px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm space-y-3">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center gap-3">
          <div className="relative flex-1 w-full">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3.5 top-3 text-slate-400" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search by room name, building..."
              className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-800 placeholder-slate-400 outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={toggleSelectAll}
            className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer transition shrink-0"
          >
            {selectedIds.length === filtered.length && filtered.length > 0 ? (
              <CheckSquare className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600" />
            ) : (
              <Square className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
            )}
            <span>
              {selectedIds.length === filtered.length && filtered.length > 0
                ? 'Deselect All'
                : `Select All (${filtered.length})`}
            </span>
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs">
          <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mr-1">
            Facility Type:
          </span>
          {['All', 'Lecture Hall', 'Computer Lab', 'Science Lab', 'Auditorium'].map((t) => (
            <button
              key={t}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setTypeFilter(t)}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                typeFilter === t
                  ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-sm'
                  : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'
              }`}
            >
              {t}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Floating Toolbar when selected */}
      {selectedIds.length > 0 && (
        <div className="p-3.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-900 to-slate-900 text-white rounded-2xl shadow-lg border border-indigo-500/40 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 animate-in fade-in">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold">
            <span className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded-lg font-mono">
              {selectedIds.length}
            </span>
            <span>Venues Selected</span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsPrintAllOpen(true)}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Print Selected</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleBulkDelete}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-rose-600/80 hover:bg-rose-600 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Delete</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSelectedIds([])}
              className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-white rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Room Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        {filtered.map((item) => {
          const isSelected = selectedIds.includes(item.id);
          return (
            <div
              key={item.id}
              className={`p-5 rounded-[22px] border shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg transition-all flex flex-col justify-between ${
                isSelected ? 'bg-indigo-50/70 border-indigo-400 ring-2 ring-indigo-400/40' : 'bg-white border-slate-200'
              }`}
            >
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={isSelected}
                      onChange={() => toggleSelect(item.id)}
                      className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-indigo-600 cursor-pointer"
                    />
                    <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 rounded-lg">
                      {item.building}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <span
                    className={`px-2 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase ${
                      item.status === 'Available'
                        ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                        : item.status === 'Occupied'
                        ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800'
                        : 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {item.status}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <h3 className="mt-2 text-lg font-black text-slate-900">{item.roomNumber}</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-semibold">{item.type}</p>

                <div className="mt-3 p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80 flex items-center justify-between font-mono text-xs">
                  <span className="text-slate-500 font-sans font-semibold">Max Seating Capacity:</span>
                  <span className="font-black text-indigo-700 text-sm">{item.capacity} Students</span>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-3">
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider block mb-1">
                    Installed Amenities:
                  </span>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                    {item.facilities.map((fac, i) => (
                      <span key={i} className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 rounded text-[10px]">
                        {fac}
                      </span>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-400">
                <span className="font-mono text-[10px]">{item.id}</span>

                {/* Edit & Delete Actions */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={(e) => handleOpenEdit(item, e)}
                    className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-50 rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                    title="Edit / Modify Facility"
                  >
                    <Edit2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={(e) => handleDelete(item.id, e)}
                    className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                    title="Delete Facility"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* ADD / EDIT ROOM MODAL */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isAddModalOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsAddModalOpen(false);
          setIsEditMode(false);
          setEditingRoomId(null);
        }}
        title={isEditMode ? 'Edit / Modify Campus Facility' : 'Register Campus Facility'}
        subtitle="Define room numbers, building blocks, and capacity limits"
        badge={isEditMode ? 'MODIFY' : 'CAMPUS INFRA'}
      >
        <form onSubmit={handleSaveRoom} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Building Block</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={building}
                onChange={(e) => setBuilding(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Academic Block A"
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none font-bold"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Room / Lab Number *</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={roomNumber}
                onChange={(e) => setRoomNumber(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Room 104 or Robotics Lab"
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none focus:border-indigo-600 font-bold"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Facility Type</label>
              <select
                value={type}
                onChange={(e) => setType(e.target.value as CampusRoom['type'])}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none bg-white font-medium"
              >
                <option value="Lecture Hall">Lecture Hall</option>
                <option value="Computer Lab">Computer Lab</option>
                <option value="Science Lab">Science Lab</option>
                <option value="Auditorium">Auditorium</option>
                <option value="Staff Room">Staff Room</option>
                <option value="Library">Library</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Capacity</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={1}
                value={capacity}
                onChange={(e) => setCapacity(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none font-mono font-bold"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Current Status</label>
              <select
                value={status}
                onChange={(e) => setStatus(e.target.value as CampusRoom['status'])}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none bg-white font-medium"
              >
                <option value="Available">Available</option>
                <option value="Occupied">Occupied</option>
                <option value="Under Maintenance">Under Maintenance</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
              Facilities (Comma separated)
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={facilitiesStr}
              onChange={(e) => setFacilitiesStr(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Multimedia Projector, Whiteboard, Air Conditioned"
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="pt-3 flex justify-end gap-2 border-t border-slate-100">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setIsAddModalOpen(false);
                setIsEditMode(false);
                setEditingRoomId(null);
              }}
              className="px-4 py-2 border border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl cursor-pointer"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="px-5 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-xs font-black rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 cursor-pointer"
            >
              {isEditMode ? 'Update Facility' : 'Add Facility'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Modal>

      {/* PRINT ALL MODAL (Print + PDF Download) */}
      {isPrintAllOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-md p-4 no-print overflow-y-auto">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-4xl w-full p-6 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-slate-200 mb-4">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-slate-900">Campus Facilities Ledger (A4)</h3>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => triggerBrowserPrint()}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-indigo-700 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  Print A4
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => downloadElementAsPdf('campus-print-table', 'TaleemOS_Campus_Infrastructure')}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-800 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  PDF Download
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsPrintAllOpen(false)}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800"
                >
                  Close
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div id="campus-print-table">
              <LetterheadPrint
                title="INSTITUTIONAL CAMPUS BUILDINGS & VENUES ROSTER"
                documentNo="CAMPUS-FAC-2026"
                summaryStats={[
                  { label: 'Total Venues', value: totalRooms },
                  { label: 'Campus Capacity', value: totalCapacity },
                ]}
              >
                <table className="w-full border-collapse border border-slate-300 text-left text-xs">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 font-bold">
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Building</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Room / Lab</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Type</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right">Capacity</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Status</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {(selectedIds.length > 0 ? filtered.filter((r) => selectedIds.includes(r.id)) : filtered).map((r) => (
                      <tr key={r.id}>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-bold">{r.building}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-mono font-bold text-indigo-700">
                          {r.roomNumber}
                        </td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2">{r.type}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right font-mono font-bold">{r.capacity}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-bold">{r.status}</td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </LetterheadPrint>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default CampusModule;

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Award,
  Search,
  Printer,
  Download,
  FileText,
  GraduationCap,
  Star,
  Plus,
  X,
  Edit2,
  Trash2,
  CheckSquare,
  Square,
  CheckCircle2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { LetterheadPrint } from '../components/common/LetterheadPrint';
import { triggerBrowserPrint, downloadElementAsPdf } from '../lib/pdf';
import { Modal } from '../components/common/Modal';
import { getCurrentUser } from '../components/auth/AuthSystem';

import { CloudinaryUploader } from '../components/common/CloudinaryUploader';

type CertType =
  | 'Bonafide'
  | 'Character'
  | 'Achievement'
  | 'Course Completion'
  | 'Transfer Certificate'
  | 'Merit';

type Certificate = {
  id: string;
  studentName: string;
  fatherName?: string;
  rollNo: string;
  class: string;
  type: CertType;
  issueDate: string;
  status: 'Issued' | 'Draft';
  achievement?: string;
  fileUrl?: string;
  fileName?: string;
  photoUrl?: string;
};

export default function CertificatesModule() {
  const currentUser = getCurrentUser();
  const [certs, setCerts] = useState<Certificate[]>(INITIAL_CERTS);
  const [showNew, setShowNew] = useState(false);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [editingCertId, setEditingCertId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedCert, setSelectedCert] = useState<Certificate | null>(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    studentName: '',
    fatherName: '',
    rollNo: '',
    class: 'F.Sc Pre-Engineering',
    type: 'Bonafide' as CertType,
    achievement: '',
    fileUrl: '',
    fileName: '',
    photoUrl: '',
  });

  const filtered = certs.filter(
    (c) =>
      c.studentName.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      c.rollNo.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      c.type.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())
  );

  const toggleSelect = (id: string) => {
    setSelectedIds((prev) =>
      prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((i) => i !== id) : [...prev, id]
    );
  };

  const toggleSelectAll = () => {
    if (selectedIds.length === filtered.length && filtered.length > 0) {
      setSelectedIds([]);
    } else {
      setSelectedIds(filtered.map((c) => c.id));
    }
  };

  const handleOpenEdit = (c: Certificate, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsEditMode(true);
    setEditingCertId(c.id);
    setForm({
      studentName: c.studentName,
      fatherName: c.fatherName || '',
      rollNo: c.rollNo,
      class: c.class,
      type: c.type,
      achievement: c.achievement || '',
      fileUrl: c.fileUrl || '',
      fileName: c.fileName || '',
      photoUrl: c.photoUrl || '',
    });
    setShowNew(true);
  };

  const handleSave = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!form.studentName.trim() || !form.rollNo.trim()) return;

    if (isEditMode && editingCertId) {
      setCerts(
        certs.map((c) =>
          c.id === editingCertId
            ? {
                ...c,
                studentName: form.studentName.trim(),
                fatherName: form.fatherName.trim() || undefined,
                rollNo: form.rollNo.trim(),
                class: form.class,
                type: form.type,
                achievement: form.achievement.trim() || undefined,
                fileUrl: form.fileUrl || undefined,
                fileName: form.fileName || undefined,
                photoUrl: form.photoUrl || undefined,
              }
            : c
        )
      );
      setNotice(`Updated certificate for ${form.studentName}`);
    } else {
      const newCert: Certificate = {
        id: `CERT-${String(certs.length + 1).padStart(3, '0')}`,
        studentName: form.studentName.trim(),
        fatherName: form.fatherName.trim() || undefined,
        rollNo: form.rollNo.trim(),
        class: form.class,
        type: form.type,
        issueDate: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
        status: 'Issued',
        achievement: form.achievement.trim() || undefined,
        fileUrl: form.fileUrl || undefined,
        fileName: form.fileName || undefined,
        photoUrl: form.photoUrl || undefined,
      };
      setCerts([newCert, ...certs]);
      setNotice(`Issued new ${form.type} Certificate (${newCert.id})`);
    }

    setShowNew(false);
    setIsEditMode(false);
    setEditingCertId(null);
    setForm({
      studentName: '',
      fatherName: '',
      rollNo: '',
      class: 'F.Sc Pre-Engineering',
      type: 'Bonafide',
      achievement: '',
      fileUrl: '',
      fileName: '',
      photoUrl: '',
    });
    setTimeout(() => setNotice(null), 3500);
  };

  const handleDelete = (id: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (confirm('Delete this certificate record?')) {
      setCerts(certs.filter((c) => c.id !== id));
      if (selectedCert?.id === id) setSelectedCert(null);
      setSelectedIds((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item !== id));
      setNotice('Certificate deleted.');
      setTimeout(() => setNotice(null), 3000);
    }
  };

  const academyName = currentUser?.academyName || 'Taleem Academy Kandhkot';

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      {/* Toast Notice */}
      {notice && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800 text-xs font-bold rounded-2xl animate-in fade-in flex items-center gap-2">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
          <span>{notice}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Header */}
      <div className="rounded-[24px] bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-indigo-950 to-slate-900 p-6 text-white shadow-xl flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 bg-indigo-600 rounded-xl">
              <Award className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
            </span>
            <h1 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-black tracking-tight">
              Certificates & Awards Issuance PRO
            </h1>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 font-black text-[10px] rounded uppercase">
              PRINT A4 & PDF
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-indigo-200 mt-1">
            Bonafide, Character, Merit, Transfer (TC), and Achievement certificates with verifiable institutional seal.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => triggerBrowserPrint()}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl border border-white/20 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
            Print Ledger
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setIsEditMode(false);
              setEditingCertId(null);
              setForm({
                studentName: '',
                fatherName: '',
                rollNo: '',
                class: 'F.Sc Pre-Engineering',
                type: 'Bonafide',
                achievement: '',
                fileUrl: '',
                fileName: '',
                photoUrl: '',
              });
              setShowNew(true);
            }}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-black rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            Issue Certificate
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Search & Checkbox Select Bar */}
      <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[22px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="relative flex-1 w-full">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3.5 top-3 text-slate-400" />
          <input
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search certificate by student, roll number, or type..."
            className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none focus:border-indigo-500"
          />
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={toggleSelectAll}
          className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer transition shrink-0"
        >
          {selectedIds.length === filtered.length && filtered.length > 0 ? (
            <CheckSquare className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600" />
          ) : (
            <Square className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
          )}
          <span>
            {selectedIds.length === filtered.length && filtered.length > 0
              ? 'Deselect All'
              : `Select All (${filtered.length})`}
          </span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Floating Toolbar when selected */}
      {selectedIds.length > 0 && (
        <div className="p-3.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-900 to-slate-900 text-white rounded-2xl shadow-lg border border-indigo-500/40 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 animate-in fade-in">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold">
            <span className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded-lg font-mono">
              {selectedIds.length}
            </span>
            <span>Certificates Selected</span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => triggerBrowserPrint()}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Print Selected</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                if (confirm(`Delete ${selectedIds.length} selected certificates?`)) {
                  setCerts(certs.filter((c) => !selectedIds.includes(c.id)));
                  setSelectedIds([]);
                  setNotice('Deleted selected certificates.');
                  setTimeout(() => setNotice(null), 3000);
                }
              }}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-rose-600/80 hover:bg-rose-600 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Delete</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSelectedIds([])}
              className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-white rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Certificates Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        {filtered.map((c) => {
          const isSelected = selectedIds.includes(c.id);
          return (
            <div
              key={c.id}
              onClick={() => setSelectedCert(c)}
              className={`p-5 rounded-[22px] border shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between ${
                isSelected ? 'bg-indigo-50/70 border-indigo-400 ring-2 ring-indigo-400/40' : 'bg-white border-slate-200'
              }`}
            >
              <div>
                <div className="flex justify-between items-start gap-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={isSelected}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        toggleSelect(c.id);
                      }}
                      className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-indigo-600 cursor-pointer"
                    />
                    <span className="font-mono text-[10px] bg-slate-900 text-white px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold">
                      {c.id}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border border-indigo-200">
                    {c.type}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-start gap-3 mt-2.5">
                  {c.photoUrl && (
                    <img
                      src={c.photoUrl}
                      alt={c.studentName}
                      className="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl object-cover border-2 border-indigo-200 shrink-0"
                    />
                  )}
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <h3 className="font-extrabold text-[15px] text-slate-900 truncate">{c.studentName}</h3>
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-mono">
                      Roll: <strong className="text-indigo-700">{c.rollNo}</strong> &bull; {c.class}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {c.achievement && (
                  <p className="text-[11px] mt-2.5 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200/80 text-amber-900 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-medium">
                    🏆 {c.achievement}
                  </p>
                )}

                {c.fileUrl && (
                  <div className="mt-2.5 flex items-center justify-between p-2 bg-indigo-50/70 rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 text-[11px]">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-indigo-900 truncate">
                      <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600 shrink-0" />
                      <span className="font-bold truncate">{c.fileName || 'Attached Certificate Doc'}</span>
                    </div>
                    <a
                      href={c.fileUrl}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                      onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                      className="text-[10px] font-bold text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-800 underline shrink-0 ml-1"
                    >
                      View
                    </a>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono">Issued: {c.issueDate}</span>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={(e) => handleOpenEdit(c, e)}
                    className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-50 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
                    title="Edit Certificate"
                  >
                    <Edit2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={(e) => handleDelete(c.id, e)}
                    className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
                    title="Delete Certificate"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* CREATE / EDIT CERTIFICATE MODAL */}
      {showNew && (
        <Modal
          isOpen={showNew}
          onClose={() => {
            setShowNew(false);
            setIsEditMode(false);
            setEditingCertId(null);
          }}
          title={isEditMode ? 'Edit / Modify Certificate' : 'Issue Official Academic Certificate'}
          subtitle={`Issuing Authority: ${academyName}`}
          badge="OFFICIAL ATTESTATION"
          maxWidth="max-w-xl"
        >
          <form onSubmit={handleSave} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Student Name *</label>
                <input
                  required
                  value={form.studentName}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, studentName: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="Student full name"
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 border rounded-xl outline-none font-bold focus:border-indigo-600"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Father Name</label>
                <input
                  value={form.fatherName}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, fatherName: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="Father's name"
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 border rounded-xl outline-none"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Roll Number *</label>
                <input
                  required
                  value={form.rollNo}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, rollNo: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="e.g. TAK-26-001"
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 border rounded-xl outline-none font-mono font-bold"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Class / Program</label>
                <input
                  value={form.class}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, class: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="F.Sc Pre-Engineering"
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 border rounded-xl outline-none"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Certificate Type *</label>
              <select
                value={form.type}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, type: e.target.value as CertType })}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 border rounded-xl outline-none bg-white font-bold"
              >
                <option value="Bonafide">Bonafide Student Certificate</option>
                <option value="Character">Character & Conduct Certificate</option>
                <option value="Achievement">Merit & Achievement Award</option>
                <option value="Course Completion">Course Completion Diploma</option>
                <option value="Transfer Certificate">School Leaving / Transfer Certificate (TC)</option>
                <option value="Merit">Academic Merit Certificate</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Citation / Achievement Description
              </label>
              <textarea
                rows={2}
                value={form.achievement}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, achievement: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="Specific commendation or reasons for issuance..."
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 border rounded-xl outline-none"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Cloudinary Integration for Student Portrait & Document Scans */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 pt-2">
              <CloudinaryUploader
                label="Student Photo (Cloudinary)"
                description="Upload student portrait for certificate"
                value={form.photoUrl}
                accept="image/*"
                mode="image"
                previewShape="circle"
                folder="taleemos_students"
                onUpload={(url) => setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, photoUrl: url }))}
              />
              <CloudinaryUploader
                label="Scanned Certificate / PDF Doc"
                description="Attach signed certificate or official scan"
                value={form.fileUrl}
                accept="application/pdf,image/*"
                mode="document"
                folder="taleemos_certificates"
                onUpload={(url, meta) =>
                  setForm((prev) => ({
                    ...prev,
                    fileUrl: url,
                    fileName: meta?.name || 'certificate_doc.pdf',
                  }))
                }
              />
            </div>

            <div className="pt-3 flex justify-end gap-2 border-t">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setShowNew(false);
                  setIsEditMode(false);
                  setEditingCertId(null);
                }}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 rounded-xl font-bold"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="px-5 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white rounded-xl font-black shadow-md shadow-indigo-900/30"
              >
                {isEditMode ? 'Update Certificate' : 'Issue Certificate'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {/* DETAIL CERTIFICATE MODAL with Print & PDF Download */}
      {selectedCert && (
        <Modal
          isOpen={Boolean(selectedCert)}
          onClose={() => setSelectedCert(null)}
          title={`Certificate of ${selectedCert.type}: ${selectedCert.studentName}`}
          subtitle={`Roll No: ${selectedCert.rollNo} • Document Ref: ${selectedCert.id}`}
          badge={selectedCert.status}
          maxWidth="max-w-4xl"
        >
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div id="single-certificate-view">
              <LetterheadPrint
                title={`CERTIFICATE OF ${selectedCert.type.toUpperCase()}`}
                documentNo={selectedCert.id}
                date={selectedCert.issueDate}
                signatures={[
                  'Class Incharge',
                  'Controller of Examinations',
                  'Principal / Director Seal',
                ]}
              >
                <div className="p-6 md:p-8 bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-50/40 via-white to-indigo-50/30 rounded-2xl border-2 border-amber-300 text-center space-y-4 my-2">
                  {selectedCert.photoUrl && (
                    <div className="flex justify-center">
                      <img
                        src={selectedCert.photoUrl}
                        alt={selectedCert.studentName}
                        className="w-20 h-20 rounded-2xl object-cover border-2 border-amber-400 shadow-md"
                      />
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <p className="text-xs uppercase font-extrabold tracking-widest text-amber-800">
                    This is to proudly certify that
                  </p>

                  <h2 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight font-serif uppercase">
                    {selectedCert.studentName}
                  </h2>

                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 max-w-lg mx-auto leading-relaxed">
                    Son / Daughter of <strong className="text-slate-900">{selectedCert.fatherName || 'Guardian'}</strong>, bearing official Institutional Roll Number{' '}
                    <strong className="text-indigo-700 font-mono">{selectedCert.rollNo}</strong>, has successfully been enrolled in{' '}
                    <strong className="text-slate-900">{selectedCert.class}</strong>.
                  </p>

                  {selectedCert.achievement && (
                    <div className="p-3 bg-amber-100/70 border border-amber-300 rounded-xl inline-block max-w-md text-xs font-bold text-amber-950">
                      &ldquo;{selectedCert.achievement}&rdquo;
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {selectedCert.fileUrl && (
                    <div className="p-3 bg-white/90 border border-indigo-200 rounded-2xl inline-flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-left max-w-md mx-auto shadow-xs">
                      <FileText className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600 shrink-0" />
                      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
