                      onChange={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        toggleSelect(item.id);
                      }}
                      className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-emerald-600 cursor-pointer"
                    />
                    <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs font-black bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 rounded-lg">
                      {item.voucherNo}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <span
                    className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-black rounded-full uppercase ${
                      item.status === 'Paid'
                        ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                        : item.status === 'Unpaid'
                        ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800'
                        : 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {item.status}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <h3 className="mt-2 text-base font-extrabold text-slate-900">{item.studentName}</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-mono">Roll: {item.rollNo} &bull; {item.batch}</p>

                <div className="mt-4 p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80 space-y-1.5 text-xs">
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span className="text-slate-400">Fee Head / Month:</span>
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-800">{item.feeHead} ({item.month})</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span className="text-slate-400">Payment Mode:</span>
                    <span className="font-medium text-slate-700">{item.paymentMethod}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="pt-1.5 border-t border-slate-200 flex justify-between font-mono">
                    <span className="text-slate-500 font-sans font-semibold">Net Payable:</span>
                    <span className="font-black text-emerald-700 text-sm">PKR {item.netPayable.toLocaleString()}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-400">
                <span className="truncate max-w-[160px]">Officer: {item.collectedBy}</span>

                {/* Edit & Delete Actions */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={(e) => handleOpenEdit(item, e)}
                    className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-50 rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                    title="Edit / Modify Voucher"
                  >
                    <Edit2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={(e) => handleDelete(item.id, e)}
                    className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                    title="Delete Voucher"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      </>
      )}

      {/* ISSUE / EDIT VOUCHER MODAL */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isAddModalOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsAddModalOpen(false);
          setIsEditMode(false);
          setEditingVoucherId(null);
        }}
        title={isEditMode ? 'Edit / Modify Fee Voucher' : 'Issue Fee Voucher / Bank Challan'}
        subtitle="Generates institutional voucher reference VCH-26-XXX"
        badge={isEditMode ? 'MODIFY' : 'FEE VOUCHER'}
        maxWidth="max-w-3xl"
      >
        <form onSubmit={handleSaveVoucher} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Candidate Student *
              </label>
              <select
                value={studentRoll}
                onChange={(e) => setStudentRoll(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none bg-white font-mono"
              >
                {state.students.map((s) => (
                  <option key={s.id} value={s.rollNo}>
                    {s.rollNo} - {s.name} ({s.classBatch})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Billing Month *
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={month}
                onChange={(e) => setMonth(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. October 2026"
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none font-bold"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Fee Head</label>
              <select
                value={feeHead}
                onChange={(e) => setFeeHead(e.target.value as FeeVoucher['feeHead'])}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none bg-white font-medium"
              >
                <option value="Monthly">Monthly Tuition</option>
                <option value="Admission">Admission Fee</option>
                <option value="Exam">Exam Fee</option>
                <option value="Library">Library Caution</option>
                <option value="Lab">Lab Practical Fee</option>
                <option value="Annual">Annual Sports/Gala</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Payment Method</label>
              <select
                value={paymentMethod}
                onChange={(e) => setPaymentMethod(e.target.value as FeeVoucher['paymentMethod'])}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none bg-white font-medium"
              >
                <option value="Cash">Cash at Counter</option>
                <option value="Bank Transfer">Bank Deposit / Transfer</option>
                <option value="EasyPaisa">EasyPaisa</option>
                <option value="JazzCash">JazzCash</option>
                <option value="Cheque">Bank Cheque</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Status</label>
              <select
                value={status}
                onChange={(e) => setStatus(e.target.value as FeeVoucher['status'])}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none bg-white font-bold"
              >
                <option value="Paid">Paid</option>
                <option value="Unpaid">Unpaid</option>
                <option value="Partial">Partial</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 mb-1">Base Amount (PKR)</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={0}
                value={amount}
                onChange={(e) => setAmount(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 mb-1">Discount (PKR)</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={0}
                value={discount}
                onChange={(e) => setDiscount(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold text-rose-600"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 mb-1">Late Fine (PKR)</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={0}
                value={fine}
                onChange={(e) => setFine(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold text-amber-600"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 mb-1">Net Total (PKR)</label>
              <div className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-black text-emerald-800">
                PKR {netPayable.toLocaleString()}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="pt-3 flex justify-end gap-2 border-t border-slate-100">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setIsAddModalOpen(false);
                setIsEditMode(false);
                setEditingVoucherId(null);
              }}
              className="px-4 py-2 border border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl cursor-pointer"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="px-5 py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white text-xs font-black rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-emerald-600/30 cursor-pointer"
            >
              {isEditMode ? 'Update Voucher' : 'Generate Voucher'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Modal>

      {/* DETAIL MODAL + OFFICIAL SINGLE VOUCHER PRINT & PDF DOWNLOAD */}
      {selectedVoucher && (
        <Modal
          isOpen={Boolean(selectedVoucher)}
          onClose={() => setSelectedVoucher(null)}
          title={`Official Fee Voucher: ${selectedVoucher.voucherNo}`}
          subtitle={`Student: ${selectedVoucher.studentName} • ${selectedVoucher.month}`}
          badge={selectedVoucher.status}
          maxWidth="max-w-4xl"
        >
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div id="single-fee-voucher">
              <LetterheadPrint
                title="OFFICIAL INSTITUTIONAL TUITION FEE RECEIPT"
                documentNo={selectedVoucher.voucherNo}
                signatures={[
                  'Accounts Officer (Cashier)',
                  'Student / Guardian Copy',
                  'Auditor / Principal Seal',
                ]}
              >
                <div className="space-y-4 text-xs">
                  <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-slate-400 block font-semibold text-[10px]">STUDENT NAME</span>
                      <strong className="text-slate-900 text-sm uppercase">{selectedVoucher.studentName}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-slate-400 block font-semibold text-[10px]">ROLL NUMBER</span>
                      <strong className="text-indigo-700 font-mono text-sm">{selectedVoucher.rollNo}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-slate-400 block font-semibold text-[10px]">CLASS / BATCH</span>
                      <strong className="text-slate-900">{selectedVoucher.batch}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-slate-400 block font-semibold text-[10px]">FEE HEAD / MONTH</span>
                      <strong className="text-slate-900">{selectedVoucher.feeHead} ({selectedVoucher.month})</strong>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Fee Breakdown Table */}
                  <table className="w-full border-collapse border border-slate-300 text-left">
                    <thead>
                      <tr className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 font-bold">
                        <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Item Description</th>
                        <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right">Amount (PKR)</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      <tr>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-semibold">Base Tuition Charge</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right font-mono">
                          PKR {selectedVoucher.amount.toLocaleString()}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                      {selectedVoucher.discount > 0 && (
                        <tr>
                          <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-rose-700 font-semibold">
                            Scholarship / Sibling Concession
                          </td>
                          <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right font-mono text-rose-700 font-bold">
                            -PKR {selectedVoucher.discount.toLocaleString()}
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      )}
                      {selectedVoucher.fine > 0 && (
                        <tr>
                          <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-amber-700 font-semibold">
                            Late Deposit Fine
                          </td>
                          <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right font-mono text-amber-700 font-bold">
                            +PKR {selectedVoucher.fine.toLocaleString()}
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      )}
                      <tr className="bg-slate-50 font-bold">
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 uppercase">Net Amount Deposited</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right font-mono font-black text-emerald-800 text-sm">
                          PKR {selectedVoucher.netPayable.toLocaleString()}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    </tbody>
                  </table>

                  <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 flex justify-between items-center text-[11px]">
                    <div>
                      Payment Instrument: <strong>{selectedVoucher.paymentMethod}</strong> &bull; Received by:{' '}
                      <strong>{selectedVoucher.collectedBy}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div className="font-mono text-slate-500">
                      Status:{' '}
                      <span className="font-bold text-emerald-700 uppercase">{selectedVoucher.status}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </LetterheadPrint>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => triggerBrowserPrint()}
                  className="px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold hover:bg-indigo-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-md"
                >
                  <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Print Fee Voucher
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => downloadElementAsPdf('single-fee-voucher', `Voucher_${selectedVoucher.voucherNo}`)}
                  className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-800 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold hover:bg-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-md"
                >
                  <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Download PDF
                </button>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelectedVoucher(null)}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold hover:bg-slate-200 cursor-pointer"
              >
                Close
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {/* PRINT ALL MODAL (Print + PDF Download) */}
      {isPrintAllOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-md p-4 no-print overflow-y-auto">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-4xl w-full p-6 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-slate-200 mb-4">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-slate-900">Fee Invoices & Collection Ledger (A4)</h3>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => triggerBrowserPrint()}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-indigo-700 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  Print A4
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => downloadElementAsPdf('fees-print-table', 'TaleemOS_Fee_Collection_Report')}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-800 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  PDF Download
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsPrintAllOpen(false)}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800"
                >
                  Close
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div id="fees-print-table">
              <LetterheadPrint
                title="INSTITUTIONAL FEE INVOICES & COLLECTION AUDIT LEDGER"
                documentNo="FEE-AUDIT-2026"
                summaryStats={[
                  { label: 'Total Invoices', value: state.fees.length },
                  { label: 'Collected Revenue', value: `PKR ${totalPaidRevenue.toLocaleString()}` },
                  { label: 'Pending Dues', value: `PKR ${totalUnpaidDues.toLocaleString()}` },
                ]}
              >
                <table className="w-full border-collapse border border-slate-300 text-left text-xs">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 font-bold">
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Voucher No</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Roll No</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Student Name</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Month</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Head</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Net Amount</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Status</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {(selectedIds.length > 0 ? filtered.filter((f) => selectedIds.includes(f.id)) : filtered).map((f) => (
                      <tr key={f.id}>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-mono font-bold text-indigo-700">
                          {f.voucherNo}
                        </td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-mono">{f.rollNo}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-bold">{f.studentName}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2">{f.month}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2">{f.feeHead}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-mono font-bold text-emerald-800">
                          PKR {f.netPayable.toLocaleString()}
                        </td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-bold">{f.status}</td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </LetterheadPrint>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* BATCH PRINT CONCATENATED FEE CHALLANS MODAL */}
      {isBatchChallanPrintOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-md p-4 no-print overflow-y-auto">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl max-w-4xl w-full p-6 max-h-[92vh] overflow-y-auto shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-slate-200 mb-6 gap-3">
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <h3 className="font-black text-lg text-slate-900">
                    Concatenated Batch Print ({selectedIds.length} Fee Challans)
                  </h3>
                  <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700">
                    Multi-Page A4 PDF
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                  Each selected student voucher is rendered as a formal bank & student fee challan with official academy header and footer separated by page breaks.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => triggerBrowserPrint()}
                  className="px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 active:scale-95 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-md transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Print Concatenated PDF
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() =>
                    downloadElementAsPdf(
                      'batch-fee-concatenated-challans',
                      `Batch_Fee_Challans_${selectedIds.length}_Students`
                    )
                  }
                  className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 active:scale-95 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
                  PDF File
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsBatchChallanPrintOpen(false)}
                  className="p-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-xl transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <X className="w-5 h-5" />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Concatenated Challan Container */}
            <div id="batch-fee-concatenated-challans" className="space-y-8">
              {(selectedIds.length > 0
                ? state.fees.filter((f) => selectedIds.includes(f.id))
                : filtered
              ).map((voucher, index, arr) => (
                <div
                  key={voucher.id}
                  className={`fee-challan-card avoid-break ${
                    index < arr.length - 1 ? 'page-break' : ''
                  }`}
                >
                  <UnifiedPrintLayout
                    title="OFFICIAL INSTITUTIONAL TUITION FEE CHALLAN"
                    subtitle={`Billing Month: ${voucher.month} • Head: ${voucher.feeHead} • ${voucher.batch}`}
                    documentNo={voucher.voucherNo}
                    watermarkText="OFFICIAL FEE CHALLAN"
                    signatures={[
                      'Accounts Officer (Cashier)',
                      'Bank / Receiving Stamp',
                      'Principal / Auditor Seal',
                    ]}
                  >
                    <div className="space-y-4 text-xs">
                      {/* Candidate & Voucher Info Header */}
                      <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50/80 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
                        <div>
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase block">Student Name</span>
                          <strong className="text-slate-900 text-sm uppercase">{voucher.studentName}</strong>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase block">Roll Number</span>
                          <strong className="text-indigo-700 font-mono text-sm">{voucher.rollNo}</strong>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase block">Class / Batch</span>
                          <strong className="text-slate-900">{voucher.batch}</strong>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase block">Voucher Reference</span>
                          <strong className="text-slate-900 font-mono">{voucher.voucherNo}</strong>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Fee Breakdown Detailed Table */}
                      <table className="w-full border-collapse border border-slate-300 text-left">
                        <thead>
                          <tr className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 font-bold">
                            <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2.5">Billing Description / Account Head</th>
                            <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2.5 text-center w-28">Status</th>
                            <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2.5 text-right w-36">Amount (PKR)</th>
                          </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody>
                          <tr>
                            <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2.5 font-semibold">
                              Base Tuition Fee ({voucher.month})
                            </td>
                            <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2.5 text-center font-bold text-slate-600">
                              Billed
                            </td>
                            <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2.5 text-right font-mono font-bold">
                              PKR {voucher.amount.toLocaleString()}
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                          {voucher.discount > 0 && (
                            <tr>
                              <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2.5 text-rose-700 font-semibold">
                                Sibling / Merit Scholarship Concession
                              </td>
                              <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2.5 text-center font-bold text-rose-600">
                                Concession
                              </td>
                              <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2.5 text-right font-mono text-rose-700 font-bold">
                                -PKR {voucher.discount.toLocaleString()}
                              </td>
                            </tr>
                          )}
                          {voucher.fine > 0 && (
                            <tr>
                              <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2.5 text-amber-700 font-semibold">
                                Late Payment Surcharge / Fine
                              </td>
                              <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2.5 text-center font-bold text-amber-600">
                                Fine
                              </td>
                              <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2.5 text-right font-mono text-amber-700 font-bold">
                                +PKR {voucher.fine.toLocaleString()}
                              </td>
                            </tr>
                          )}
                          <tr className="bg-slate-50 font-bold">
                            <td colSpan={2} className="border border-slate-300 p-2.5 uppercase tracking-wide">
                              Total Net Payable Amount
                            </td>
                            <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2.5 text-right font-mono font-black text-emerald-800 text-base">
                              PKR {voucher.netPayable.toLocaleString()}
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        </tbody>
                      </table>

                      {/* Payment Verification Block */}
                      <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs">
                        <div>
                          <span>Payment Method: <strong className="text-slate-900">{voucher.paymentMethod}</strong></span>
                          <span className="mx-2">&bull;</span>
                          <span>Issued By: <strong className="text-slate-900">{voucher.collectedBy}</strong></span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-mono">
                          <span className="text-slate-500">Status:</span>
                          <span
                            className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-black uppercase ${
                              voucher.status === 'Paid'
                                ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-300'
                                : 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border border-rose-300'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {voucher.status}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* 2-Part Tear-Off: Bank Copy vs Student Copy Notice */}
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 pt-2">
                        <div className="p-3 border border-dashed border-slate-300 rounded-xl bg-white text-[10px] space-y-1">
                          <div className="font-bold text-slate-800 uppercase flex items-center justify-between">
                            <span>PART A: BANK / OFFICE RECORD</span>
                            <span className="font-mono text-indigo-700">{voucher.voucherNo}</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-slate-500">
                            Deposited at fee collection counter or authorized partner bank branch.
                          </p>
                          <div className="pt-3 flex justify-between text-slate-400 font-mono">
                            <span>Cashier Sign: ________</span>
                            <span>Date: ________</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="p-3 border border-dashed border-slate-300 rounded-xl bg-white text-[10px] space-y-1">
                          <div className="font-bold text-slate-800 uppercase flex items-center justify-between">
                            <span>PART B: STUDENT / GUARDIAN COPY</span>
                            <span className="font-mono text-indigo-700">{voucher.voucherNo}</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-slate-500">
                            Retain this receipt for clearance at term-end and roll number slip collection.
                          </p>
                          <div className="pt-3 flex justify-between text-slate-400 font-mono">
                            <span>Received Stamp: ________</span>
                            <span>Seal: ________</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </UnifiedPrintLayout>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default FeesModule;


==================== FILE: src/modules/IdCardsModule.tsx ====================
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  IdCard,
  Printer,
  Download,
  Filter,
  Search,
  QrCode,
  CheckSquare,
  Square,
  X,
  UploadCloud,
  Camera,
  CheckCircle2,
  Image as ImageIcon,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { erpStorage, INSTITUTIONS } from '../lib/storage';
import { triggerBrowserPrint, downloadElementAsPdf } from '../lib/pdf';
import { getCurrentUser } from '../components/auth/AuthSystem';
import { CloudinaryUploader } from '../components/common/CloudinaryUploader';
import { Modal } from '../components/common/Modal';
import { uploadToCloudinary } from '../lib/cloudinary';

export const IdCardsModule: React.FC = () => {
  const state = erpStorage.getState();
  const currentUser = getCurrentUser();
  const isDev = currentUser?.role === 'developer';

  const [batchFilter, setBatchFilter] = useState('All');
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [showAssetModal, setShowAssetModal] = useState(false);
  const [customLogoUrl, setCustomLogoUrl] = useState<string>(() => {
    return localStorage.getItem('taleemos_academy_logo') || '';
  });
  const [editingStudent, setEditingStudent] = useState<{ id: string; name: string; photoUrl: string } | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const activeInst =
    INSTITUTIONS.find((i) => i.id === state.activeInstitutionId) || INSTITUTIONS[0];

  const resolvedAcademyName: string = (isDev
    ? (state.activeInstitutionId === 'all' ? 'All Academies Network' : activeInst?.academyName || activeInst?.name || 'Taleem Academy')
    : (currentUser?.academyName || activeInst?.academyName || activeInst?.name || 'Taleem Academy')) || 'Taleem Academy';

  const resolvedCode = activeInst?.code || 'TAK-01';

  const emblemInitials = resolvedAcademyName
    .split(' ')
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((w) => w[0] || '')
    .join('')
    .toUpperCase() || 'TA';

  const filteredStudents = state.students.filter((s) => {
    const matchSearch =
      s.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      s.rollNo.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      s.fatherName.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase());
    const matchBatch = batchFilter === 'All' || s.classBatch === batchFilter;
    return matchSearch && matchBatch;
  });

  const displayedStudents =
    selectedIds.length > 0
      ? filteredStudents.filter((s) => selectedIds.includes(s.id))
      : filteredStudents;

  const toggleSelect = (id: string) => {
    setSelectedIds((prev) =>
      prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((i) => i !== id) : [...prev, id]
    );
  };

  const toggleSelectAll = () => {
    if (selectedIds.length === filteredStudents.length && filteredStudents.length > 0) {
      setSelectedIds([]);
    } else {
      setSelectedIds(filteredStudents.map((s) => s.id));
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="rounded-[24px] bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-indigo-950 to-slate-900 p-6 text-white shadow-xl flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 no-print">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 bg-indigo-600 rounded-xl">
              <IdCard className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
            </span>
            <h1 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-black tracking-tight">Student ID Cards Generator</h1>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 font-black text-[10px] rounded uppercase">
              A4 8-UP PRO
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-indigo-200 mt-1">
            Printable 8 cards per standard A4 sheet for <strong className="text-white">{resolvedAcademyName}</strong> with QR code and barcode.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => triggerBrowserPrint()}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-black rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
            Print 8-Card Sheet (A4)
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() =>
              downloadElementAsPdf(
                'id-cards-sheet',
                `${resolvedAcademyName.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_')}_Student_ID_Cards`
              )
            }
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl border border-white/20 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
            Download PDF
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filter and Multi-Select row */}
      <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[22px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 no-print">
        <div className="relative flex-1 w-full">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3.5 top-3 text-slate-400" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Filter cards by student name, roll number, or father..."
            className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-800 placeholder-slate-400 outline-none"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs shrink-0">
          <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase">Batch:</span>
          <select
            value={batchFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setBatchFilter(e.target.value)}
            className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium outline-none"
          >
            <option value="All">All Batches</option>
            {state.batches.map((b) => (
              <option key={b.id} value={b.batchName}>
                {b.batchName}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={toggleSelectAll}
            className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
          >
            {selectedIds.length === filteredStudents.length && filteredStudents.length > 0 ? (
              <CheckSquare className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600" />
            ) : (
              <Square className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
            )}
            <span>
              {selectedIds.length === filteredStudents.length && filteredStudents.length > 0
                ? 'Deselect All'
                : `Select All (${filteredStudents.length})`}
            </span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 8-Card Printable Grid (A4 layout) */}
      <div id="id-cards-sheet" className="p-4 md:p-6 bg-slate-100 rounded-[22px] print:bg-white print:p-0">
        <div className="text-center mb-4 print:hidden flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
          <span>
            Displaying {displayedStudents.length} cards {selectedIds.length > 0 && `(Filtered to ${selectedIds.length} selected)`}
          </span>
          {selectedIds.length > 0 && (
            <button
              onClick={() => setSelectedIds([])}
              className="text-indigo-600 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1"
            >
              <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Show All Cards</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 print:grid-cols-2 print:gap-3 max-w-[800px] mx-auto">
          {displayedStudents.map((s) => {
            const isSelected = selectedIds.includes(s.id);
            return (
              <div
                key={s.id}
                className={`w-full bg-white rounded-2xl border-2 shadow-md p-4 flex flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden relative print:shadow-none print:border print:border-slate-800 print:page-break-inside-avoid print:rounded-xl ${
                  isSelected ? 'border-indigo-600 ring-2 ring-indigo-500/30' : 'border-indigo-900/40'
                }`}
              >
                {/* Card top banner */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-indigo-900/20 pb-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={isSelected}
                      onChange={() => toggleSelect(s.id)}
                      className="w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded text-indigo-600 cursor-pointer no-print shrink-0"
                    />
                    {customLogoUrl ? (
                      <img
                        src={customLogoUrl}
                        alt="Academy Crest"
                        className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg object-contain bg-white border border-slate-200 shrink-0"
                      />
                    ) : (
                      <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-indigo-950 text-white font-black text-xs flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                        {emblemInitials}
                      </div>
                    )}
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <h5 className="text-[11px] font-black tracking-tight text-slate-900 uppercase leading-none truncate max-w-[170px]">
                        {resolvedAcademyName}
                      </h5>
                      <span className="text-[8px] font-semibold text-indigo-700">Code: {resolvedCode}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200 text-indigo-800 text-[8px] font-black rounded uppercase shrink-0">
                    STUDENT ID
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Card Body */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 my-2.5">
                  <div className="relative group/pic shrink-0">
                    <img
                      src={s.photoUrl}
                      alt={s.name}
                      className="w-16 h-16 rounded-xl object-cover border-2 border-indigo-600 shadow"
                    />
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() =>
                        setEditingStudent({
                          id: s.id,
                          name: s.name,
                          photoUrl: s.photoUrl,
                        })
                      }
                      className="no-print absolute inset-0 bg-slate-950/60 opacity-0 group-hover/pic:opacity-100 rounded-xl text-white text-[9px] font-bold flex flex-col items-center justify-center transition cursor-pointer gap-0.5"
                      title="Update photo with Cloudinary"
                    >
                      <Camera className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>Change</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  <div className="text-xs min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <h4 className="font-black text-slate-900 text-sm leading-snug truncate">{s.name}</h4>
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 truncate">S/O {s.fatherName}</div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-indigo-800 font-bold mt-0.5 truncate">{s.classBatch}</div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-700 flex items-center justify-between mt-1">
                      <span>
                        Roll: <strong className="text-indigo-900">{s.rollNo}</strong>
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-rose-600 font-bold">Blood: {s.bloodGroup}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Card Footer with QR & Signature */}
                <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between text-[8px] text-slate-500">
                  {/* QR block */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <div className="w-8 h-8 bg-slate-900 p-0.5 text-white flex items-center justify-center rounded">
                      <QrCode className="w-7 h-7 text-white" />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <div className="font-mono text-[8px] text-slate-700 font-bold">Session 2026-27</div>
                      <div className="text-[7px] text-slate-400">Valid: Jun 2027</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="text-right">
                    <div className="w-16 border-b border-slate-400 border-dashed mb-0.5" />
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-700">Principal Sign</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ID CARD ASSETS MODAL (Cloudinary Logo / Crest) */}
      {showAssetModal && (
        <Modal
          isOpen={showAssetModal}
          onClose={() => setShowAssetModal(false)}
          title="ID Card Assets & Academy Logo"
          subtitle="Upload official crest and branding to Cloudinary (TaleemOS)"
          badge="CLOUDINARY ASSETS"
          maxWidth="max-w-lg"
        >
          <div className="space-y-4 text-xs">
            <CloudinaryUploader
              label="Official Academy Crest / Logo"
              description="Uploaded to Cloudinary (preset: TaleemOS). Applied across all 8-UP ID cards."
              value={customLogoUrl}
              accept="image/*"
              mode="image"
              folder="taleemos_branding"
              onUpload={(url) => {
                setCustomLogoUrl(url);
                localStorage.setItem('taleemos_academy_logo', url);
                setNotice('Official Academy Logo updated via Cloudinary!');
                setTimeout(() => setNotice(null), 3500);
              }}
            />

            {customLogoUrl && (
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center p-3 bg-slate-50 border rounded-xl">
                <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">Remove custom logo and revert to monogram:</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setCustomLogoUrl('');
                    localStorage.removeItem('taleemos_academy_logo');
                    setNotice('Reverted to monogram.');
                    setTimeout(() => setNotice(null), 3000);
                  }}
                  className="px-3 py-1 bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200 rounded-lg font-bold"
                >
                  Reset
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="pt-3 flex justify-end border-t">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowAssetModal(false)}
                className="px-5 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-bold rounded-xl shadow"
              >
                Done
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {/* UPDATE STUDENT PHOTO MODAL */}
      {editingStudent && (
        <Modal
          isOpen={Boolean(editingStudent)}
          onClose={() => setEditingStudent(null)}
          title={`Update ID Photo: ${editingStudent.name}`}
          subtitle="Instant Cloudinary upload for permanent student card record"
          badge="STUDENT ASSET"
          maxWidth="max-w-md"
        >
          <div className="space-y-4 text-xs">
            <CloudinaryUploader
              label="New Student Portrait"
              description="Upload high-res portrait to Cloudinary (h79njj6q)"
              value={editingStudent.photoUrl}
              accept="image/*"
              mode="image"
              previewShape="circle"
              folder="taleemos_students"
              onUpload={(url) => {
                erpStorage.updateItem('students', editingStudent.id, { photoUrl: url });
                setEditingStudent((prev) => (prev ? { ...prev, photoUrl: url } : null));
                setNotice(`Updated photo for ${editingStudent.name} via Cloudinary!`);
                setTimeout(() => setNotice(null), 3500);
              }}
            />

            <div className="pt-3 flex justify-end border-t">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setEditingStudent(null)}
                className="px-5 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-bold rounded-xl shadow"
              >
                Close & Save
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default IdCardsModule;


==================== FILE: src/modules/InventoryModule.tsx ====================
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Package,
  Plus,
  Printer,
  Download,
  Search,
  AlertTriangle,
  ArrowUpRight,
  ArrowDownLeft,
  Trash2,
  Edit2,
  CheckSquare,
  Square,
  X,
  CheckCircle2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { erpStorage } from '../lib/storage';
import { type InventoryItem } from '../types';
import { Modal } from '../components/common/Modal';
import { LetterheadPrint } from '../components/common/LetterheadPrint';
import { triggerBrowserPrint, downloadElementAsPdf } from '../lib/pdf';

export const InventoryModule: React.FC = () => {
  const state = erpStorage.getState();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState('All');
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [isAddModalOpen, setIsAddModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [editingItemId, setEditingItemId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isPrintAllOpen, setIsPrintAllOpen] = useState(false);
  const [actionNotice, setActionNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Form fields
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<InventoryItem['category']>('Stationery');
  const [currentStock, setCurrentStock] = useState(50);
  const [minimumThreshold, setMinimumThreshold] = useState(20);
  const [unit, setUnit] = useState('Pieces');
  const [costPerUnit, setCostPerUnit] = useState(150);
  const [location, setLocation] = useState('Main Store Cupboard B');

  const filtered = state.inventory.filter((item) => {
    const matchSearch =
      item.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      item.location.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase());
    const matchCat = categoryFilter === 'All' || item.category === categoryFilter;
    return matchSearch && matchCat;
  });

  const lowStockItems = state.inventory.filter((i) => i.currentStock <= i.minimumThreshold);

  const toggleSelect = (id: string) => {
    setSelectedIds((prev) =>
      prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((i) => i !== id) : [...prev, id]
    );
  };

  const toggleSelectAll = () => {
    if (selectedIds.length === filtered.length && filtered.length > 0) {
      setSelectedIds([]);
    } else {
      setSelectedIds(filtered.map((i) => i.id));
    }
  };

  const handleOpenEdit = (item: InventoryItem, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsEditMode(true);
    setEditingItemId(item.id);
    setName(item.name);
    setCategory(item.category);
    setCurrentStock(item.currentStock);
    setMinimumThreshold(item.minimumThreshold);
    setUnit(item.unit);
    setCostPerUnit(item.costPerUnit);
    setLocation(item.location);
    setIsAddModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSaveItem = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!name.trim()) return;

    if (isEditMode && editingItemId) {
      erpStorage.updateItem('inventory', editingItemId, {
        name,
        category,
        currentStock: Number(currentStock),
        minimumThreshold: Number(minimumThreshold),
        unit,
        costPerUnit: Number(costPerUnit),
        location,
        lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      });
      setActionNotice(`Updated inventory item: ${name}`);
    } else {
      const newItem: InventoryItem = {
        id: `INV-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,
        name,
        category,
        currentStock: Number(currentStock),
        minimumThreshold: Number(minimumThreshold),
        unit,
        costPerUnit: Number(costPerUnit),
        location,
        lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      };
      erpStorage.addItem('inventory', newItem);
      setActionNotice(`Stocked in item: ${name}`);
    }

    setIsAddModalOpen(false);
    setIsEditMode(false);
    setEditingItemId(null);
    setTimeout(() => setActionNotice(null), 3500);
  };

  const handleStockAdjust = (id: string, delta: number) => {
    const item = state.inventory.find((i) => i.id === id);
    if (!item) return;
    const newStock = Math.max(0, item.currentStock + delta);
    erpStorage.updateItem('inventory', id, {
      currentStock: newStock,
      lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
    });
  };

  const handleDelete = (id: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (confirm('Delete this inventory item?')) {
      erpStorage.deleteItem('inventory', id);
      setSelectedIds((prev) => prev.filter((i) => i !== id));
      setActionNotice('Item removed from inventory.');
      setTimeout(() => setActionNotice(null), 3000);
    }
  };

  const handleBulkDelete = () => {
    if (confirm(`Delete ${selectedIds.length} selected inventory items?`)) {
      selectedIds.forEach((id) => erpStorage.deleteItem('inventory', id));
      setSelectedIds([]);
      setActionNotice('Selected items deleted.');
      setTimeout(() => setActionNotice(null), 3000);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      {/* Toast Notice */}
      {actionNotice && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800 text-xs font-bold rounded-2xl animate-in fade-in flex items-center gap-2">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
          <span>{actionNotice}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Header */}
      <div className="rounded-[24px] bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-indigo-950 to-slate-900 p-6 text-white shadow-xl flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 bg-indigo-600 rounded-xl">
              <Package className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
            </span>
            <h1 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-black tracking-tight">Institutional Inventory & Stationery</h1>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-indigo-500 text-white font-black text-[10px] rounded uppercase">
              STOCK AUDIT
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-indigo-200 mt-1">
            Stationery reams, examination answer sheets, IT hardware, lab reagents, and automated low-stock warnings.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsPrintAllOpen(true)}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl border border-white/20 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
            Print Stock Ledger
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setIsEditMode(false);
              setEditingItemId(null);
              setIsAddModalOpen(true);
            }}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-black rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            Stock In Item
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Low stock alert banner */}
      {lowStockItems.length > 0 && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-300 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-amber-900 text-xs">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
            <div>
              <span className="font-bold">Low Stock Warning: </span>
              {lowStockItems.map((i) => `${i.name} (${i.currentStock} ${i.unit})`).join(', ')}
            </div>
          </div>
          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-amber-200 text-amber-900 font-bold rounded-lg shrink-0">
            Reorder Suggested
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Search & Checkbox Select Bar */}
      <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[22px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm space-y-3">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center gap-3">
          <div className="relative flex-1 w-full">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3.5 top-3 text-slate-400" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search items by name, category, or store location..."
              className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-800 placeholder-slate-400 outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={toggleSelectAll}
            className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer transition shrink-0"
          >
            {selectedIds.length === filtered.length && filtered.length > 0 ? (
              <CheckSquare className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600" />
            ) : (
              <Square className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
            )}
            <span>
              {selectedIds.length === filtered.length && filtered.length > 0
                ? 'Deselect All'
                : `Select All (${filtered.length})`}
            </span>
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs">
          <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mr-1">
            Category:
          </span>
          {['All', 'Stationery', 'IT Equipment', 'Furniture', 'Lab Consumable'].map((c) => (
            <button
              key={c}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setCategoryFilter(c)}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                categoryFilter === c
                  ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-sm'
                  : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'
              }`}
            >
              {c}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Floating Toolbar when selected */}
      {selectedIds.length > 0 && (
        <div className="p-3.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-900 to-slate-900 text-white rounded-2xl shadow-lg border border-indigo-500/40 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 animate-in fade-in">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold">
            <span className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded-lg font-mono">
              {selectedIds.length}
            </span>
            <span>Items Selected</span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsPrintAllOpen(true)}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Print Selected</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleBulkDelete}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-rose-600/80 hover:bg-rose-600 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Delete</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSelectedIds([])}
              className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-white rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Item Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        {filtered.map((item) => {
          const isLow = item.currentStock <= item.minimumThreshold;
          const isSelected = selectedIds.includes(item.id);
          return (
            <div
              key={item.id}
              className={`p-5 rounded-[22px] border shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg transition-all flex flex-col justify-between ${
                isSelected ? 'bg-indigo-50/70 border-indigo-400 ring-2 ring-indigo-400/40' : 'bg-white border-slate-200'
              }`}
            >
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={isSelected}
                      onChange={() => toggleSelect(item.id)}
                      className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-indigo-600 cursor-pointer"
                    />
                    <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 rounded-lg">
                      {item.category}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <span
                    className={`px-2 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase ${
                      isLow ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800' : 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {isLow ? 'Low Stock' : 'In Stock'}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <h3 className="mt-2 text-base font-extrabold text-slate-900">{item.name}</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-mono mt-0.5">Location: {item.location}</p>

                <div className="mt-4 p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block font-sans">Current Balance</span>
                    <span className={`text-base font-black ${isLow ? 'text-rose-600' : 'text-slate-900'}`}>
                      {item.currentStock} {item.unit}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-right">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block font-sans">Unit Price</span>
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-700">PKR {item.costPerUnit}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                {/* Stock In / Stock Out Quick Action Buttons */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleStockAdjust(item.id, 5)}
                    className="px-2 py-1 bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 font-bold rounded-lg text-[10px] flex items-center gap-0.5 cursor-pointer"
                    title="+5 Quick Stock In"
                  >
                    <ArrowDownLeft className="w-3 h-3" />
                    +5 In
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleStockAdjust(item.id, -5)}
                    className="px-2 py-1 bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 font-bold rounded-lg text-[10px] flex items-center gap-0.5 cursor-pointer"
                    title="-5 Quick Issue Out"
                  >
                    <ArrowUpRight className="w-3 h-3" />
                    -5 Out
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Edit & Delete Action Buttons */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={(e) => handleOpenEdit(item, e)}
                    className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-50 rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                    title="Edit / Modify Item"
                  >
                    <Edit2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={(e) => handleDelete(item.id, e)}
                    className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                    title="Delete Item"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* STOCK IN / EDIT MODAL */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isAddModalOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsAddModalOpen(false);
          setIsEditMode(false);
          setEditingItemId(null);
        }}
        title={isEditMode ? 'Edit / Modify Inventory Item' : 'Stock In New Inventory Item'}
        subtitle="Catalog supply consumables and threshold alert limits"
        badge={isEditMode ? 'MODIFY' : 'INVENTORY ENTRY'}
      >
        <form onSubmit={handleSaveItem} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Item Title *</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={name}
                onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. A4 Paper Box"
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none focus:border-indigo-600 font-bold"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Category</label>
              <select
                value={category}
                onChange={(e) => setCategory(e.target.value as InventoryItem['category'])}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none bg-white font-medium"
              >
                <option value="Stationery">Stationery</option>
                <option value="IT Equipment">IT Equipment</option>
                <option value="Furniture">Furniture</option>
                <option value="Sports">Sports Equipment</option>
                <option value="Lab Consumable">Lab Consumable</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Quantity Stocked</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={1}
                value={currentStock}
                onChange={(e) => setCurrentStock(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none font-mono font-bold"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Low Threshold</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={1}
                value={minimumThreshold}
                onChange={(e) => setMinimumThreshold(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none font-mono font-bold text-rose-600"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Unit of Measure</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={unit}
                onChange={(e) => setUnit(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Reams, Pieces, Packs"
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Cost Per Unit (PKR)</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={0}
                value={costPerUnit}
                onChange={(e) => setCostPerUnit(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none font-mono"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Storage Location</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={location}
                onChange={(e) => setLocation(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Admin Store Cupboard A1"
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="pt-3 flex justify-end gap-2 border-t border-slate-100">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setIsAddModalOpen(false);
                setIsEditMode(false);
                setEditingItemId(null);
              }}
              className="px-4 py-2 border border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl cursor-pointer"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="px-5 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-xs font-black rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 cursor-pointer"
            >
              {isEditMode ? 'Update Item' : 'Catalog Inventory'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Modal>

      {/* PRINT ALL MODAL (Print + PDF Download) */}
      {isPrintAllOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-md p-4 no-print overflow-y-auto">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-4xl w-full p-6 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-slate-200 mb-4">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-slate-900">Inventory Stock Audit Ledger (A4)</h3>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => triggerBrowserPrint()}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-indigo-700 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  Print A4
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => downloadElementAsPdf('inventory-print-table', 'TaleemOS_Inventory_Stock')}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-800 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  PDF Download
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsPrintAllOpen(false)}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800"
                >
                  Close
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div id="inventory-print-table">
              <LetterheadPrint
                title="INSTITUTIONAL ASSET & INVENTORY STOCK REPORT"
                documentNo="INV-AUDIT-2026"
                summaryStats={[
                  { label: 'Stock Items', value: state.inventory.length },
                  { label: 'Low Stock Alerts', value: lowStockItems.length },
                ]}

                <table className="w-full border-collapse border border-slate-300 text-left text-xs">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 font-bold">
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Item Name</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Category</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Location</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right">Current Stock</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right">Threshold</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right">Unit Price</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {(selectedIds.length > 0 ? filtered.filter((i) => selectedIds.includes(i.id)) : filtered).map((item) => (
                      <tr key={item.id}>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-bold">{item.name}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2">{item.category}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2">{item.location}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right font-mono font-bold">
                          {item.currentStock} {item.unit}
                        </td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right font-mono text-rose-600">
                          {item.minimumThreshold}
                        </td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right font-mono">PKR {item.costPerUnit}</td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </LetterheadPrint>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export const LeavesModule: React.FC = () => {
  const state = erpStorage.getState();
  const [isApplyModalOpen, setIsApplyModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isPrintAllOpen, setIsPrintAllOpen] = useState(false);

  // Form fields
  const [applicantType, setApplicantType] = useState<LeaveRequest['applicantType']>('Staff');
  const [applicantName, setApplicantName] = useState(state.userName);
  const [applicantId, setApplicantId] = useState('STF-03');
  const [leaveType, setLeaveType] = useState<LeaveRequest['leaveType']>('Casual');
  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState(new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]);
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState(new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]);
  const [totalDays, setTotalDays] = useState(1);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');

  const handleApplyLeave = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!reason.trim()) return;

    const leaveId = `LEV-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`;
    const newLeave: LeaveRequest = {
      id: leaveId,
      applicantType,
      applicantName,

      startDate,
      endDate,
