      reason,
      status: 'Pending',
      appliedDate: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
    };

    erpStorage.addItem('leaves', newLeave);

    // If staff leave, route to Principal approval queue
    const approvalReq: ApprovalRequest = {
      id: `APP-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,
      module: 'Staff Leave',
      recordId: leaveId,
      title: `${leaveType} Leave: ${applicantName} (${totalDays} Days)`,
      requestedBy: applicantName,
      requestedRole: state.activeRole,
      currentApproverRole: 'Principal',
      amountOrValue: `${totalDays} Days (${startDate} to ${endDate})`,
      status: 'Pending Approval',
      date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      reason,
      history: [
        {
          actor: applicantName,
          role: state.activeRole,
          action: 'Created',
          timestamp: new Date().toLocaleString(),
        },
      ],
    };
    erpStorage.addItem('approvals', approvalReq);

    setIsApplyModalOpen(false);
    setReason('');
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="rounded-[24px] bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-indigo-950 to-slate-900 p-6 text-white shadow-xl flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 bg-indigo-600 rounded-xl">
              <FileText className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
            </span>
            <h1 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-black tracking-tight">Leave Management ERP</h1>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-indigo-500 text-white font-black text-[10px] rounded uppercase">
              APPROVAL CHAIN
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-indigo-200 mt-1">
            Faculty & student leave applications, quota tracking, medical documents, and Principal authorization.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsPrintAllOpen(true)}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl border border-white/20 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
            Print Leave Ledger
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsApplyModalOpen(true)}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-black rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            Apply For Leave
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

        <h3 className="font-extrabold text-base text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
          <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
          Leave Applications & Institutional Sanctions
        </h3>

        <div className="space-y-3">
          {state.leaves.map((l) => (
            <div
              key={l.id}
              className="p-4 bg-slate-50 hover:bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 transition-all flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4"
            >

                  <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm">{l.applicantName}</h4>
                  <span className="px-2 py-0.2 bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 text-[10px] font-bold rounded">

                  </span>

                      l.status === 'Approved'
                        ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                        : l.status === 'Pending'
                        ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800'
                        : 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {l.status}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-600 flex items-center gap-3">

              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* APPLY FOR LEAVE MODAL */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isApplyModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsApplyModalOpen(false)}
        title="Submit Institutional Leave Application"
        subtitle="Automatic escalation to Principal office for sanctioning"

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Applicant Name</label>
              <input
                type="text"

              />
            </div>
            <div>

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { BookOpen, Plus, Printer, Download, Search, AlertTriangle, CheckCircle, UserCheck, BookMarked, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { erpStorage } from '../lib/storage';
import { type LibraryBook } from '../types';
import { Modal } from '../components/common/Modal';
import { LetterheadPrint } from '../components/common/LetterheadPrint';
import { triggerBrowserPrint, downloadElementAsPdf } from '../lib/pdf';

export const LibraryModule: React.FC = () => {
  const state = erpStorage.getState();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [isAddModalOpen, setIsAddModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isIssueModalOpen, setIsIssueModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isPrintAllOpen, setIsPrintAllOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedBook, setSelectedBook] = useState<LibraryBook | null>(null);

  // Form fields
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [author, setAuthor] = useState('');
  const [isbn, setIsbn] = useState('');
  const [rackNo, setRackNo] = useState('PHY-01-A');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState('Science');
  const [totalQuantity, setTotalQuantity] = useState(10);
  const [finePerDay, setFinePerDay] = useState(20);

  // Issue fields
  const [issueStudentName, setIssueStudentName] = useState(state.students[0]?.name || 'Muhammad Hamza Malik');
  const [issueRollNo, setIssueRollNo] = useState(state.students[0]?.rollNo || 'TAK-26-001');
  const [issueDueDate, setIssueDueDate] = useState('2026-11-10');

  const totalBooks = state.library.reduce((sum, b) => sum + b.totalQuantity, 0);
  const availableBooks = state.library.reduce((sum, b) => sum + b.availableQuantity, 0);
  const issuedBooks = totalBooks - availableBooks;

  const filtered = state.library.filter(
    (b) =>
      b.title.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      b.author.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      b.isbn.includes(search) ||
      b.rackNo.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())
  );

  const handleCreateBook = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!title.trim() || !author.trim()) return;

    const newBook: LibraryBook = {
      id: `LIB-0${state.library.length + 1}`,
      title,
      author,
      isbn: isbn || '978-0000000000',
      rackNo,
      category,
      totalQuantity: Number(totalQuantity),
      availableQuantity: Number(totalQuantity),
      finePerDay: Number(finePerDay),
    };

    erpStorage.addItem('library', newBook);
    setIsAddModalOpen(false);
    resetForm();
  };

  const resetForm = () => {
    setTitle('');
    setAuthor('');
    setIsbn('');
    setTotalQuantity(10);
  };

  const handleConfirmIssue = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedBook) return;

    if (selectedBook.availableQuantity <= 0) {
      alert('All copies of this title are currently issued out.');
      return;
    }

    const issuedRecord = {
      studentName: issueStudentName,
      rollNo: issueRollNo,
      issueDate: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      dueDate: issueDueDate,
    };

    const currentIssued = selectedBook.issuedTo || [];
    erpStorage.updateItem('library', selectedBook.id, {
      availableQuantity: selectedBook.availableQuantity - 1,
      issuedTo: [...currentIssued, issuedRecord],
    });

    setIsIssueModalOpen(false);
    setSelectedBook(null);
  };

  const handleDelete = (id: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (confirm('Delete this library book entry?')) {
      erpStorage.deleteItem('library', id);
      if (selectedBook?.id === id) setSelectedBook(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="rounded-[24px] bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-indigo-950 to-slate-900 p-6 text-white shadow-xl flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 bg-indigo-600 rounded-xl">
              <BookOpen className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
            </span>
            <h1 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-black tracking-tight">Institutional Library ERP</h1>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-indigo-500 text-white font-black text-[10px] rounded uppercase">
              CIRCULATION
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-indigo-200 mt-1">
            Book cataloging, rack locator, circulation issues, overdue alerts, and daily fine calculations.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsPrintAllOpen(true)}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl border border-white/20 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
            Print Catalog
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              resetForm();
              setIsAddModalOpen(true);
            }}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-black rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            Catalog Book
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* KPIs */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[20px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Total Volumes</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 font-mono mt-1">{totalBooks} Copies</div>
        </div>
        <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[20px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-600 uppercase">Available On Shelves</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-emerald-600 font-mono mt-1">{availableBooks} Copies</div>
        </div>
        <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[20px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-indigo-600 uppercase">Currently Borrowed</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-indigo-600 font-mono mt-1">{issuedBooks} Issued</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Search */}
      <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[22px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
        <div className="relative">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3.5 top-3 text-slate-400" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search books by title, author, ISBN barcode, or shelf rack..."
            className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-800 placeholder-slate-400 outline-none"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Book Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        {filtered.map((item) => (
          <div
            key={item.id}
            onClick={() => setSelectedBook(item)}
            className="p-5 bg-white rounded-[22px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between"
          >
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs font-black bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 rounded-lg">
                  {item.rackNo}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400">ISBN: {item.isbn}</span>
              </div>

              <h3 className="mt-2 text-base font-extrabold text-slate-900 leading-snug">{item.title}</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium">By {item.author}</p>

              <div className="mt-4 p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs font-mono">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase block font-sans">Available</span>
                  <span
                    className={`font-black ${
                      item.availableQuantity > 0 ? 'text-emerald-700' : 'text-rose-600'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {item.availableQuantity} of {item.totalQuantity}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase block font-sans">Overdue Fine</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-amber-700">PKR {item.finePerDay}/Day</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {item.issuedTo && item.issuedTo.length > 0 && (
                <div className="mt-3 text-[11px] bg-amber-50/70 border border-amber-200/70 p-2 rounded-lg text-amber-900">
                  <span className="font-bold">Borrowed By:</span> {item.issuedTo[0].studentName} (Due:{' '}
                  {item.issuedTo[0].dueDate})
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  setSelectedBook(item);
                  setIsIssueModalOpen(true);
                }}
                className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold hover:bg-indigo-700 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <BookMarked className="w-3 h-3" />
                Issue to Student
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={(e) => handleDelete(item.id, e)}
                className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* CATALOG BOOK MODAL */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isAddModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsAddModalOpen(false)}
        title="Catalog New Library Volume"
        subtitle="Register book into accession register with shelf locator"
        badge="ACCESSION"
      >
        <form onSubmit={handleCreateBook} className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Book Title *</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              required
              value={title}
              onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Full book title & edition"
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none focus:border-indigo-600"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Author *</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={author}
                onChange={(e) => setAuthor(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Author / Editor"
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">ISBN Number</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={isbn}
                onChange={(e) => setIsbn(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="978-XXXXXXXXXX"
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none font-mono"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Rack / Shelf Locator</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={rackNo}
                onChange={(e) => setRackNo(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. PHY-02-B"
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none font-mono"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Copies Quantity</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={1}
                value={totalQuantity}
                onChange={(e) => setTotalQuantity(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none font-mono font-bold"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Fine Per Day (PKR)</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={0}
                value={finePerDay}
                onChange={(e) => setFinePerDay(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none font-mono font-bold"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="pt-3 flex justify-end gap-2 border-t border-slate-100">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsAddModalOpen(false)}
              className="px-4 py-2 border border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl cursor-pointer"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="px-5 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-xs font-black rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 cursor-pointer"
            >
              Add to Catalog
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Modal>

      {/* ISSUE BOOK MODAL */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isIssueModalOpen && Boolean(selectedBook)}
        onClose={() => setIsIssueModalOpen(false)}
        title={`Issue Book: ${selectedBook?.title}`}
        subtitle="Assign lending record to student roll number"
        badge="CIRCULATION DESK"
      >
        <form onSubmit={handleConfirmIssue} className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Borrower Student *</label>
            <select
              value={issueRollNo}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setIssueRollNo(e.target.value);
                const s = state.students.find((stu) => stu.rollNo === e.target.value);
                if (s) setIssueStudentName(s.name);
              }}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none bg-white font-mono"
            >
              {state.students.map((s) => (
                <option key={s.id} value={s.rollNo}>
                  {s.rollNo} - {s.name} ({s.classBatch})
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Due Return Date *</label>
            <input
              type="date"
              required
              value={issueDueDate}
              onChange={(e) => setIssueDueDate(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none bg-white"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="p-3 bg-indigo-50 rounded-xl text-xs text-indigo-900">
            Overdue penalty rate: <strong>PKR {selectedBook?.finePerDay}/day</strong> after due date.
          </div>

          <div className="pt-3 flex justify-end gap-2 border-t border-slate-100">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsIssueModalOpen(false)}
              className="px-4 py-2 border border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl cursor-pointer"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="px-5 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-xs font-black rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 cursor-pointer"
            >
              Confirm Issue
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Modal>

      {/* PRINT ALL MODAL */}
      {isPrintAllOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-md p-4 no-print overflow-y-auto">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-4xl w-full p-6 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-slate-200 mb-4">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-slate-900">Library Accession Register (A4)</h3>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => triggerBrowserPrint()}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-indigo-700 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  Print A4
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => downloadElementAsPdf('library-print-table', 'TaleemOS_Library_Catalog')}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-800 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  PDF Download
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsPrintAllOpen(false)}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800"
                >
                  Close
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div id="library-print-table">
              <LetterheadPrint
                title="INSTITUTIONAL CENTRAL LIBRARY ACCESSION REGISTER"
                documentNo="LIB-REGISTER-2026"
                summaryStats={[
                  { label: 'Total Stock', value: totalBooks },
                  { label: 'Available', value: availableBooks },
                  { label: 'Issued Out', value: issuedBooks },
                ]}
              >
                <table className="w-full border-collapse border border-slate-300 text-left text-xs">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 font-bold">
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Shelf Rack</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Title</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Author</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">ISBN</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Total</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Available</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {filtered.map((b) => (
                      <tr key={b.id}>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-mono font-bold text-indigo-700">{b.rackNo}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-bold">{b.title}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2">{b.author}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-mono">{b.isbn}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-mono">{b.totalQuantity}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-mono font-bold text-emerald-700">
                          {b.availableQuantity}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </LetterheadPrint>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default LibraryModule;

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Users,
  Calendar,
  Clock,
  DollarSign,
  Award,
  Phone,
  MessageSquare,
  Printer,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  FileText,
  School,
  ArrowRight,
  ShieldCheck,
  Share2,
  Bell,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { erpStorage } from '../lib/storage';
import { type User } from '../components/auth/AuthSystem';
import { triggerBrowserPrint } from '../lib/pdf';

interface ParentPortalProps {
  user: User;
  onNavigate: (path: string) => void;
}

export const ParentPortal: React.FC<ParentPortalProps> = ({ user, onNavigate }) => {
  const state = erpStorage.getState();

  // Find linked student for this parent
  // Match by name or default to first student
  const student =
    state.students.find(
      (s) =>
        user.name.toLowerCase().includes(s.fatherName.toLowerCase()) ||
        user.email.toLowerCase().includes(s.name.toLowerCase().split(' ')[0])
    ) || state.students[0];

  // Child specific data
  const childFees = state.fees.filter((f) => f.rollNo === student.rollNo);
  const childAttendance = state.attendance.filter((a) => a.rollNo === student.rollNo);
  const childReport = state.reportCards.find((r) => r.rollNo === student.rollNo);
  const childTimetable = state.timetables.filter((t) => t.batch === student.classBatch);

  // Attendance stats
  const presentCount = childAttendance.filter((a) => a.status === 'P').length || 23;
  const absentCount = childAttendance.filter((a) => a.status === 'A').length || 1;
  const attRatio = Math.round((presentCount / (presentCount + absentCount)) * 100);

  // Fee dues
  const unpaidFee = childFees.find((f) => f.status === 'Unpaid' || f.status === 'Partial');
  const totalPaid = childFees.filter((f) => f.status === 'Paid').reduce((s, f) => s + f.netPayable, 0);

  // Contact administration via WhatsApp
  const handleWhatsAppDesk = () => {
    const msg = encodeURIComponent(
      `Assalam-o-Alaikum, I am ${user.name}, parent of ${student.name} (Roll # ${student.rollNo}). I am inquiring regarding their academic progress.`
    );
    window.open(`https://wa.me/923001234567?text=${msg}`, '_blank');
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Parent Hero Banner */}
      <div className="rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-indigo-950 to-slate-900 p-6 md:p-8 text-white shadow-xl border border-indigo-900/40 relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="absolute right-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-1/3 bg-radial from-amber-500/10 to-transparent pointer-events-none" />
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-5 relative z-10">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-amber-500/20 border-2 border-amber-400/40 flex items-center justify-center text-3xl font-black text-amber-300 shadow-md shrink-0">
              👨‍👩‍👧
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30">
                  Parent Guardian Portal
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                  {user.academyName || 'Taleem Academy Main Campus'}
                </span>
              </div>
              <h1 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-black tracking-tight">
                Guardian: {user.name}
              </h1>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-300 mt-0.5">
                Monitoring Ward: <b className="text-white">{student.name}</b> (Roll # {student.rollNo}) &bull; Class:{' '}
                <b>{student.classBatch}</b>
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 self-start md:self-auto">
            <button
              onClick={handleWhatsAppDesk}
              className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-emerald-950/40 transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Contact Academy</span>
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => onNavigate('fees')}
              className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2 border border-white/10 transition cursor-pointer"
            >
              <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-300" />
              <span>Fee Vouchers</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 4 Child Overview Cards */}
        <div className="mt-6 pt-5 border-t border-white/10 grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3 text-xs">
          <div className="p-3 bg-white/5 rounded-2xl border border-white/10">
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 block">Child Attendance</span>
            <span className="text-2xl font-black text-emerald-300 font-mono mt-1 block">
              {attRatio}%
            </span>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">{presentCount} Days Present &bull; {absentCount} Absent</span>
          </div>
          <div className="p-3 bg-white/5 rounded-2xl border border-white/10">
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 block">Latest Examination Grade</span>
            <span className="text-2xl font-black text-amber-300 font-mono mt-1 block">
              {childReport ? `Grade ${childReport.grade}` : 'Grade A+'}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">{childReport ? `Rank #${childReport.rank} Position` : 'Top Standings'}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="p-3 bg-white/5 rounded-2xl border border-white/10">
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 block">Current Fee Status</span>
            <span className={`text-xl font-black font-mono mt-1 block ${unpaidFee ? 'text-rose-400' : 'text-emerald-300'}`}>
              {unpaidFee ? `PKR ${unpaidFee.netPayable.toLocaleString()} Due` : 'All Paid'}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Total Cleared: PKR {totalPaid.toLocaleString()}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="p-3 bg-white/5 rounded-2xl border border-white/10">
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 block">Academic Stream</span>
            <span className="text-base font-extrabold text-white mt-1 block truncate">
              {student.course}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Section: {student.classBatch}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2-Column Parent Content Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Left Column: Academic Results & Timetable */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-6">
          {/* Child Report Card */}
          {childReport && (
            <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl border p-6 shadow-sm space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-extrabold text-base text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Award className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
                    Ward Academic Progress: {childReport.examType}
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                    Marks: {childReport.marksObtained}/{childReport.maxMarks} &bull; Percentage: {childReport.percentage}%
                  </p>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={() => triggerBrowserPrint()}
                  className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-100 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Print Report</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
                {childReport.subjectsBreakdown.map((s, idx) => (
                  <div key={idx} className="p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border text-center">
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 block truncate">{s.subject}</span>
                    <span className="text-lg font-black text-slate-900 font-mono mt-1 block">
                      {s.marks}/{s.max}
                    </span>
                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 mt-1 inline-block">
                      Grade {s.grade}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl border text-xs">
                <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 block mb-1">
                  Principal & Class Teacher Remarks:
                </span>
                <p className="text-slate-800 italic font-medium">&ldquo;{childReport.remarks}&rdquo;</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Child Class Schedule */}
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl border p-6 shadow-sm space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b">
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-extrabold text-base text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600" />
                  Ward Class Schedule & Dismissal Timings
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">{student.classBatch} Routine</p>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => onNavigate('timetable')}
                className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-800"
              >
                Full Grid
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2.5">
              {childTimetable.slice(0, 4).map((slot) => (
                <div
                  key={slot.id}
                  className="p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border flex items-center justify-between text-xs"
                >
                  <div>
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 block">{slot.subject}</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Instructor: {slot.teacher} &bull; Room: {slot.room}</span>
                  </div>
                  <span className="font-mono font-bold text-indigo-700 bg-indigo-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
                    {slot.timing}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Column: Fee Vouchers & Academy Notices */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-6">
          {/* Fee Vouchers & Payment Status */}
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl border p-6 shadow-sm space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b">
              <h3 className="font-extrabold text-base text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                Tuition Fee Vouchers
              </h3>
              <button
                onClick={() => onNavigate('fees')}
                className="text-xs text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-800 font-bold"
              >
                History
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3">
              {childFees.map((f) => (
                <div key={f.id} className="p-4 bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl border text-xs space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="font-mono font-bold text-indigo-700">{f.voucherNo}</span>
                    <span
                      className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold uppercase ${
                        f.status === 'Paid'
                          ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                          : 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {f.status}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-slate-600">{f.month} ({f.feeHead})</span>
                    <span className="font-mono font-black text-slate-900 text-sm">
                      PKR {f.netPayable.toLocaleString()}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="pt-2 border-t flex justify-between items-center">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                      Pay Mode: {f.paymentMethod}
                    </span>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => onNavigate('fees')}
                      className="px-3 py-1 bg-white border hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <Printer className="w-3 h-3" />
                      <span>Print Challan</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* School Broadcasts & Announcements */}
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl border p-6 shadow-sm space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b">
              <h3 className="font-extrabold text-base text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                <Bell className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600" />
                Institutional Notices
              </h3>
              <button
                onClick={() => onNavigate('alerts')}
                className="text-xs text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-800 font-bold"
              >
                All
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3">
              {state.alerts
                .filter((a) => {
                  const parentAcademyId = user.academyId || 'inst-1';
                  return a.academyId === parentAcademyId || a.academyId === 'all' || (!a.academyId && parentAcademyId === 'inst-1');
                })
                .slice(0, 3)
                .map((a) => (
                  <div key={a.id} className="p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border text-xs space-y-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">{a.title}</span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-400">{a.date}</span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-600">{a.message}</p>
                  </div>
                ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ParentPortal;

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { DollarSign, Plus, Printer, Download, Search, UserCheck, ShieldCheck, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { erpStorage } from '../lib/storage';
import { type PayrollRecord, type ApprovalRequest } from '../types';
import { Modal } from '../components/common/Modal';
import { LetterheadPrint } from '../components/common/LetterheadPrint';
import { triggerBrowserPrint, downloadElementAsPdf } from '../lib/pdf';

export const PayrollModule: React.FC = () => {
  const state = erpStorage.getState();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [isAddModalOpen, setIsAddModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedPayRecord, setSelectedPayRecord] = useState<PayrollRecord | null>(null);
  const [isPrintAllOpen, setIsPrintAllOpen] = useState(false);

  // Form fields
  const [staffName, setStaffName] = useState('Prof. Ghulam Rasool');
  const [designation, setDesignation] = useState('Director & Academic Dean');
  const [month, setMonth] = useState('October 2026');
  const [basicSalary, setBasicSalary] = useState(75000);
  const [allowances, setAllowances] = useState(10000);
  const [deductions, setDeductions] = useState(2000);
  const [paymentMethod, setPaymentMethod] = useState('Direct Bank Transfer');

  const netPay = Math.max(0, basicSalary + allowances - deductions);

  const totalPayroll = state.payroll.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.netPay, 0);

  const filtered = state.payroll.filter(
    (p) =>
      p.staffName.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      p.designation.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      p.month.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())
  );

  const handleCreatePayroll = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const payId = `PAY-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`;

    const newPay: PayrollRecord = {
      id: payId,
      staffName,
      designation,
      month,
      basicSalary: Number(basicSalary),
      allowances: Number(allowances),
      deductions: Number(deductions),
      netPay,
      status: 'Paid',
      paymentDate: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      paymentMethod,
    };

    erpStorage.addItem('payroll', newPay);
    setIsAddModalOpen(false);
  };

  const handleDelete = (id: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (confirm('Delete this payroll record?')) {
      erpStorage.deleteItem('payroll', id);
      if (selectedPayRecord?.id === id) setSelectedPayRecord(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="rounded-[24px] bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-indigo-950 to-slate-900 p-6 text-white shadow-xl flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 bg-indigo-600 rounded-xl">
              <DollarSign className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
            </span>
            <h1 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-black tracking-tight">Staff Salary & Payroll PRO</h1>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-indigo-500 text-white font-black text-[10px] rounded uppercase">
              PAYROLL SLIPS
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-indigo-200 mt-1">
            Faculty remuneration, basic pay structures, allowances, tax deductions, and official pay slips.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsPrintAllOpen(true)}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl border border-white/20 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
            Print Master Payroll
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsAddModalOpen(true)}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-black rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            Process Salary
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* KPI */}
      <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[22px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase">Total Net Staff Remuneration</span>
          <div className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-black text-indigo-700 font-mono mt-1">
            PKR {totalPayroll.toLocaleString()}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="text-right text-xs text-slate-400">
          <div>Disbursement Status: 100% Processed</div>
          <div className="font-bold text-emerald-600">Audited via TaleemOS Hub</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Search */}
      <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[22px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
        <div className="relative">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3.5 top-3 text-slate-400" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search salary records by staff name, designation, or month..."
            className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-800 placeholder-slate-400 outline-none"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Cards (Tappable to Detail Pay Slip) */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        {filtered.map((item) => (
          <div
            key={item.id}
            onClick={() => setSelectedPayRecord(item)}
            className="p-5 bg-white rounded-[22px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between"
          >
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 font-bold text-xs bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 rounded-lg">
                  {item.month}
                </span>
                <span
                  className={`px-2 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase ${
                    item.status === 'Paid'
                      ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                      : 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800'
                  }`}
                >
                  {item.status}
                </span>
              </div>

              <h3 className="mt-2 text-base font-extrabold text-slate-900">{item.staffName}</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">{item.designation}</p>

              <div className="mt-4 p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80 space-y-1 text-xs font-mono">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <span className="text-slate-400 font-sans">Basic Pay:</span>
                  <span>PKR {item.basicSalary.toLocaleString()}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between text-emerald-700">
                  <span className="text-slate-400 font-sans">Allowances:</span>
                  <span>+PKR {item.allowances.toLocaleString()}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between text-rose-600">
                  <span className="text-slate-400 font-sans">Deductions:</span>
                  <span>-PKR {item.deductions.toLocaleString()}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="pt-1.5 border-t border-slate-200 flex justify-between font-bold text-slate-900">
                  <span className="font-sans">Net Salary:</span>
                  <span className="text-indigo-700 font-black">PKR {item.netPay.toLocaleString()}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-400">
              <span className="font-mono text-[10px]">{item.paymentMethod}</span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={(e) => handleDelete(item.id, e)}
                className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* PROCESS SALARY MODAL */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isAddModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsAddModalOpen(false)}
        title="Process Staff Salary Disbursement"
        subtitle="Calculates gross compensation, tax/provident deductions, and net credit"
        badge="PAYROLL"
      >
        <form onSubmit={handleCreatePayroll} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Staff / Faculty Member *
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={staffName}
                onChange={(e) => setStaffName(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none focus:border-indigo-600"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Designation *
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={designation}
                onChange={(e) => setDesignation(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Salary Month</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={month}
                onChange={(e) => setMonth(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="October 2026"
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Payment Channel
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={paymentMethod}
                onChange={(e) => setPaymentMethod(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Direct Bank Transfer"
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 mb-1">Basic Salary (PKR)</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={0}
                value={basicSalary}
                onChange={(e) => setBasicSalary(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 mb-1">Allowances (PKR)</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={0}
                value={allowances}
                onChange={(e) => setAllowances(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold text-emerald-700"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 mb-1">Deductions (PKR)</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={0}
                value={deductions}
                onChange={(e) => setDeductions(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold text-rose-600"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 mb-1">Net Pay (PKR)</label>
              <div className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-black text-indigo-900">
                PKR {netPay.toLocaleString()}
              </div>
            </div>

          <div className="pt-3 flex justify-end gap-2 border-t border-slate-100">

              onClick={() => setIsAddModalOpen(false)}
              className="px-4 py-2 border border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl cursor-pointer"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="px-5 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-xs font-black rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 cursor-pointer"
            >
              Issue Pay Record

          </div>
        </form>

      {/* DETAIL MODAL + OFFICIAL PAY SLIP PRINT */}
      {selectedPayRecord && (

          subtitle={`Month: ${selectedPayRecord.month} • Designation: ${selectedPayRecord.designation}`}
          badge={selectedPayRecord.status}
          maxWidth="max-w-4xl"
        >
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div id="single-pay-slip">
              <LetterheadPrint
                title="OFFICIAL FACULTY & STAFF CONFIDENTIAL PAY SLIP"
                documentNo={selectedPayRecord.id}
                signatures={[
                  'Staff Signature / Acknowledgment',
                  'Accounts Officer (Prepared By)',
                  'Director Prof. Ghulam Rasool (Approved By)',
                ]}
              >
                <div className="space-y-4 text-xs">
                  <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-slate-400 block font-semibold text-[10px]">EMPLOYEE NAME</span>
                      <strong className="text-slate-900 text-sm uppercase">{selectedPayRecord.staffName}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-slate-400 block font-semibold text-[10px]">DESIGNATION</span>
                      <strong className="text-slate-900">{selectedPayRecord.designation}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-slate-400 block font-semibold text-[10px]">PAYROLL MONTH</span>
                      <strong className="text-indigo-700 font-bold">{selectedPayRecord.month}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-slate-400 block font-semibold text-[10px]">DISBURSEMENT METHOD</span>
                      <strong className="text-slate-900">{selectedPayRecord.paymentMethod}</strong>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <table className="w-full border-collapse border border-slate-300 text-left">
                    <thead>
                      <tr className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 font-bold">
                        <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Earnings Head</th>
                        <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right">Amount (PKR)</th>
                        <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Deductions Head</th>
                        <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right">Amount (PKR)</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      <tr>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-semibold">Basic Pay</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right font-mono">
                          PKR {selectedPayRecord.basicSalary.toLocaleString()}
                        </td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-rose-700 font-semibold">Income Tax / Provident</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right font-mono text-rose-700">
                          PKR {selectedPayRecord.deductions.toLocaleString()}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                      <tr>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-semibold text-emerald-700">
                          Special & Medical Allowances
                        </td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right font-mono text-emerald-700">
                          PKR {selectedPayRecord.allowances.toLocaleString()}
                        </td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-slate-400">Other Deductions</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right font-mono text-slate-400">PKR 0</td>
                      </tr>
                      <tr className="bg-slate-50 font-bold">
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 uppercase">Total Gross Remuneration</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right font-mono text-indigo-900 font-black">
                          PKR {(selectedPayRecord.basicSalary + selectedPayRecord.allowances).toLocaleString()}
                        </td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 uppercase">Net Bank Credit Amount</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right font-mono text-emerald-800 font-black text-sm">
                          PKR {selectedPayRecord.netPay.toLocaleString()}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              </LetterheadPrint>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => triggerBrowserPrint()}
                  className="px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold hover:bg-indigo-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-md"
                >
                  <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Print Salary Slip
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => downloadElementAsPdf('single-pay-slip', `PaySlip_${selectedPayRecord.staffName}`)}
                  className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-800 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold hover:bg-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-md"
                >
                  <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Download PDF
                </button>
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelectedPayRecord(null)}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold hover:bg-slate-200 cursor-pointer"
              >
                Close
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {/* PRINT ALL MODAL */}
      {isPrintAllOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-md p-4 no-print overflow-y-auto">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-4xl w-full p-6 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-slate-200 mb-4">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-slate-900">Institutional Master Payroll Ledger (A4)</h3>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => triggerBrowserPrint()}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-indigo-700 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  Print A4
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => downloadElementAsPdf('payroll-print-table', 'TaleemOS_Payroll_Ledger')}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-800 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  PDF Download
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsPrintAllOpen(false)}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800"
                >
                  Close
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div id="payroll-print-table">
              <LetterheadPrint
                title="INSTITUTIONAL FACULTY & STAFF MASTER PAYROLL REGISTER"
                documentNo="PAY-REGISTER-2026"
                summaryStats={[
                  { label: 'Staff Count', value: state.payroll.length },
                  { label: 'Total Payroll', value: `PKR ${totalPayroll.toLocaleString()}` },
                ]}
              >
                <table className="w-full border-collapse border border-slate-300 text-left text-xs">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 font-bold">
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Staff Member</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Designation</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Month</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right">Basic</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right">Allowances</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right">Deductions</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right">Net Pay</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {filtered.map((p) => (
                      <tr key={p.id}>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-bold">{p.staffName}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2">{p.designation}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2">{p.month}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right font-mono">
                          PKR {p.basicSalary.toLocaleString()}
                        </td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right font-mono text-emerald-700">
                          PKR {p.allowances.toLocaleString()}
                        </td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right font-mono text-rose-700">
                          PKR {p.deductions.toLocaleString()}
                        </td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-right font-mono font-black text-indigo-900">
                          PKR {p.netPay.toLocaleString()}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </LetterheadPrint>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
