==================== FILE: src/modules/PromoteModule.tsx ====================
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { TrendingUp, CheckCircle, Clock, ShieldCheck, ArrowRight, UserCheck, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { erpStorage } from '../lib/storage';
import { type PromotionRecord, type ApprovalRequest } from '../types';
import { Modal } from '../components/common/Modal';

export const PromoteModule: React.FC = () => {
  const state = erpStorage.getState();
  const [selectedStudentId, setSelectedStudentId] = useState(state.students[0]?.id || '');
  const [targetBatch, setTargetBatch] = useState('2nd Year F.Sc Engineering');
  const [academicYear, setAcademicYear] = useState('2026-2027');
  const [remarks, setRemarks] = useState('');
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);

  const selectedStudent = state.students.find((s) => s.id === selectedStudentId);

  const handleCreatePromotion = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedStudent) return;

    const promoId = `PRO-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`;
    const newPromo: PromotionRecord = {
      id: promoId,
      studentId: selectedStudent.id,
      studentName: selectedStudent.name,
      currentClass: selectedStudent.classBatch,
      targetClass: targetBatch,
      academicYear,
      status: 'Pending',
      date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      approver: 'Principal Office',
      remarks: remarks || 'Eligible for session advancement.',
    };

    erpStorage.addItem('promotions', newPromo);

    // Queue in approvals
    const approvalReq: ApprovalRequest = {
      id: `APP-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,
      module: 'Student Promotion',
      recordId: promoId,
      title: `Promotion Approval: ${selectedStudent.name} (${selectedStudent.rollNo})`,
      requestedBy: state.userName,
      requestedRole: state.activeRole,
      currentApproverRole: 'Principal',
      amountOrValue: `Promote to ${targetBatch}`,
      status: 'Pending Approval',
      date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      reason: remarks || 'Annual examination qualification.',
      history: [
        {
          actor: state.userName,
          role: state.activeRole,
          action: 'Created',
          timestamp: new Date().toLocaleString(),
        },
      ],
    };
    erpStorage.addItem('approvals', approvalReq);

    setIsModalOpen(false);
    setRemarks('');
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="rounded-[24px] bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-indigo-950 to-slate-900 p-6 text-white shadow-xl flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 bg-indigo-600 rounded-xl">
              <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
            </span>
            <h1 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-black tracking-tight">Student Promotion Workflow</h1>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-indigo-500 text-white font-black text-[10px] rounded uppercase">
              PRINCIPAL APPROVAL
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-indigo-200 mt-1">
            Institutional cohort progression, academic prerequisites validation, and multi-tier approval governance.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(true)}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-black rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 transition-all cursor-pointer"
        >
          <UserCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
          Request Promotion
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Promotion requests list */}
      <div className="p-6 bg-white rounded-[22px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm space-y-4">
        <h3 className="font-extrabold text-base text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
          <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
          Promotion Queues & Historical Records
        </h3>

        <div className="space-y-3">
          {state.promotions.map((p) => (
            <div
              key={p.id}
              className="p-4 bg-slate-50 hover:bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 transition-all flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3"
            >
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="font-mono text-xs font-black text-indigo-700">{p.id}</span>
                  <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm">{p.studentName}</h4>
                  <span
                    className={`px-2 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase ${
                      p.status === 'Approved'
                        ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                        : p.status === 'Pending'
                        ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800'
                        : 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {p.status}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">{p.currentClass}</span>
                  <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600 shrink-0" />
                  <span className="font-bold text-indigo-900">{p.targetClass}</span>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 font-mono">({p.academicYear})</span>
                </div>
                {p.remarks && <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1 italic">&ldquo;{p.remarks}&rdquo;</p>}
              </div>

              <div className="text-right text-xs">
                <span className="text-slate-400 block font-semibold">Authorized By</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-slate-800">{p.approver}</span>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block font-mono">{p.date}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* REQUEST PROMOTION MODAL */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}
        title="Submit Student Promotion Proposal"
        subtitle="Routes to Principal Approval Queue before updating academic batch"
        badge="APPROVAL QUEUE"
      >
        <form onSubmit={handleCreatePromotion} className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
              Select Candidate Student *
            </label>
            <select
              value={selectedStudentId}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedStudentId(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none bg-white"
            >
              {state.students.map((s) => (
                <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>
                  {s.name} ({s.rollNo}) - Current: {s.classBatch}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Target Progression Class / Batch *
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={targetBatch}
                onChange={(e) => setTargetBatch(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. 2nd Year F.Sc Engineering"
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Target Academic Year
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={academicYear}
                onChange={(e) => setAcademicYear(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="2026-2027"
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none font-mono"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
              Academic Justification & Prerequisites
            </label>
            <textarea
              rows={3}
              value={remarks}
              onChange={(e) => setRemarks(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. Scored 88% in 1st year board exams; cleared all compulsory papers."
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="p-3 bg-amber-50 rounded-xl border border-amber-200 text-xs text-amber-800 flex items-center gap-2">
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
            <span>
              Per TaleemOS RBAC policy, promotions must be formally approved by Principal or Director.
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="pt-3 flex justify-end gap-2 border-t border-slate-100">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}
              className="px-4 py-2 border border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl cursor-pointer"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="px-5 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-xs font-black rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 cursor-pointer"
            >
              Submit to Principal
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
};

export default PromoteModule;


==================== FILE: src/modules/SettingsModule.tsx ====================
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Settings,
  Shield,
  Database,
  Building2,
  RefreshCw,
  Download,
  Upload,
  CheckCircle2,
  Terminal,
  Activity,
  Plus,
  Edit2,
  Trash2,
  Calendar,
  Type,
  AlertCircle,
  FileText,
  Sliders,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { erpStorage, INSTITUTIONS } from '../lib/storage';
import { type UserRole, type CustomFieldDefinition } from '../types';
import { isFirebaseConfigured } from '../lib/firebase';
import { CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME, CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_PRESET } from '../lib/cloudinary';
import {
  getCustomFieldsForAcademy,
  addCustomField,
  updateCustomField,
  deleteCustomField,
} from '../lib/customFields';
import { getCurrentUser } from '../components/auth/AuthSystem';
import { Modal } from '../components/common/Modal';

export const SettingsModule: React.FC = () => {
  const state = erpStorage.getState();
  const currentUser = getCurrentUser();
  const academyId = currentUser?.academyId || state.activeInstitutionId || 'inst-1';

  const [importStatus, setImportStatus] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Custom Fields State
  const [customFields, setCustomFields] = useState<CustomFieldDefinition[]>([]);
  const [isFieldModalOpen, setIsFieldModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingFieldId, setEditingFieldId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [fieldLabel, setFieldLabel] = useState('');
  const [fieldType, setFieldType] = useState<'text' | 'date'>('text');
  const [fieldPlaceholder, setFieldPlaceholder] = useState('');
  const [fieldRequired, setFieldRequired] = useState(false);
  const [fieldError, setFieldError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const loadFields = () => {
    setCustomFields(getCustomFieldsForAcademy(academyId));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadFields();
    const handleFieldChange = () => loadFields();
    window.addEventListener('taleemos_custom_fields_changed', handleFieldChange);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('taleemos_custom_fields_changed', handleFieldChange);
  }, [academyId]);

  const handleOpenAddField = () => {
    if (customFields.length >= 5) {
      alert('Maximum of 5 custom fields reached. Please delete an existing custom field first.');
      return;
    }
    setEditingFieldId(null);
    setFieldLabel('');
    setFieldType('text');
    setFieldPlaceholder('');
    setFieldRequired(false);
    setFieldError(null);
    setIsFieldModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenEditField = (field: CustomFieldDefinition) => {
    setEditingFieldId(field.id);
    setFieldLabel(field.label);
    setFieldType(field.type);
    setFieldPlaceholder(field.placeholder || '');
    setFieldRequired(Boolean(field.isRequired));
    setFieldError(null);
    setIsFieldModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSaveField = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setFieldError(null);

    if (!fieldLabel.trim()) {
      setFieldError('Field label cannot be empty.');
      return;
    }

    if (editingFieldId) {
      const res = updateCustomField(academyId, editingFieldId, {
        label: fieldLabel.trim(),
        type: fieldType,
        placeholder: fieldPlaceholder.trim(),
        isRequired: fieldRequired,
      });
      if (!res.success) {
        setFieldError(res.error || 'Failed to update field.');
        return;
      }
    } else {
      const res = addCustomField(academyId, {
        label: fieldLabel.trim(),
        type: fieldType,
        placeholder: fieldPlaceholder.trim(),
        isRequired: fieldRequired,
      });
      if (!res.success) {
        setFieldError(res.error || 'Failed to add field.');
        return;
      }
    }

    loadFields();
    setIsFieldModalOpen(false);
    setImportStatus(editingFieldId ? 'Custom student field updated!' : 'New custom student field added!');
    setTimeout(() => setImportStatus(null), 3500);
  };

  const handleDeleteField = (id: string, label: string) => {
    if (confirm(`Are you sure you want to delete custom student field "${label}"? Existing student values for this field will no longer be tracked.`)) {
      const res = deleteCustomField(academyId, id);
      if (res.success) {
        loadFields();
        setImportStatus(`Removed custom field "${label}".`);
        setTimeout(() => setImportStatus(null), 3000);
      } else {
        alert(res.error || 'Could not delete custom field.');
      }
    }
  };

  const rolesMatrix: {
    role: UserRole;
    description: string;
    permissions: string[];
  }[] = [
    {
      role: 'Super Admin',
      description: 'Full institutional authority, multi-tenant campus management, audit logs, backup and recovery.',
      permissions: ['Manage All Settings', 'All 23 Modules', 'Approve All High-Value Actions', 'Export/Import Backup'],
    },
    {
      role: 'Director / Owner',
      description: 'Executive governance, approve high admissions, fee discounts > 500, payroll sanction.',
      permissions: ['Approve Admissions', 'Approve Discounts > 500', 'Payroll Approval', 'Approve Expenses > 5000'],
    },
    {
      role: 'Principal',
      description: 'Chief Academic Officer, approves leaves, examinations, report cards, and student promotions.',
      permissions: ['Academic Approval', 'Staff Leave Sanction', 'Student Promotion', 'Marks Final Submit', 'View Finance'],
    },
    {
      role: 'Accountant',
      description: 'Financial ledger maintenance, fees collection, vouchers, defaulter follow-ups, and payroll.',
      permissions: ['Fee Invoices', 'Expense Records', 'Payroll Slip Processing', 'Defaulter Actions'],
    },
    {
      role: 'Teacher',
      description: 'Batch instructor, records student attendance for assigned cohorts, creates examination marks.',
      permissions: ['Assigned Batch Attendance', 'Marks Entry', 'Personal Timetable', 'Leave Request'],
    },
    {
      role: 'Receptionist / Front Desk',
      description: 'Campus reception, registers new enquiries and prospective admissions in pending status.',
      permissions: ['New Enquiries (Full)', 'Admissions (Pending Only)', 'Fee Collection (Pending)', 'No Deletions'],
    },
    {
      role: 'Student',
      description: 'Student portal profile, view own attendance ratio, fee vouchers, report card transcript, and books.',
      permissions: ['View Own Attendance', 'View Own Fees', 'Download Transcript', 'View Library Records'],
    },
    {
      role: 'Parent',
      description: 'Parent guardian portal, monitor child daily attendance, fee dues, notices, and exam results.',
      permissions: ['Monitor Child Attendance', 'Fee Arrears Reminders', 'Exam Report Card View'],
    },
  ];

  const handleExportBackup = () => {
    erpStorage.exportToJson();
  };

  const handleImportBackup = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
      const file = e.target.files[0];
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = (event) => {
        const text = event.target?.result as string;
        const ok = erpStorage.importFromJson(text);
        if (ok) {
          setImportStatus('Backup restored successfully! All records refreshed.');
          setTimeout(() => setImportStatus(null), 4000);
        } else {
          alert('Failed to parse backup JSON file. Ensure it is a valid TaleemOS export.');
        }
      };
      reader.readAsText(file);
    }
  };

  const handleResetData = () => {
    if (confirm('Reset entire system database to initial demo state? All custom records will be replaced.')) {
      erpStorage.resetToDemo();
      setImportStatus('Database reset to factory demo state.');
      setTimeout(() => setImportStatus(null), 4000);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="rounded-[24px] bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-indigo-950 to-slate-900 p-6 text-white shadow-xl flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 bg-indigo-600 rounded-xl">
              <Settings className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
            </span>
            <h1 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-black tracking-tight">System Settings & Governance</h1>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-indigo-500 text-white font-black text-[10px] rounded uppercase">
              RBAC & BACKUP
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-indigo-200 mt-1">
            Enterprise role-based permissions matrix, multi-tenant campus configuration, and JSON backup/restore.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleResetData}
            className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-rose-600/30 hover:bg-rose-600/50 text-rose-200 hover:text-white border border-rose-500/40 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            Reset to Demo Data
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {importStatus && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800 text-xs font-bold rounded-2xl animate-in fade-in flex items-center gap-2">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
          <span>{importStatus}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Cloud & Termux Configuration Overview */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        <div className="p-5 bg-white rounded-[22px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
              <Database className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600" />
              Firebase Database Integration

            <span
              className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase ${
                isFirebaseConfigured()
                  ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                  : 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800'
              }`}
            >
              {isFirebaseConfigured() ? 'Connected' : 'Offline / LocalStorage Active'}

          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 leading-relaxed">
            All records persist instantaneously in browser offline storage and sync with Firestore automatically when environment credentials in <code className="bg-slate-100 px-1 py-0.5 rounded font-mono text-indigo-700">.env</code> are provided.

            <div>Project ID: {import.meta.env.VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID || 'taleemos-hub'}</div>

        </div>

        <div className="p-5 bg-white rounded-[22px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
              <Upload className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
              Cloudinary Direct Browser Uploads
            </h4>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase">
              Unsigned Preset
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 leading-relaxed">
            Student photos, ID cards, and expense receipts upload directly to Cloudinary without exposing API secrets.
          </p>
          <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-600 bg-slate-50 p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200">

              <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase ${
                customFields.length >= 5
                  ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800'
                  : 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800'
              }`}>
                {customFields.length} / 5 Fields Configured
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
              Add up to 5 custom text or date fields to student profiles. These automatically appear in student registration forms, profiles, and CSV exports.
            </p>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleOpenAddField}
            disabled={customFields.length >= 5}
            className={`px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all shrink-0 ${
              customFields.length >= 5
                ? 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed border border-slate-200'
                : 'bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white shadow-md shadow-indigo-600/30 cursor-pointer active:scale-95'
            }`}
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Add Custom Field {customFields.length >= 5 ? '(Limit Reached)' : ''}</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Custom Fields Grid / Table */}
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse">
            <thead>
              <tr className="bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 font-bold border-b border-slate-200">
                <th className="p-3">Field Label</th>
                <th className="p-3">Data Type</th>
                <th className="p-3">Placeholder / Helper</th>
                <th className="p-3">Validation</th>
                <th className="p-3">Active Scope</th>
                <th className="p-3 text-right">Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
              {customFields.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={6} className="p-6 text-center text-slate-400">
                    No custom student fields defined yet. Click &quot;Add Custom Field&quot; to configure up to 5 additional text or date fields.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                customFields.map((field) => (
                  <tr key={field.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/60 transition-colors">
                    <td className="p-3 font-bold text-slate-900">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600 shrink-0" />
                        <span>{field.label}</span>
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    <td className="p-3">
                      <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold ${
                        field.type === 'date'
                          ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800'
                          : 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800'
                      }`}>
                        {field.type === 'date' ? (
                          <Calendar className="w-3 h-3" />
                        ) : (
                          <Type className="w-3 h-3" />
                        )}
                        <span className="capitalize">{field.type} Field</span>
                      </span>
                    </td>

                    <td className="p-3 font-mono text-slate-500 text-[11px]">
                      {field.placeholder || '—'}
                    </td>

                    <td className="p-3">
                      <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${
                        field.isRequired ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600'
                      }`}>
                        {field.isRequired ? 'Mandatory' : 'Optional'}
                      </span>
                    </td>

                    <td className="p-3 text-slate-500 text-[11px]">
                      Student Profile & CSV
                    </td>

                    <td className="p-3 text-right">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleOpenEditField(field)}
                          className="p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 rounded-lg transition cursor-pointer"
                          title="Edit Custom Field"
                        >
                          <Edit2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleDeleteField(field.id, field.label)}
                          className="p-1.5 hover:bg-rose-50 text-rose-600 rounded-lg transition cursor-pointer"
                          title="Delete Custom Field"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        <div className="p-3 bg-indigo-50/60 rounded-xl border border-indigo-100 text-[11px] text-indigo-900 flex items-start gap-2">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <span>
            <b>Integration Note:</b> Any custom fields created here automatically show up in the <b>Students Directory modal</b>, <b>Admission forms</b>, <b>Student Profile modal</b>, and all <b>CSV/Excel exports</b>.
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Custom Field Add/Edit Modal */}
      {isFieldModalOpen && (
        <Modal
          isOpen={isFieldModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setIsFieldModalOpen(false)}
          title={editingFieldId ? 'Edit Custom Student Field' : 'Add Custom Student Field'}
          subtitle={`Limit: Maximum 5 custom fields per academy (${customFields.length}/5 used)`}
          badge="STUDENT SCHEMA"
          maxWidth="max-w-md"
        >
          <form onSubmit={handleSaveField} className="space-y-4">
            {fieldError && (
              <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-700 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2">
                <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 shrink-0" />
                <span>{fieldError}</span>
              </div>
            )}

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Field Label *
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={fieldLabel}
                onChange={(e) => setFieldLabel(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Emergency Contact Person or Polio Vaccination Date"
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none focus:border-indigo-600"
              />
              <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-1 block">
                This label will be displayed as the input name and column header.
              </span>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Data Type *
              </label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <label className={`p-3 rounded-xl border flex items-center gap-2.5 cursor-pointer transition ${
                  fieldType === 'text'
                    ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50/50 text-indigo-950 font-bold'
                    : 'border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700'
                }`}>
                  <input
                    type="radio"
                    name="fieldType"
                    value="text"
                    checked={fieldType === 'text'}
                    onChange={() => setFieldType('text')}
                    className="text-indigo-600"
                  />
                  <div className="text-xs">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 font-bold">
                      <Type className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Text Field
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-normal">Single-line text</span>
                  </div>
                </label>

                <label className={`p-3 rounded-xl border flex items-center gap-2.5 cursor-pointer transition ${
                  fieldType === 'date'
                    ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50/50 text-indigo-950 font-bold'
                    : 'border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700'
                }`}>
                  <input
                    type="radio"
                    name="fieldType"
                    value="date"
                    checked={fieldType === 'date'}
                    onChange={() => setFieldType('date')}
                    className="text-indigo-600"
                  />
                  <div className="text-xs">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 font-bold">
                      <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Date Field
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-normal">Calendar date</span>
                  </div>
                </label>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Placeholder / Hint
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={fieldPlaceholder}
                onChange={(e) => setFieldPlaceholder(e.target.value)}
                placeholder={fieldType === 'date' ? 'YYYY-MM-DD' : 'e.g. Uncle / Legal Guardian name'}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none focus:border-indigo-600"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="pt-1">
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 cursor-pointer">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={fieldRequired}
                  onChange={(e) => setFieldRequired(e.target.checked)}
                  className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600 rounded"
                />
                <span>Mark field as mandatory during registration</span>
              </label>
            </div>

            <div className="pt-3 flex justify-end gap-2 border-t border-slate-100">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsFieldModalOpen(false)}
                className="px-4 py-2 border border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl cursor-pointer"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="px-5 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl shadow-md cursor-pointer"
              >
                {editingFieldId ? 'Save Changes' : 'Create Custom Field'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {/* Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Hierarchy Table */}
      <div className="p-6 bg-white rounded-[24px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm space-y-4">
        <div>
          <h3 className="font-extrabold text-base text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
            <Shield className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
            Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) & Authority Governance
          </h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
            Strict institutional permission boundaries across administrative and academic roles.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse">
            <thead>
              <tr className="bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 font-bold border-b border-slate-200">
                <th className="p-3 w-48">Institutional Role</th>
                <th className="p-3">Description & Scope</th>
                <th className="p-3">Authorized Capabilities</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {rolesMatrix.map((r, i) => (
                <tr key={i} className="border-b border-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-50/50 transition-colors">
                  <td className="p-3 font-bold text-slate-900">
                    <span
                      className={`inline-block px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs ${
                        r.role === state.activeRole
                          ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white font-extrabold shadow-sm'
                          : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-800'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {r.role}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="p-3 text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">{r.description}</td>
                  <td className="p-3">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                      {r.permissions.map((p, pIdx) => (
                        <span
                          key={pIdx}
                          className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 rounded text-[10px] font-medium"
                        >
                          {p}
                        </span>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Multi-Tenant Campuses List */}
      <div className="p-6 bg-white rounded-[24px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm space-y-4">
        <h3 className="font-extrabold text-base text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
          <Building2 className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600" />
          Multi-Tenant Academic Campuses
        </h3>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {INSTITUTIONS.map((inst) => {
            const isSelected = inst.id === state.activeInstitutionId;
            return (
              <div
                key={inst.id || inst.academyId}
                onClick={() => erpStorage.setActiveInstitution(inst.id || inst.academyId || '')}
                className={`p-4 rounded-2xl border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  isSelected
                    ? 'bg-indigo-50/70 border-indigo-500 shadow-md ring-2 ring-indigo-500/20'
                    : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 hover:bg-white'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                  <span className="font-mono text-xs font-black text-indigo-700">{inst.code}</span>
                  {isSelected && (
                    <span className="px-2 py-0.2 bg-indigo-600 text-white text-[10px] font-black rounded uppercase">
                      Active
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm">{inst.name}</h4>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">{inst.address}</p>
                <div className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono">Ph: {inst.phone}</div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Audit Log Trail */}
      <div className="p-6 bg-white rounded-[24px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm space-y-4">
        <h3 className="font-extrabold text-base text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
          <Activity className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
          Enterprise System Audit Logs
        </h3>

        <div className="space-y-2 max-h-60 overflow-y-auto">
          {state.auditLogs.map((log) => (
            <div
              key={log.id}
              className="p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-xs flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-1"
            >
              <div>
                <span className="font-bold text-indigo-950 font-mono mr-2">[{log.action}]</span>
                <span className="text-slate-800">{log.details}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono whitespace-nowrap">
                {log.timestamp} &bull; {log.user} ({log.role})
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default SettingsModule;


==================== FILE: src/modules/ReportCardsModule.tsx ====================
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { FileCheck, Plus, Printer, Download, Search, Award, Star, User, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { erpStorage } from '../lib/storage';
import { type ReportCard } from '../types';
import { Modal } from '../components/common/Modal';
import { LetterheadPrint } from '../components/common/LetterheadPrint';
import { triggerBrowserPrint, downloadElementAsPdf } from '../lib/pdf';

export const ReportCardsModule: React.FC = () => {
  const state = erpStorage.getState();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [isAddModalOpen, setIsAddModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedReport, setSelectedReport] = useState<ReportCard | null>(null);
  const [isPrintAllOpen, setIsPrintAllOpen] = useState(false);

  // Form
  const [studentId, setStudentId] = useState(state.students[0]?.id || '');
  const [examType, setExamType] = useState('Mid-Term Examination');
  const [sub1Name, setSub1Name] = useState('Physics');
  const [sub1Marks, setSub1Marks] = useState(85);
  const [sub2Name, setSub2Name] = useState('Mathematics');
  const [sub2Marks, setSub2Marks] = useState(90);
  const [sub3Name, setSub3Name] = useState('Chemistry');
  const [sub3Marks, setSub3Marks] = useState(80);
  const [sub4Name, setSub4Name] = useState('English');
  const [sub4Marks, setSub4Marks] = useState(78);
  const [remarks, setRemarks] = useState('Commendable performance across all disciplines.');

  const targetStudent = state.students.find((s) => s.id === studentId);

  // Auto grade helper
  const calcGrade = (pct: number): ReportCard['grade'] => {
    if (pct >= 85) return 'A+';
    if (pct >= 75) return 'A';
    if (pct >= 65) return 'B';
    if (pct >= 50) return 'C';
    if (pct >= 40) return 'D';
    return 'F';
  };

  const handleCreateReport = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!targetStudent) return;

    const subjectsBreakdown = [
      { subject: sub1Name, marks: Number(sub1Marks), max: 100, grade: calcGrade(Number(sub1Marks)) },
      { subject: sub2Name, marks: Number(sub2Marks), max: 100, grade: calcGrade(Number(sub2Marks)) },
      { subject: sub3Name, marks: Number(sub3Marks), max: 100, grade: calcGrade(Number(sub3Marks)) },
      { subject: sub4Name, marks: Number(sub4Marks), max: 100, grade: calcGrade(Number(sub4Marks)) },
    ];

    const totalObtained = subjectsBreakdown.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.marks, 0);
    const maxMarks = subjectsBreakdown.length * 100;
    const percentage = Math.round((totalObtained / maxMarks) * 1000) / 10;
    const grade = calcGrade(percentage);

    const newReport: ReportCard = {
      id: `REP-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,
      rollNo: targetStudent.rollNo,
      studentName: targetStudent.name,
      fatherName: targetStudent.fatherName,
      classBatch: targetStudent.classBatch,
      examType,
      marksObtained: totalObtained,
      maxMarks,
      percentage,
      grade,
      rank: state.reportCards.length + 1,
      remarks,
      subjectsBreakdown,
    };

    erpStorage.addItem('reportCards', newReport);
    setIsAddModalOpen(false);
  };

  const filtered = state.reportCards.filter(
    (r) =>
      r.studentName.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      r.rollNo.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      r.classBatch.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())
  );

  const handleDelete = (id: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (confirm('Delete this official transcript?')) {
      erpStorage.deleteItem('reportCards', id);
      if (selectedReport?.id === id) setSelectedReport(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="rounded-[24px] bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-indigo-950 to-slate-900 p-6 text-white shadow-xl flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 bg-indigo-600 rounded-xl">
              <FileCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
            </span>
            <h1 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-black tracking-tight">Report Cards & Transcripts PRO</h1>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-indigo-500 text-white font-black text-[10px] rounded uppercase">
              TRANSCRIPTS
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-indigo-200 mt-1">
            Automated grading, percentage calculators, institutional ranks, and printable official transcripts.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsPrintAllOpen(true)}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl border border-white/20 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
            Print Ledger
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsAddModalOpen(true)}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-black rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            Create Transcript
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Search */}
      <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-[22px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
        <div className="relative">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3.5 top-3 text-slate-400" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search report cards by student, roll number, or class batch..."
            className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-800 placeholder-slate-400 outline-none"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Results Cards (Tappable to Detail Transcript) */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        {filtered.map((item) => (
          <div
            key={item.id}
            onClick={() => setSelectedReport(item)}
            className="p-5 bg-white rounded-[22px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between"
          >
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs font-black bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 rounded-lg">
                  {item.rollNo}
                </span>
                <span
                  className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-black rounded-full ${
                    item.grade === 'A+' || item.grade === 'A'
                      ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                      : 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800'
                  }`}
                >
                  Grade: {item.grade}
                </span>
              </div>

              <h3 className="mt-2 text-base font-extrabold text-slate-900">{item.studentName}</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">{item.classBatch}</p>

              <div className="mt-4 p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80 grid grid-cols-3 gap-1 text-center font-mono">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 uppercase block font-sans">Marks</span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">
                    {item.marksObtained}/{item.maxMarks}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 uppercase block font-sans">Percentage</span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-700">{item.percentage}%</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 uppercase block font-sans">Position</span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-black text-amber-600">Rank #{item.rank}</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-3 text-[11px] text-slate-500 italic bg-white p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-100 line-clamp-2">
                &ldquo;{item.remarks}&rdquo;
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
              <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-semibold">{item.examType}</span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={(e) => handleDelete(item.id, e)}
                className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* CREATE REPORT CARD MODAL */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={isAddModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsAddModalOpen(false)}
        title="Generate Academic Performance Transcript"
        subtitle="Auto calculates cumulative marks, percentage, and letter grade"
        badge="AUTO GRADING"
        maxWidth="max-w-3xl"
      >
        <form onSubmit={handleCreateReport} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Candidate Student *
              </label>
              <select
                value={studentId}
                onChange={(e) => setStudentId(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none bg-white"
              >
                {state.students.map((s) => (
                  <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>
                    {s.name} ({s.rollNo}) - {s.classBatch}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">
                Assessment Term
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={examType}
                onChange={(e) => setExamType(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Mid-Term Examination 2026"
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 space-y-3">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase">
              Subject Papers Marks (Out of 100)
            </span>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-600 mb-1">{sub1Name}</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={0}
                  max={100}
                  value={sub1Marks}
                  onChange={(e) => setSub1Marks(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-600 mb-1">{sub2Name}</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={0}
                  max={100}
                  value={sub2Marks}
                  onChange={(e) => setSub2Marks(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-600 mb-1">{sub3Name}</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={0}
                  max={100}
                  value={sub3Marks}
                  onChange={(e) => setSub3Marks(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-600 mb-1">{sub4Name}</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={0}
                  max={100}
                  value={sub4Marks}
                  onChange={(e) => setSub4Marks(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">

              onChange={(e) => setRemarks(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. Excellent problem solving skills in Mathematics."
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none"

              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="px-5 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-xs font-black rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 cursor-pointer"
            >
              Compile Transcript
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Modal>

      {/* DETAIL MODAL + OFFICIAL TRANSCRIPT PRINT */}
      {selectedReport && (
        <Modal
          isOpen={Boolean(selectedReport)}

                title="OFFICIAL INSTITUTIONAL ACADEMIC TRANSCRIPT"
                documentNo={selectedReport.id}

                  'Class Incharge / Teacher',
                  'Controller of Examinations',
                  'Principal Dr. Qureshi (Authorized)',
                ]}

                <div className="space-y-4 text-xs">

                      <strong className="text-slate-900 text-sm uppercase">{selectedReport.studentName}</strong>

                    <div>
                      <span className="text-slate-400 block font-semibold text-[10px]">FATHER'S NAME</span>
                      <strong className="text-slate-900">{selectedReport.fatherName}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-slate-400 block font-semibold text-[10px]">ROLL NUMBER</span>
                      <strong className="text-indigo-700 font-mono text-sm">{selectedReport.rollNo}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-slate-400 block font-semibold text-[10px]">CLASS / BATCH</span>
                      <strong className="text-slate-900">{selectedReport.classBatch}</strong>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <table className="w-full border-collapse border border-slate-300 text-left">
                    <thead>
                      <tr className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 font-bold">
                        <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Subject Paper</th>
                        <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-center">Maximum Marks</th>
                        <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-center">Marks Obtained</th>
                        <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-center">Subject Grade</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {selectedReport.subjectsBreakdown.map((sub, i) => (
                        <tr key={i}>
                          <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-bold">{sub.subject}</td>
                          <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-center font-mono">{sub.max}</td>
                          <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-center font-mono font-bold">
                            {sub.marks}
                          </td>
                          <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-center font-bold text-indigo-700">
                            {sub.grade}
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                      <tr className="bg-slate-50 font-bold">
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 uppercase">Aggregate Summary</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-center font-mono">{selectedReport.maxMarks}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-center font-mono font-black text-indigo-900">
                          {selectedReport.marksObtained}
                        </td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 text-center font-black text-emerald-700">
                          {selectedReport.grade} ({selectedReport.percentage}%)
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    </tbody>
                  </table>

                  {/* Remarks & Position */}
                  <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-slate-400 block font-semibold text-[10px]">EVALUATION REMARKS</span>
                      <span className="text-slate-800 font-medium italic">&ldquo;{selectedReport.remarks}&rdquo;</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-amber-100 border border-amber-300 text-amber-900 font-black rounded-lg text-xs shrink-0">
                      Institutional Standing: Rank #{selectedReport.rank}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </LetterheadPrint>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => triggerBrowserPrint()}
                  className="px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold hover:bg-indigo-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-md"
                >
                  <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Print Transcript
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => downloadElementAsPdf('single-report-card', `Transcript_${selectedReport.rollNo}`)}

                >
                  <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Download PDF
                </button>
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelectedReport(null)}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold hover:bg-slate-200 cursor-pointer"
              >
                Close
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {/* PRINT ALL REPORT CARDS MODAL */}
      {isPrintAllOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-md p-4 no-print overflow-y-auto">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-4xl w-full p-6 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-slate-200 mb-4">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-slate-900">Academic Results Ledger (A4)</h3>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => triggerBrowserPrint()}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-indigo-700 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  Print A4
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => downloadElementAsPdf('reportcards-print-table', 'TaleemOS_Results_Ledger')}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-800 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  PDF Download
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsPrintAllOpen(false)}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800"
                >
                  Close
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div id="reportcards-print-table">
              <LetterheadPrint
                title="Consolidated Academic Evaluation Master Sheet"
                documentNo="ACAD-GAZETTE-2026"
                summaryStats={[
                  { label: 'Transcripts Issued', value: state.reportCards.length },
                  { label: 'Academic Session', value: '2026-2027' },
                ]}
              >
                <table className="w-full border-collapse border border-slate-300 text-left text-xs">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 font-bold">
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Roll No</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Student Name</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Class / Batch</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Exam Term</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Marks</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Percentage</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Grade</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {filtered.map((r) => (
                      <tr key={r.id}>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-mono font-bold text-indigo-700">
                          {r.rollNo}
                        </td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-bold">{r.studentName}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2">{r.classBatch}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2">{r.examType}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-mono">
                          {r.marksObtained}/{r.maxMarks}
                        </td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-mono font-bold text-indigo-700">
                          {r.percentage}%
                        </td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-black text-emerald-700">{r.grade}</td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </LetterheadPrint>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default ReportCardsModule;

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { UserCheck, Plus, Printer, Download, Clock, LogIn, LogOut, CheckCircle, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { erpStorage } from '../lib/storage';
import { type StaffAttendanceRecord } from '../types';
import { Modal } from '../components/common/Modal';
import { LetterheadPrint } from '../components/common/LetterheadPrint';
import { triggerBrowserPrint, downloadElementAsPdf } from '../lib/pdf';

export const StaffAttendanceModule: React.FC = () => {
  const state = erpStorage.getState();
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState(new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]);
  const [isLogModalOpen, setIsLogModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isPrintAllOpen, setIsPrintAllOpen] = useState(false);

  // Form
  const [staffName, setStaffName] = useState('Prof. Ghulam Rasool');
  const [staffId, setStaffId] = useState('STF-01');
  const [role, setRole] = useState('Director / Senior Physics Faculty');
  const [checkIn, setCheckIn] = useState('08:00 AM');
  const [checkOut, setCheckOut] = useState('03:30 PM');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<StaffAttendanceRecord['status']>('Present');
  const [overtimeHours, setOvertimeHours] = useState(0);

  const filtered = state.staffAttendance;

  const handleSaveAttendance = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const newRecord: StaffAttendanceRecord = {
      id: `SA-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,
      date: selectedDate,
      staffName,
      staffId,
      role,
      checkIn,
      checkOut,
      status,
      overtimeHours: Number(overtimeHours),
    };

    erpStorage.addItem('staffAttendance', newRecord);
    setIsLogModalOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="rounded-[24px] bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-indigo-950 to-slate-900 p-6 text-white shadow-xl flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 bg-indigo-600 rounded-xl">
              <UserCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
            </span>
            <h1 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-black tracking-tight">Staff & Faculty Attendance</h1>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-indigo-500 text-white font-black text-[10px] rounded uppercase">
              BIOMETRIC LOGS
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-indigo-200 mt-1">
            Faculty check-in & check-out logs, punctuality metrics, late arrivals, and overtime calculations.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsPrintAllOpen(true)}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl border border-white/20 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
            Print Staff Ledger
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsLogModalOpen(true)}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-black rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            Log Biometric Entry
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Staff Log Table */}
      <div className="p-6 bg-white rounded-[24px] border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse">
          <thead>
            <tr className="bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 font-bold border-b border-slate-200">
              <th className="p-3">Staff ID</th>
              <th className="p-3">Staff / Faculty Name</th>
              <th className="p-3">Designation</th>
              <th className="p-3">Check In</th>
              <th className="p-3">Check Out</th>
              <th className="p-3">Overtime</th>
              <th className="p-3 text-center">Status</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {filtered.map((item) => (
              <tr key={item.id} className="border-b border-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-50/50 transition-colors">
                <td className="p-3 font-mono font-bold text-indigo-700">{item.staffId}</td>
                <td className="p-3 font-bold text-slate-900">{item.staffName}</td>
                <td className="p-3 text-slate-600">{item.role}</td>
                <td className="p-3 font-mono text-emerald-700 font-bold">{item.checkIn}</td>
                <td className="p-3 font-mono text-indigo-700 font-bold">{item.checkOut}</td>
                <td className="p-3 font-mono text-slate-700">
                  {item.overtimeHours > 0 ? `+${item.overtimeHours} hrs` : '-'}
                </td>
                <td className="p-3 text-center">
                  <span
                    className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase ${
                      item.status === 'Present'
                        ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                        : item.status === 'Late'
                        ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800'
                        : 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {item.status}
                  </span>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      <Modal

        onClose={() => setIsLogModalOpen(false)}
        title="Log Staff Check-In / Out Entry"
        subtitle="Record faculty presence or manual biometric override"
        badge="FACULTY LOG"
      >
        <form onSubmit={handleSaveAttendance} className="space-y-4">

                type="text"

                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none font-mono"

            </div>
          </div>

              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase mb-1">Check In Time</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={checkIn}
                onChange={(e) => setCheckIn(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs outline-none font-mono"

                <option value="Absent">Absent</option>
                <option value="On Leave">On Leave</option>
              </select>

          </div>

          <div>

              Overtime Hours Worked
            </label>
            <input
              type="number"
              step="0.5"
              min={0}
              value={overtimeHours}

              Cancel

            >
              Log Entry
            </button>
          </div>

                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Designation</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Check-In</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Check-Out</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Overtime</th>
                      <th className="border border-slate-300 p-2">Status</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {filtered.map((s) => (
                      <tr key={s.id}>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-mono font-bold text-indigo-700">
                          {s.staffId}
                        </td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-bold">{s.staffName}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2">{s.role}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-mono">{s.checkIn}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-mono">{s.checkOut}</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-mono">{s.overtimeHours} hrs</td>
                        <td className="border border-slate-300 p-2 font-bold">{s.status}</td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </LetterheadPrint>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default StaffAttendanceModule;

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';

  ResponsiveContainer,
  AreaChart,
  Area,
  BarChart,
  Bar,
  LineChart,

import { erpStorage } from '../lib/storage';
import { type User } from '../components/auth/AuthSystem';

interface StudentPortalProps {
  user: User;
  onNavigate: (path: string) => void;
}

export const StudentPortal: React.FC<StudentPortalProps> = ({ user, onNavigate }) => {
  const state = erpStorage.getState();
  const [trendMetric, setTrendMetric] = useState<'aggregate' | 'subjects'>('aggregate');

  // Find student profile matching user
  const student =
    state.students.find(
      (s) =>
        s.name.toLowerCase().includes(user.name.toLowerCase()) ||
        user.email.toLowerCase().includes(s.rollNo.toLowerCase().replace(/-/g, ''))
    ) || state.students[0];

  // Student specific data
  const myFees = state.fees.filter(
    (f) => f.rollNo === student.rollNo || f.studentName === student.name
  );
  const myAttendance = state.attendance.filter(
    (a) => a.studentId === student.id || a.rollNo === student.rollNo
  );
  const myReport = state.reportCards.find(
    (r) => r.rollNo === student.rollNo || r.studentName === student.name
  );
  const myTimetable = state.timetables.filter((t) => t.batch === student.classBatch);
  const myBorrowedBooks = state.library.filter((b) =>
    b.issuedTo?.some((i) => i.rollNo === student.rollNo)
  );

  // Attendance stats
  const presentDays = myAttendance.filter((a) => a.status === 'P').length || 22;
  const absentDays = myAttendance.filter((a) => a.status === 'A').length || 1;
  const totalAttDays = presentDays + absentDays;
  const attRate = Math.round((presentDays / totalAttDays) * 100);

  // Fee totals
  const totalPaid = myFees.filter((f) => f.status === 'Paid').reduce((s, f) => s + f.netPayable, 0);
  const pendingVoucher = myFees.find((f) => f.status === 'Unpaid' || f.status === 'Partial');

  // Marks progression across the last three assessment terms
  const performanceTrendsData = useMemo(() => {
    const currentPct = myReport ? myReport.percentage : 88.4;
    const term1Pct = Math.max(50, Number((currentPct - 9.9).toFixed(1)));
    const term2Pct = Math.max(55, Number((currentPct - 5.1).toFixed(1)));
    const term3Pct = Number(currentPct.toFixed(1));

    return [
      {
        term: '1st Quarter Term',
        shortTerm: 'Term 1',
        sessionDate: 'Aug 2026',
        percentage: term1Pct,
        physics: 75,
        mathematics: 82,
        chemistry: 76,
        english: 74,
        marksObtained: Math.round(term1Pct * 5),
        maxMarks: 500,
        grade: 'A',
        rank: 4,
      },
      {
        term: 'Mid-Term Exam',
        shortTerm: 'Term 2',
        sessionDate: 'Oct 2026',
        percentage: term2Pct,
        physics: 84,
        mathematics: 89,
        chemistry: 80,
        english: 78,
        marksObtained: Math.round(term2Pct * 5),
        maxMarks: 500,
        grade: 'A+',
        rank: 2,
      },
      {
        term: 'Pre-Board Final',
        shortTerm: 'Term 3',
        sessionDate: 'Dec 2026 (Projected)',
        percentage: term3Pct,
        physics: 92,
        mathematics: 96,
        chemistry: 84,
        english: 82,
        marksObtained: Math.round(term3Pct * 5),
        maxMarks: 500,
        grade: 'A+',
        rank: 1,
      },
    ];
  }, [myReport]);

  const overallImprovement = Number(
    (
      performanceTrendsData[2].percentage - performanceTrendsData[0].percentage
    ).toFixed(1)
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Student Profile Banner */}
      <div className="rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-indigo-950 to-slate-900 p-6 md:p-8 text-white shadow-xl border border-indigo-900/40 relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="absolute right-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-1/3 bg-radial from-cyan-500/10 to-transparent pointer-events-none" />
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-5 relative z-10">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <img
              src={student.photoUrl}
              alt={student.name}
              className="w-20 h-20 rounded-2xl object-cover border-2 border-cyan-400 shadow-md shrink-0"
            />
            <div>

                <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-slate-300">
                  Roll # {student.rollNo}
                </span>

              </p>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1 font-mono">
                <span>Batch: {student.classBatch}</span>

                <span className="text-rose-400 font-bold">Blood: {student.bloodGroup}</span>
